rows.name: Blasting Courier
rows.short_description: Find the castle as a medieval courier while avoiding the deadly mines.
rows.description_html: You take the role of a medieval courier tasked with the quest of delivering important letters to kings and queens (they usually reside in castles). However, your path is not easy. You have to avoid deadly mines that can blast you to the stars and back. In Blasting Courier you control a 2D top-down character. You can control that character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The primary goal is to reach the unique castle per level. You can also flag the mines, so you can avoid them better. Compete with friends and see who is the best medieval messenger. Levels are procedurally generated and only limited by the specs of your computer. If you have any ideas, please visit our Discord server or our subreddit! We can talk about it and probably get it into the game. Don't forget to leave a review no matter what the rating is. Constructive criticism goes a long way!

rows.name: Peril by MDE
rows.short_description: Use your javelin to jump across platforms, solve puzzles, and defeat monsters in seven unique worlds. If you are a fan of retro platformers, you are going to love this game!
rows.description_html: Peril is a retro action adventure 2d platformer. In this game the player must battle through various worlds and defeat many enemies, all the while using a javelin as both a weapon and a tool to reach new places. Battle against dangerous enemies -Over 40 different enemies to face -7 unique and challenging bosses -Choose to slice them with your sword or snipe them with your javelin Upgrade character stats -Collect gems and coins to upgrade your sword strength, javelin power, max health, or javelin capacity Use your Javelin to jump across obstacles -Master the art of throwing your javelin to make a new platform Solve puzzles -Puzzles are built to be solves in many unique ways. The javelin can provide some creative solutions to challenges.

rows.name: Flash Party
rows.short_description: Flash Party brings another major update: new colorful stickers, weekly free heroes, community event trophy wall... The fun and exciting fighting party continues! Flash Party is a platform fighter. Attack, jump, dodge, and block... throw your opponents off-stage with all sorts of moves!
rows.description_html: JOIN US ON DISOCRD About the Game Enjoy the Thrill of Battle! Flash Party is back with the Dark Side of the Moon major update: a whole new batch of colorful stickers, weekly free heroes, community event trophy walls...the exciting and fun-filled battle party continues! Flash Party is a platform fighter. You can control the most interesting heroes in this exciting fighting party. Attack, jump, dodge, and block... throw your opponents off-stage with all sorts of moves! Discover your unique style, and you are the next Party Star! [How to Win] To win the party, it's as simple as knocking everyone else off-stage! Attack the Heroes controlled by other players and increase the Knock-out Score above their head; The higher the KO Score, the more susceptible they are to knock-outs. [Original Characters] Meet all kinds of unique original characters! A Chubby snowman, a God of Trial that descends from heaven, a high school girl with an apple-shaped head, and an idol singer admired by all, everyone’s waiting for you in the exciting Flash Party battles! Of course, there's also the brand new hero from the indie action game ICEY, as well as the Kamaitachi Girl designed by players... With over 20 unique heroes to choose from and more new heroes being introduced, the action never stops! The Heroes are categorized into four types: All-rounder, Assaulter, Power House, and Impeder; each has an exclusive fighting mechanism. All-rounder: Attack in three directions to accumulate energy and release a Super Neutral Special Assaulter: Cancel specific attacks with certain moves to remove the Ending Lag, creating abundant combo openings and variations Power House: The higher their KO Score is, the more powerful their Attack becomes Impeder: Attack Shields to accumulate energy and release a Super Grab & Throw [Easy Start] After the Dark Side of the Moon major update , two heroes will be available for free trial every week, which can be used without restrictions in all modes! We hope that new coming players can also try various heroes until you find your own favorite hero! The new Wish Come True Card event also allows you to obtain the desired colorful stickers more easily, and the first-time activation is completely free! [Game Modes] Here, you will participate in 1v1 Challenge, Team Competition, Brawl, and Soccer Showdown, as well as weekend-limited event modes, and Friendly Battle mode to play with friends anytime. For players who want to hone their skills, join the Pinnacle Arena! Rise to higher ranks in modes such as Pinnacle Solo, Pinnacle Relay, and Pinnacle Team, and become a master player in the party! [Become the Champion] Thanks to the support of the global community, we are able to continue hosting exciting and dynamic competitions in Flash Party! In the Dark Side of the Moon major update, we have added the Trophy Wall feature. Winning official tournaments and community-certified events will earn you commemorative trophies in your personal profile! [Costumes] Collect various themed hero skins, KO effects, and other decorations from themes like Pool Party, Oriental Legend, Western Adventure, and Cosmic Adventure to become the shining star of the party! [Season: Party Pass] Each season has a unique party pass theme, and by participating in competitions or completing seasonal missions, you can unlock party rewards, including skins, emojis, KO effects, and more. Purchase a Star Card to unlock more missions and have a chance to redeem past season-exclusive rewards. [To Be a Party Animal] Find more friends in the party, team up for battle or practice together. Create a dojo and improve together with friends. Edit your hero banner to showcase your accumulated achievements. Compete for the regional rankings of hero scores and arena ranks and become a top-ranked fighter in your area. Go to the video hall to find your mentor. Here, you have multiple ways to enjoy the joyful fighting party with others! Party stars, show us what you've got!

rows.name: Smelogs Playground
rows.short_description: Smelogs Playground is a Free-to-Play Real-Time Strategy game with charming aesthetics and a simple but effective gameplay mechanism. Take over the playful and rocky Smelogs to compete against each other for fun and honor!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Conquer the Aztec Realm! Smelogs Playground invites you to enter the mystical realm of ancient Aztec civilization. Build your base, command armies, and wield powerful magical spells. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or a newcomer to the genre, Smelogs Playground offers an immersive experience that combines strategy, combat, and enchantment. Base Building Construct your Aztec stronghold from the ground up. Gather resources, construct Cave systems, and fortify walls. Will you create an impenetrable fortress or an elaborate maze of traps? Your base is the heart of your empire, and its design will impact your success on the battlefield. Dynamic Sidegrade In the mystical Aztec world of Smelogs Playground, nothing is static. Units possess hidden potential—they can evolve into structures, and buildings can morph back into warriors. Unit Controlling and Combat Lead your units to victory. From swift Ballers to punchy warriors to the powerful Obsidian Cannons, assemble your forces strategically. Micromanage troops during epic battles to outmaneuver foes. Witness the clash of armies as they vie for dominance. Crystal Codex Spells Tap into the mystical energy of the Crystal Codex. Learn powerful spells that can turn the tide of battles. Summon comet showers, heal wounded soldiers and structures, or uncover hidden enemies. Base Editor Define how your initial base should look like before the match has even started. You can place units and buildings for strategic depth right from the start of the match. Unleash your creativity! Design custom bases, and share them with friends. Procedural generated maps with Neutral Objectives Navigate, adapt, and overcome the unknown capture neutral objectives and beware of unknown creatures. Player Progression and Customization Advance through levels and unlock new challenges and cosmetics. Personalize your appearance, avatar, border, and title. Stand out on the battlefield and let your enemies know who they’re up against. Online Ranked Ladder Battles Challenge the Best: Test your mettle against players from around the world. Climb the ranked ladder by winning battles. Rise through the tiers—from novice to grand master. Elo Points: Each victory earns you Elo points, while defeats deduct them. Prove your strategic prowess and ascend to the top ranks. Custom Game Lobbies Host Your Arena: Create custom lobbies with personalized rules. Choose map settings, and even tweak resource rates. Invite friends or fellow strategists to join your private matches. Variety Unleashed: Whether it’s a no-rush skirmish or a resource-rich clash, tailor the game to your liking. Experiment with unconventional strategies and settings. Skirmish Against AI Training Grounds: Hone your skills. Face off against cunning AI opponents. Adjust difficulty levels—from novice to deity—and learn the intricacies of unit management and base building. Experiment and Learn: Try out new tactics, explore the tech tree, and discover hidden synergies. The AI adapts, so stay on your toes! Single-player and Coop Tackle dynamic missions, manage your loadout, and complete objectives while strategically navigating the Playground, balancing risk to secure successful extractions and progress further. The Aztec realm awaits your command. Will you forge alliances, dominate the ranked ladder, or unravel the mysteries of Smelogs Playground?

rows.name: Bullet Bash
rows.short_description: Minigames meet FPS madness in this epic party game. Play with your friends, your enemies and your friends recently turned enemies.
rows.description_html: Blast through a series of FPS based minigames with your friends and prove your greatness! Whether you're an ultra experienced FPS expert or a more casual player, Bullet Bash has minigames for all types. From the sane and sensible to sheer comedic insanity, from classic minigames to the brand new, there will be plenty of fun (and agonizing pain) for all. Minimum of four players recommended but, can be played with as many as twelve. Here are just some of the minigames available: Rocket Jump Race- Prove you're the ultimate rocket jump master or the ultimate boomer who knows... Dodgeball- Similar to the sport but with more explosives, way more explosives... One Gun- Everyone starts with the same gun prove you're the best sniper/assault/shotgun etc... specialist there is One Shot Kill- Similar to One Gun but all weapons (and explosives) kill instantly. You've gotta stay on your toes and watch out because danger could come at anytime. Blindfold- Players receive a blindfold on spawn. Every so often the blindfold gets removed but only briefly. Knockout- Knock opponents out of the arena with some serious firepower. Breakfloor- Break the floor... and hope your opponent doesn't do the same... Trap Master- Reimagining of a famous game mode. In Trap Master you must either activate traps eliminating enemy players or survive said traps and return the favor. and more!

rows.name: Transformation Tycoon
rows.short_description: [18+] Run a small clinic that performs transformations for clients. Research new transformation techniques. Hire staff and fulfill their dreams by granting them their own transformation. Upgrade your clinic and gain fame (or infamy!) from your actions. Become the ultimate TRANSFORMATION TYCOON!
rows.description_html: [18+] Transformation Tycoon is a transformation themed, tycoon-style business simulation game. You have just unlocked a patented new technique to transform people into other sexes, animals, items, mythological beings, and more. What do you plan to do with this new knowledge? Make money, of course! You have rented a small clinic on a city street where visitors can be transformed into the body of their dreams--for a price, of course! In this business simulation / tycoon-style game, you research new types of transformations to satisfy a growing pool of eager applicants. Hire employees to help you out and incentivize them with their own illustrated transformations. Take out loans to help you grow and begin advertisement campaigns to spread the word of your services. Upgrade your transformation chambers and move to larger, more prestigious locations. Grow your fame to attract applicants from local legends, Hollywood stars, and all manners of international celebrities each with their own reason for being transformed, or having others in their inner circle be transformed. Do all this to change the world one transformation at a time and become the ultimate TRANSFORMATION TYCOON ! IMPLEMENTED FEATURES: - Hire and manage employees from a unique cast of illustrated characters and perform transformation on them as their skills progress. Happy employees are efficient employees, and nothing makes them happier than giving them the body of their dreams! - Research new transformation types via paying research test subjects. - Hundreds of generated/randomized clients featuring thirteen transformation types: Feminization, Defeminization, Masculinization, Demasculinization, Feralization, Inanimation, Shrinking, Growth, Corruption, Purification, Personality, Fantasticalization, and Merging. - Story clients: repeat customers with storylines that progress alongside your clinic. - Alternate transformation choices: The transformation a client is expecting doesn't always have to be the one you're giving them! - Maintain your inventory of transformation crystals. Don't fall short of a crystal type when you need it most! - Configurable automatic inventory restocking, so long as you can afford it. - Advertise your clinic to increase application rate. - Handle Random Events that may help or hurt your finances, fame, infamy, employee morale, and more. - Employee client delegation can be enabled to auto-process already seen generated clients to help you see new characters more easily. - Relocate your clinic to attract more prestigious clients from local businessmen and women to Hollywood actors and actresses to international celebrities - Construct additional transformation chambers to process more clients at once, as well as upgrading existing ones to perform transforms more quickly and with a better chance at good results. - Take out and repay loans for temporary cash increase, but be wary of interest and daily payments! - Transformation calibration slider minigame to create skill-based transformation results for perfectionist players. The minigame can also be skipped by enabling on Autocalibration. - Rise the twelve tycoon ranks: Transformer-In-Training, Beginner Matter Mutator, Amateur Body-Morpher, Apprentice Alterator, Initiate Reengineer, Professional Remaker,Esteemed Recombinator, Metamorphosis Master, Renowned Reconstitutor, Regeneration Magnate, Titan of Transfiguration, and Transformation Tycoon! - Comes with a built-in Client Writer, allowing you to create your own generated and story clients that can be added to your game or shared with friends. We already have a number of community-written clients in the game and are always welcome to officially incorporating more! See Early Access for more information on what we still plan on adding to the game. NOTE : This game is centered around transformation themes including gender-bending (male to female, female to male, or inbetween), transformation into animals and anthropomorphic beings (anthros, furries), inanimate transformations (statues, clothing, adult toys), merging / absorption / transformation into body parts, shrinking, growth, and more. Undesired transformation themed can be disabled by simply not researching those transformation types , though game balance and content level is affected. Transformation lengths vary between a few days to being permanent, depending on the client. Be aware there are text-based descriptions of nudity and adult acts .

rows.name: Kolhii ChampionsAU
rows.short_description: On the great island of Mata Nui, the matoran compete for honor and glory in the great sport of Kolhii! With the copper masks up for grabs, all bets are off in this highly competetive arena. This is where champions are made!
rows.description_html: (Champions AU is a fan project, and not endoresed by The Lego Group) On the great island of Mata Nui, the matoran compete for honor and glory in the great sport of Kolhii! With the copper masks up for grabs, all bets are off in this highly competitive arena! Exploit every weakness your opponent shows, build up your own strengths, every mistake is punished. Meet new and familiar faces as you explore the island, and compete to become renowned in every village! There is no time for fun and games. This is where champions are made! Kolhii Champions is an online sports arena game, where players can compete in minigames and sports events inspired by the original BIONICLE series from The Lego Group! Players can customize their matoran using set and color accurate pieces, including pieces that were never printed in certain colors! Our namesake, the sport of Koli, is a game where a number of players up to 4 enter a field and each have their own goal to protect. Players kick stone comets into eachothers goals to score points and remove points from others! Strategy and threat assessment is required to come out on top! With graphics inspired by classic content such as the Mata Nui Online Games, or the Piraka Animations; mixed with modern visual fidelity, our aesthetic is one of revamped nostalgia. In this world first online BIONICLE experience, we aim to bring in not only old fans, but newer ones as well! We aim to craft an experience and community that joins everyone together, and further the legacy that the original series has created!

rows.name: Unreal Mashup
rows.short_description: Unreal Mashup will test your gaming ability with a solid first person shooter base experience. Fight against bots or join your friends in their personal server automatically created at every login. This high pace futuristic shooter is Fast!
rows.description_html: I am attempting to create a shooter experience tailored to our community's wishes. So what you see is what we all are looking for. Fast dynamic lateral movement and ideal projectile randomness incorporated with stylized animations which are generated dynamically via Unreal Engine's animation montage system, which by the way, is eye candy. We are using the Lyra shooter project as our base and as we go. I am planning to create customizable guns and characters along with providing stat based ranking and comparative match making. This will be the first game Ive created by myself so be aware Ill do my best to make this something good. This project was created for our community to have fun in a semi private way. As well this is a test of the unreal engines main shooter template LYRA which I'll be modifying as we go so updates will be a thing however I also know this thing is buggy! lol There are some audio glitching happening during respawns. Might just wanna turn that music volume down till I can get a fix for that. Now this is a basic third person shooter with a litany of baked in and ready to utilize features that over time I am going to learn and hopefully be able to modify and implement. I also want to point out that the networking system is janky ATM so we use Epic to run the game server hosting experience. rows.name: Wonky Wizard
rows.short_description: In this relaxed indie adventure game, you play a wizard that can shoot 'mouse-pointer' spells at little mushroom enemies, and whatever else lurks in the forrests... Explore the map, and enjoy the 3D, level based gameplay!
rows.description_html: A very WONKY Indie adventure game, where you play a WIZARD that runs around casting spells; traveling across the landscape. There are potions, giant mushrooms, mushroom wizards, and much more! One year in-dev Indie game, Enjoy this tiny piece of my brain!

rows.name: Medusa's Heart of Stone Chapter 01
rows.short_description: Medusa's Heart of Stone is a 2D narrative driven game with action sequences, puzzles and quest interspersed throughout. Feared by mortals and forsaken by the gods, Medusa embarks on a journey to find someone who could love her.
rows.description_html: Medusa was transformed into a gorgon for defiling Athena's temple while serving as a priestess there. Condemned to spend the rest of her life on a distant isle, she is determined to find a soulmate even though most of her visitors wish to chop off her head! Follow Medusa as she embarks on a journey to prove that even a gorgon can be loved. Play through a storyline that is both deep and lighthearted. Your actions will determine your fate. Defy mortals and the gods! Use your gorgon powers to turn things into stone. Go on quests. Meet the gods and other strange and interesting characters from greek mythology. Talk to your hair. NOTE: Originally, we planned to make this game three chapters long. Due to changing circumstances, we have decided to release the first chapter as a stand alone game. We hope you enjoy what we were able to finish.

rows.name: Helix
rows.short_description: Helix is a low-poly multiplayer FPS Hero-Shooter with MOBA-like Mechanics where during a match you will have to kill your opponents and steal their DNA to unlock and upgrade your abilities, giving you an edge against anyone standing in your way.
rows.description_html: Helix is a low-poly multiplayer FPS Hero-Shooter with MOBA-like Mechanics. During gameplay you will play as (currently) one of three characters: Aca, the red sound character specialized in close combat audio-visual attacks, Radon, the green smell character specialized in fast-moving prey-stalking combat through his heightened sense of smell, and Vision, the blue sight character specialized in long-range sniping combat, enhanced thanks to his improved owl-like sight. During a match, you will have to kill your opponents and steal their DNA to unlock and upgrade your abilities which will give you an edge against anyone standing in your way. There are (currently) two main modes, deathmatch, where through the use of your abilities you will have to kill the most amount of players, or team-deathmatch, which starts off as a normal team fight, but later evolves into a king-of-the-hill, where players with the most abilities will be able to unlock an area to capture. Through the unlock and upgrade of skills during the match and a dynamic game mode. Helix is trying to pursue a mix of FPS with MOBA-like mechanics.

rows.name: Cemetery Mary
rows.short_description: A visual novel about a girl who loves the cemetery. When her parents go missing, she receives a mysterious text that has the potential to completely ruin her life...or fix it?
rows.description_html: Cemetery Mary is the story about a girl who loves visiting the cemetery. When rumors of a serial killer start floating around town, she isn't too worried--that is, until her parents go missing. And in the wake of their disappearance, a message from an unknown number leaves Mary to wade through a sea of doubts and questions. Unknown Number Your parents are safe. [12:43 AM] Is the rumored 'Blackwood Butcher' playing some sort of sick prank? Or is something even more sinister responsible for their disappearance? Will she be able to find the identity of the mysterious killer, or the whereabouts of her parents? Or will her meddling threaten to make her a permanent resident of the very cemetery she so admires? This visual novel consists of 3 different routes, each with a Good Ending and a Bad Ending. There is also a True Ending, which can potentially be unlocked by playing any of the 3 routes. Average playtime for 1 route is 2-2.5 hours. The True Ending is capable of adding an additional 1-2 hours. Credits follow the True Ending!

rows.name: HIGHBLAST
rows.short_description: You have a spaceship ship full of robots, a drone and a planet to sabotage for the safety of the solar system. Highblast is a game about an agency protecting a solar system from a greedy civilisation.
rows.description_html: Highblast is now in its 3rd version. Hope you enjoy and thanks for playing if you have! We really appreciate it. Story Context HIGHBLAST is set on a planet in a distant solar system. You work for the local star system defence force. They prevent any 1 group of people from completely controlling a planet. You are helping to free a planet from an evil civilisation who want to take all the resources for war against other planets. You must infiltrate enemy bases to perform reconnaissance and weaken the enemy. Basic Game Mechanics (Not yet complete and coming soon) Enhance your robot soldiers by equipping various arm mounted or arm replacing weapons. Examples include a anti-drone radar, a flamethrower and a rail-gun! If a robot is disabled do not worry, you have backups! You will be able to upgrade the number of robots you can deploy in later game versions. Once all enemies are destroyed you return to the ship and leave for orbit to do repairs and upgrades. Custom Maps (Unavailable) You have the freedom to create your own maps and share them with others on the Steam Workshop with Highblast's Level Foundry . The map pieces snap to a grid. And new pieces and fixes are being worked on all the time! We are also considering procedural maps for infinite replayability! Early Development Disclaimer Highblast was originally released as a first game and was very very.... Indie in it's lack of everything. But we liked the concept an wanted to make something similar with a lot more content and a cool story. So if it seems far from finished, it is. And we (2 to 3 people in our free time) are constantly working on new stuff and fixes for old stuff. WE WILL NOT NEGLECT THIS GAME UNTIL IT'S DONE! :) Please enjoy and watch Highblast grow!

rows.name: WOLF RIOT
rows.short_description: Survive the night. Play as Frank the Werewolf for a wave based cage fight for survival. Tear through a convenience store to fend off a mechanized infantry platoon of mercenaries.
rows.description_html: Frank is having a bad night, he's a Werewolf just trying to get by. He's cornered in a convenience store by a platoon of Hunters, a secretive Mercenary group hell bent on exterminating the Lycan kind. They've been tracking Frank for weeks and now they have him right where they want him, silver bullets in the chamber, but he's not dead yet. A short, blood soaked beat'em'up. Survive the night, featuring the music of DEgITx. FEATURES: -Progressive destruction: Tear through enemies and helpless inanimate produce as the store gets more and more messed up over the course of your battle. -A ludicrous amount of physics objects and particle effects, nearly every item in the store can be displaced. -Move quickly throughout the store, dodging enemy fire and ambushing your attackers. -Quickly chain attacks together for ultimate carnage, score 50 kills to survive the night.

rows.name: Deadwater Saloon Prologue
rows.short_description: Dive into the wild west as a saloon owner with this Free Prologue version of Deadwater Saloon. Customize your character and face the consequences of your choices as you forge friendships and enemies of townsfolk, travellers, outlaws and lawmen all while building your saloon business.
rows.description_html: Deadwater Saloon Prologue This is a free introductory version of the full-game Deadwater Saloon . Play the first month-and-a-half of the in-game time, build your saloon, and watch and interact with the town as it starts to grow. Create Your Character Playing as a rich and dynamic character in the old west, you will be able to fully customize your attributes to fit your playstyle, such as Mixology, Seduction, and Sneakiness. You will manage your life as well as your saloon, such as maintaining your reputation and getting married. You will struggle with the effects of disease, aging, sanity, and addictions. Form Relationships Provide travellers with a distinct drink parlour, gaining legendary stories to regale and build your legend. Interact with townspeople as they populate the town, forging friendships with blacksmiths, sheriffs, and preachers, romance prospective partners, or blackmail, abduct, and murder those who threaten you. Build Build your saloon from the ground up. Expand the walls, build bordellos, opium dens, high stakes gambling rooms, and railed porches. Buy and place spittoons, tables, chairs, handcrafted bars, pianos, chandeliers, and diamond dust mirrors. Manage Thrive within a complex economy system, stockpiling booze, food, guns, and opium. Research a diverse array of drinks and foods to serve customers. Hire and manage staff from within the town populace, including barkeeps, cooks, servers, prostitutes, croupiers, pianists and bouncers. Help them reach their full potential, or fire and replace them with those more skilled. Exist Within A Town Start with a strip of land and watch as a western town builds up around you, bringing in a myriad of citizens and businesses. Hundreds Of Events Face the forces of nature, meddlesome customers, firebrand Preachers, rival outlaw gangs, and much more. At some point, you will be tested by stronger and more formidable nemesis in longer event chains. Whatever you choose, you will face the consequences of your choices. The frontier is an unforgiving place.

Hire and manage staff from within the town populace, including barkeeps, cooks, servers, prostitutes, croupiers, pianists and bouncers. Help them reach their full potential, or fire and replace them with those more skilled. Exist Within A Town Start with a strip of land and watch as a western town builds up around you, bringing in a myriad of citizens and businesses. Hundreds Of Events Face the forces of nature, meddlesome customers, firebrand Preachers, rival outlaw gangs, and much more. At some point, you will be tested by stronger and more formidable nemesis in longer event chains. Whatever you choose, you will face the consequences of your choices. The frontier is an unforgiving place.

rows.name: Pregnant
rows.short_description: In this first-person horror experience you will solve puzzles while navigating the pitch black Reed forest. Armed with only your flashlight you are at the mercy of the forests inhabitants, with limited time to find your way before they find you and end your adventure.
rows.description_html: Venture into the dark woods surrounding Reed Mental Hospital, and find out what really happened there ten years ago when it suddenly closed down. Who is Martha? What does she want? In Pregnant you play as Gretchen, a young amateur detective invited out into the middle of the forest to participate in a dangerous game. Following the instructions of a stranger named Martha, you solve puzzles leading you through the Reed forest with limited time before it's dangerous inhabitants find you. Horror : First-person story driven horror adventure Puzzles : Solve the puzzles to uncover the truth Quick Thinking : Keep an eye on the timer, if it runs out you are in big trouble Exploration : Explore the Reed forest to find your way into Reed Mental Hospital

Enjoy playing chaotic matches in different game-modes such as: - Capture the points - Team-Deathmatch - Infinite Threat - Free For All - Rounds With the help of machinery to heal up, block shots, cause damage, or even to jump higher! rows.name: Penelope's Odyssey
rows.short_description: Penelope's Odyssey is an adventure-platfomer game where you play as Penelope, an orphaned pet rat. Use your unique sense of smell to navigate the maze of a post apocalyptic city, collect memories of your owner and eventually escape to freedom.
rows.description_html: Introducing Penelope's Odyssey! Play as Penelope, an abandoned pet rat, who uses her unique sense of smell to navigate the pitfalls of a post apocalyptic city. Sniff, jump, climb, and sprint your way to freedom, while collecting the memories of your owner. Follow your nose to escape the city and continue the search for your owner. Don't forget to look for food along your way, as the more you move, the more your hunger grows! So come and join an optimistic Penelope as her unique perspective transforms the human apocalypse into a rat’s greatest adventure. Features: Rat Abilities: Use Penelope’s enhanced smell, jumping, climbing, and tight-roping to explore a multi-level environment. Unique Exploration: See the world through her eyes and learn how to use her perspective to solve problems. Treasure Hunting: One man's trash is another rat’s treasure. Collect the memories your owner has left behind to find your way to freedom. The Basics: Genre: 3D single-player adventure-platformer Audience: Fun for people of all ages, who are fans of adventure and story-telling Platform: Built for PC Penelope’s Odyssey: A reminder that even when it feels like the world is ending, there is hope to be found, if only we look for it.

rows.name: I Told You So!
rows.short_description: A dubiously-canon Heart of the Woods spinoff, focusing on Tara's webshow.
rows.description_html: This is a short, comedic visual novel spinoff to 'Heart of the Woods.' Contains spoilers for the base game, so please play the original game first! 'I Told You So!' is the name of Tara Bryck's paranormal investigation webshow, after renaming her hit series 'Taranormal.' Join Tara and her co-host/girlfriend, Morgan Fischer, as they unravel the mysteries of the supernatural. ITYS consists of several short, dubiously-canon episodes, with more added every now and then. Many episodes are fully voiced by the original voice cast. Look. I get it. It's hard to accept the truth of the paranormal nature of the world, especially when it's been right under your nose for years. What a fool I am , you think. How could I have doubted her, when week after week she would present such irrefutable evidence of the existence the strange and the occult? Well, I'm here to tell you that you should ABSOLUTELY feel this way, because I TOLD YOU SO! That's right! It's Tara here, the world's first ACTUAL! PROVEN! PARANORMAL INVESTIGATOR! WHO FOUND REAL THINGS! AND GOT IT ALL ON TAPE! Things are gonna change around here. I got big plans, and I can't do them alone, and I'm sure you've already seen my kick-ass new logo so you know there's a new face here on the set of the webshow that changed the world. Watch out!!!! IT'S GONNA BE SO COOL!!!!!!! Features 4 bite-sized linear stories featuring the characters from Heart of the Woods across 4000 words Adorable renditions of the characters with art by Theo Full English voice acting for the first four episodes Remixes of your favorite tunes from the original game Four really, really gay women Cast Maddie Raines - Allie Goodell Abigail - Heidi Tabing Tara Bryck - Stephanie 'Teffi' Arata Morgan Fischer - Kira Buckland

rows.name: The Glade
rows.short_description: The Glade is a beautiful open world survival set on a stylized island which has been struck all over from large and mysterious meteorites creating a bridge for evil creatures from another world to enter and destroy anything in their path.
rows.description_html: The Glade is a beautiful open world survival set on a stylized island but be warned the island is not as it seems. loot, scavenge, build a base and fight of evil creatures to stay alive in this world. OPEN WORLD * Explore a beautiful open world set on 2 large picturesque Islands. BUILD A HOME * Build a place to come home to after a long day of looting and slaying evil. CRAFTING * Craft tools, weapons and Resources to survive, gather and fight. LOOTING *Enter abandoned buildings and scavenge through the old world to find items of use. FULL CHARACTER NEED SYSTEM * Tend to your characters needs. (Hunger, Thirst and stamina). HUNTING *Hunt animals to harvest meat to survive. DYNAMIC DAY AND NIGHT CYCLE *Enjoy a full dynamic day and night cycle. TRADING * Visit merchants on the islands to buy valuable resources.

rows.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: SimRail - The Railway Simulator Prologue presents the full range of possibilities of the newest and best simulator of the work of train driver. Take on the challenge and take the controls of a freight or passenger train!
rows.description_html: SimRail Early Access available now About the Game SimRail - The Railway Simulator Prologue... presents the full range of possibilities of the newest and best simulator of the work of train driver. Take on the challenge and take the controls of a freight or passenger train! Become the Driver... of the E186 locomotive carrying coal wagons and overcome all difficulties - a heavy train and numerous hills will test your skills! Do you prefer passenger trains? No problem! Lead the EN96 unit on one of the most important railway lines in Poland and deliver all passengers on time! The world's best representation of driving physics and fantastic graphics... will make you feel like a real train driver! You don't know how to drive the train? The tutorial will make you the best in this profession. new Mission... In the prologue, we have prepared two scenarios for you. The first one is identical to the one we presented in the demo. We will run the EN96 passenger train on the section Dąbrowa Górnicza Ząbkowice - Będzin. Stop at all stations and get passengers safely and on time. The second scenario is a real treat for fans of industrial climates. You have the E186 locomotive at your disposal, with 20 coal wagons attached to it. Overcome the difficulties of the goods lines in Silesia and admire the beautiful views - numerous mines and plants, but also a lot of greenery. Hurry up, the power plant is waiting for this coal!

rows.name: Lemon vs. Teddy
rows.short_description: Become a lemon and destroy the world with sausages before Teddy does it in this combat-focused RPG.
rows.description_html: It's your chance to destroy the world. All you need is to find two sausages and a magic gem. However, Teddy, a criminal known for the annihilation of over a million people, also wants them. Are you brave enough to defeat him and completely destroy the entire world? Key Features: Turn-based combat reminiscent of retro jRPGs Fight Biscuits , Glasses of water , Bananas and many more nasty enemies while thinking about the meaning of life (or anything else you want) Random encounters that are easy to avoid - just hold down SHIFT if you don't feel like fighting Sticker system that allows you to customize your characters Optional bosses that only the best players will be able to defeat Crazy abilities such as Deadline , Floppy disk chaos and the legendary Curse of Jxkfdvc Auto-save - forget about save points A convenient quick-heal menu accessible by pressing Q Modifiable EXP and BTC multipliers for players who aren't fond of grinding 100% free!

rows.name: World Tree
rows.short_description: A unique puzzle adventure where world peace has been achieved on Earth and it is up to you to discover the secrets of humanity and initiate open contact with the friendly races of the cosmic spheres.
rows.description_html: Open-World Puzzle Adventure You are a human in a future Earth timeline, where world peace has been achieved on Earth. While open contact has been made with the hidden peaceful humanoid civilizations of the Earth, and the cosmic spheres, there are still mysteries yet for you to unlock. What is the secret of humanity, that is held deep within the humble dwelling of the World Tree? --- Explore, Interact, Level up, Play Solve various puzzles and riddles Build up your Chi to unlock new areas Use techniques to acquire even MORE Chi Trade crystals for items and craft potions to acquire still more Chi!! Explore areas such as the Mothership, Hybrid Crystalline City, The Grey's Underground Tunnels, and the Orion Citadel Communicate with the friendly Sasquatch, fae, elven, and extraterrestrial people Uncover the mystical secrets of humanity, and embrace the mystery of the World Tree.

rows.name: Sensorium Galaxy
rows.short_description: Sensorium Galaxy invites you to experience the uncharted realms of PRISM. Immerse yourself in a revolutionary 30-minute set featuring tracks written, crafted and produced exclusively by Carl Cox for ‘Intermundium,’ his debut virtual show.
rows.description_html: Sensorium Galaxy is an advanced metaverse composed of interconnected virtual worlds. It is currently the only global, multi-user virtual reality platform focusing on immersive experiences centered around art and cutting-edge musical performances. Venture into the pulsating heart of Sensorium Galaxy, PRISM, where Carl Cox takes on a hyper-realistic avatar form, performing on a levitating, transformative stage of this anomaly ever-evolving virtual location. Alongside music fans from every corner of the globe, you’ll dive into the fusion of electronic beats and cutting-edge visuals that are set to redefine virtual events. Advanced technologies like VR, AI, Unreal Engine 5, and motion capture, combined with Sensorium’s unique innovations, have been seamlessly blended to create the ultimate digital incarnation of Carl, delivering the most technologically advanced and visually charged show of our time. Become part of the Sensorium Galaxy early adopter community and share your feedback to guide the development as we aim to improve. Sensorium Galaxy is a cross-platform application available in PC and PCVR modes. Features: FIRST LOOK: next-generation Social VR Experience in the making. ENTER PRISM: explore the hyper-futuristic atmosphere of the electronic music world — the first in the Sensorium Galaxy metaverse. СARL COX’S VIRTUAL DEBUT: witness Carl’s avatar transforming PRISM with his pulsating tech-house rhythms. From volcanic eruptions to colossal extraterrestrial concert structures, every beat brings this realm into a harmonically consonant movement. FASHION FOR THE METAVERSE AGE: unique line of avatars with looks to rule the dancefloor. CHOOSE YOUR STYLE: pick the look from the preset avatar skins. More customization options are coming soon. FEEL THE CONNECTION: full body avatar system makes sure your movements appear natural and enables lipsync when you speak. MEET VIRTUAL BEINGS: strike up a conversation with AI-driven companions. VR CONTROLS REDEFINED: experience VR movement in a new immersive way.

rows.name: Asteroids Extreme
rows.short_description: Asteroids Extreme is a fast-paced, top-down, arcade-style asteroid mining adventure. Players blast asteroids and various enemies, collecting crystals along the way to upgrade their ship.
rows.description_html: Asteroids Extreme Head off into the asteroid field to seek your fortune! The asteroid field is full of quantum crystals for those foolish enough to brave the dangers of space. Risk and reward is the name of the game when it comes to crystal mining. Tensions rise as the asteroid field becomes more dense and alien rivals begin to take notice of your unwelcome presence. Miners must work quickly to avoid attracting the attention of the more fearsome deep space inhabitants.

rows.name: Albert and Camille's Little Lille Adventure
rows.short_description: Explore a war-torn city, avoid capture by soldiers, and collect the supplies Albert and Camille need to create the first vaccine to fight tuberculosis. As you progress, you will learn about the methods used to create BCG and how vaccines work.
rows.description_html: Albert and Camille’s Little Lille Adventure is an exploration game in which you navigate characters around the city of Little Lille in 1917. Players take the part of or heroes Albert Calmette and Camille Guérin and help them develop the life-saving BCG Vaccine. It is a simple, 2d top-down adventure, exploration, and problem-solving game similar to classics such as Zelda. There are also elements of stealth as you avoid the guards like in the original run of Metal Gear. There is also a mini-game where you culture bacteria. This is a casual educational game and should only last around 10 minutes to play through. Explore the city, work with the people of Little Lille, avoid the soldiers, and collect the necessary supplies Albert and Camille need to create the first vaccine to fight tuberculosis. As you progress, you will learn about the methods used to create BCG and how vaccines work. Who are the games for?: The game is totally free and can be played or downloaded by anyone with an internet connection. They are specifically targeted at 11 - 14 years old students and designed as a tool for teachers, researchers, and parents looking for a fun way to engage young people with the topics of immunology, vaccines and the history of science. You can play the game in six languages - English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese.

rows.name: Beyond dreams
rows.short_description: Here is the work of a UE4 individual independent game developer. In this pixel game with simple plot, you will face 21 carefully designed bosses (two of them are plot characters), 16 magical treasures, difficult battles and challenge modes that bring new experience!!!
rows.description_html: Challenge mode, after clearance, click on the gold coin next to the title to enter This is the game of a UE4 individual independent game developer from China. In this pixel game with simple plot, you will face 21 carefully designed bosses (two of them are plot characters), 16 magical treasures, difficult battles and challenge modes that bring new experience!!! Boss Challenge In addition to the plot, the other 19 bosses have their own characteristics. Most of them have changeable skill groups and will not be released in a certain order. Moreover, the bosses have many mechanisms, such as Legion summoning, transformation, extremely fast moves, blood returning, blinking and so on. treasure Each time the protagonist defeats a lower Lord, he can obtain a magical treasure. Each treasure has special attributes and its own active skills. Although he can only equip three pieces at the same time, it can still help the player better pass the customs. Game mechanism It adopts the physical limitations of soul games and rare supplies. Players need to skillfully use jumping, tumbling and treasure skills to avoid death. Challenge mode After customs clearance, you will unlock the very fun challenge mode. In this mode, you will unlock the other two supporting roles, one is the bloodthirsty female god of war, and the other is the king of bad words proficient in calling. They will bring you a new game experience after customs clearance!!! About me and the game Most of the art and music audio materials in the game come from paid commercial materials purchased from the material website, and some free commercial materials from these platforms. I thank these authors very much. Players will see their list after customs clearance. This game really took me a lot of time and effort. In addition to most art music, it was completely completed by me. I really hope you can like him. Of course, you are very welcome to point out his shortcomings in your comments.

rows.name: Coal Mining Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Welcome to the world of Coal Mining! Start with almost nothing and get to the top - develop your mine, sell coal, buy new machines and avoid dangers in this sandbox simulator. Take control of numerous mining machines. Destroy, mine, drill, transport and blow things up.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of Coal Mining! Start with almost nothing and get to the top - develop your mine, sell coal, buy new machines and avoid dangers in this sandbox simulator. Coal Mining Simulator is a sandbox experience in which it's up to you to create new tunnels and pathways. Make your mine truly yours, as you go deeper and deeper in order to mine more coal. Take control of numerous mining machines. Destroy, mine, drill, transport and blow things up - just remember to follow safety protocols and regularly maintain your equipment. Nothing works forever - if something gets broken, it's up to you to repair it. There is no end goal in Coal Mining Simulator - you can take contracts and complete special assignments to get unique rewards or just follow your own path. The choice is yours! Mining is a dangerous job. Avoid earthquakes or gas explosions and be prepared for anything - whatever you buy, you can very easily lose if you are not careful! You think it's enough? Wrong! Because you can also: -Exchange resources -Manage your heavy equipment and expand your kingdom for more resources -Be a master of micro and macro management in your coal kingdom -Be the biggest and fastest coal supplier in you region And many more!

rows.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea
rows.short_description: A runaway rich kid and a pickpocketing vagabond work together to solve a decade old unsolved vampire attack.
rows.description_html: Play the sequel Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon! Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea now has a sequel! Play the demo on Steam by searching for  Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon . About the Game At the turn of the century, Victorian life carries on with one sharp difference from our world- vampires run amok and are a part of every day life. After having run away from home to search for his best friend, the young Cecil meets Nemo, a pickpocketing vagabond. The two set out together but in order to find what they're searching for, they must first unravel the truth behind a series of brutal vampire attacks from a decade prior. Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea is a Victorian-esque character drama visual novel revolving around 4 characters who become entangled in solving an unsolved massacre by a vampire. Features: A short and intriguing linear character drama set in Victorian times Swapping perspectives between two main characters over 30 chapters Custom watercolor-inspired graphics

rows.name: Galaxity : Korea VR
rows.short_description: Galaxity Korea created avatars based on major regions of Korea. It is a special playground where you can communicate with people from all over the world and play mini games. Do you want to meet new friends and play various games? We invite you to Galaxity Korea.
rows.description_html: You can also access it through Galaxity : Korea AR. Have a fascinating experience where VR users and Mobile users meet in one space! Let's start the Galaxity journey with the only avatar that I can decorate however I want! The avatar that expresses me is created with various products in the store. From the face to the outfit, it's filled with my taste. I meet my friends from all over the world with my own avatar. Arrived from a new place to a new look, this place will probably be our own world! meeting Seoul With Galaxity Shall We Go On A Trip to Major Areas Of Seoul? From Myeong-dong to Gwangjang Market, Gyeongbokgung Palace, N Seoul Tower, and Cheonggyecheon Stream! Friends from all over the world who meet at new destinations are full of welcome excitement from the meeting! At a playground called Galaxity : Korea, where we meet for the first time, Let's all have an exciting and happy time together. Mini games to enjoy at attractions in Seoul. Shall we enjoy various mini-games prepared by Galaxity : Korea? [Tycon] Get orders from customers at a snack bar set up in the plaza market and quickly prepare food. The only thing to solve the increasing number of orders as the game progresses is speed! [Rhythm] In Cheonggyecheon Stream, you can break the flying block as if you were doing Taekwondo to exciting music. The blocks that get faster and faster when accurate movements and my sense of rhythm are combined, too! There is no problem. [FPS] Shall we become warriors protecting Gyeongbokgung Palace? Save Gyeongbokgung Palace, which is in danger from zombies' attacks. You can defeat zombies running with double pistols and prepared secret weapons in both hands. The more dangerous zombies play the game, the more dangerous zombies will threaten Gyeongbokgung Palace, so don't let your guard down! [Arcade] At Seoul Tower, find a magpie narrowly located on a high-altitude pipe. If you take each step carefully and safely go to the magpie's nest, you succeed! The obstacles installed here and there make the road to the nest more thrilling and exciting. Can we safely save magpies beyond obstacles without falling off the pipe? When you enjoy the mini-games held at the landmark of Seoul, Korea is already in your hands! New friends from Myeong-dong, the center of Seoul. Shall we make new friends in a new space? Meet various friends while talking together and having an exciting time in the square called Myeong-dong. Did you meet your soulmate? Then, let's be a friend with him or her and leave on the journey of Galaxity : Korea together. If we're together, we also have double pleasure! If we communicate and enjoy with so many friends from all over the world, Myeong-dong will soon become our own playground. Make memories with your friends at Seoul in Galaxity : Korea and be hooked on mini-games. Then, we and Seoul will get closer! Seoul become amusement park open to everyone. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A NEW SPOT, JEJU ISLAND, has been added to Galaxity : Korea! 'Ramsar wetland protected area, Dongbaek dongsan in Jeju Island' You can visit Seoul and Jeju Island at any time you want on the World Map of Galaxity : Korea. Here, you can easily hear the explanation and story of the Dongbaek dongsan Wetland Center through text and voice. And also if you move to Meonmulkkak, the representative wetland of Dongbaek dongsan, you can hear the explanation while looking at the Meonmulkkak in front of you. Enjoy the green and beautiful scenery and get some rest of your mind in nature. Items that can only be purchased at stores in Dongbaek dongsan in Jeju Island can't be overlooked! You can decorate your avatar by choosing items that go well with exploring Meonmulkkak wetlands or taking a walk in the wetland center. Now, In Jeju Island, take a leisurely walk around the Dongbaek dongsan and the Meonmulkkak and make wonderful memories with your friends from all over the world!

rows.name: Solaris Rift
rows.short_description: Solaris Rift is a roguelike card game featuring variable encounters, sci-fi narrative, and strategic gameplay. Face off against the terrifying storm drones of the Satex Army, the saboteurs of the gang known as the RogueStars, and the venomous vinelings of the Queen of Thorns.
rows.description_html: Deep in the darkest rim of Solaris Rift, humanity has colonized the alien worlds belonging to the darker forces of the system. The beings that were conquered have risen up and begun to launch their assault on the human race. Humanity is in shambles as the system has swallowed their home world and led them to nomadic colonies on numerous worlds of the Rift. Reclaim your home from the Queen of the Everlasting Brambles and her legion. Solaris Rift is a roguelike card game featuring variable encounters, sci-fi narrative, and strategic gameplay. Face off against the terrifying storm drones of the Satex Army, the saboteurs of the gang known as the RogueStars, and the venomous vinelings of the Queen of Thorns. Embark on a journey to save the galaxy from the forces against it. Over 50 unique cards More than 12 card mechanics 3 encounters, including a boss fight Multiple player/enemy decks per encounter This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Adventure of Leek
rows.short_description: Equipped with nothing but water balloons, you must help a young child named Leek on an uber-challenging journey home!
rows.description_html: Mysterious things are happening in the small town of Milk Meadows... It seems that lately many snails and worms have gone missing, and many people are seeing a strange figure in the woods... Equipped with nothing but water balloons, you must help a young child named Leek on an uber-challenging journey home, after being abducted by a strange lifeform from outer-space! Adventure of Leek is a challenging platformer featuring... Speedrunning! Boss Fights! WORM CAVES Snails! Coins to Collect!

rows.name: Follow the Black Kitten
rows.short_description: You buy a laptop with your hands. You find an interactive collection of short stories on your laptop and something else. Or someone? What will all this lead to?
rows.description_html: You buy a laptop on the local flea market. You find an interactive collection of short stories on your laptop and something else. Or someone? What will all this lead to? You'll find out by playing this visual novel. Several stories inside, unrelated to the main storyline; Workshop and your own story loader; A short visual novel with an interesting plot; Pixel-style graphics, complemented by authentic sound when outputting text (optional); The text is written in such a way that it can be read equally both on behalf of the girl and on behalf of the guy; A Rock-Paper-Scissors mini-game with animated characters.

rows.name: Barn Finders VR: The Pilot
rows.short_description: Put on your VR and discover a whole new Barn Finders’ experience with free Pilot! Feel how is it like to work alongside Uncle Billy…if you dare!
rows.description_html: Howdy, folks! Take a free ride and test Barn Finders VR for the best price there is - FREE! Uncle Billy had discovered VR, that’s right. Then we had no other choice than to obey him (and it was NOT because of him standing over our shoulders with an open-end wrench) and do Barn Finders in VR. So, here we go, let’s have a fun ride with our beloved Uncle and his wicked team! Now you can truly feel the whole Barn Finders atmosphere and dive into it with all of your senses. Well, maybe except smell, but that’s a good thing. Disclaimer: Don’t let him got you into the moonshine business. It does not work well with VR. FEATURES: Hundreds of items to find and sell Improve the quality of goods for sale by cleaning and repairing damaged ones as needed Find parts of exclusive cars, motorbikes, rebuild them and then sell for a big payout. Discover crazy stories of the locations you visit and items you collect.

rows.name: Space Beastz
rows.short_description: Space Beastz is a cooperative multiplayer music and rhythm game. On a music-playing spaceship, players must time their actions just right to keep multiple instruments running and make the most amazing music the galaxy has ever heard!
rows.description_html: Space Beastz is a cooperative multiplayer music and rhythm game. On a music-playing spaceship, players must time their actions just right to keep multiple instruments running and make the most amazing music the galaxy has ever heard! About This Game: In Space Beastz, a player joins the crew of David, an intergalactic music composer on a mission to bring the gift of life-changing music to the galaxy. The spaceship has a collection of out-of-this-world instruments built-in, but they are prone to breaking down at just the wrong moment. They need human players to keep the beats flowing. A player can attempt the challenge alone or enlist the help of up to three friends in local or online multiplayer modes. The more players get in on the action, the more instruments will malfunction, and frantic action will ensue as players race from one station to the next, trying not to miss a beat! Each world the players play for has unique problems and preferred music style, and the difficulty ratchets up as the team plays gigs for increasingly powerful planetary rulers. If they succeed in pleasing the hardest of all audiences, they may be able to bring peace to a troubled galaxy. A fun-filled way to experience the Bible, Space Beastz shares the story of David and how the music he played had a positive impact on the world around him. Main features: Frenetic multiplayer fun, great for parties. Epic music with a retro 80s digital vibe. Each song is a brand-new creation from several unique and talented composers. Difficulty levels are set individually by each player, from casual to Beast Mode, so players of all skill levels can have fun playing together. High replayability: Every song can be replayed in the quest for a new top score. Family-friendly story, so even small children can join the fun. Completely free, with no ads or other monetization to spoil your peaceful intergalactic vibes.

rows.name: Letters From the Moon
rows.short_description: In this sci-fi pick your own story game, you must help astronaut Dorothy Chen survive in a vast underground alien city beneath the moon's surface. She faces insane robots, mutant canines, starvation, and insanity inside the city of the Anthria. Whether she survives is up to YOU.
rows.description_html: Dorothy Chen is the first Chinese-American woman on the moon, but she has a problem: her mission crash landed there. With rescue days away, Dorothy searches for a way to survive and finds a vast underground alien city. The aliens have died log ago, but she finds an educational simulation in the form of a holographic cat, Jiqi, to help her navigate the strange city with all of its dangers. She faces insane robots, mutant canines, starvation, and insanity inside the city of the Anthria. Whether she survives is up to YOU in this pick your own story adventure with over 30 different endings. This game is an interactive book with additional features such as inventory and achievements.

rows.name: Snake Force
rows.short_description: Snake Force is an alternative top-down shooting game inspired by the classic game Snake. In this game, you’ll rescue your bros and fight along side with them. You and your bros will stand in a line, and shoot at the same point. Keep the shape of your squad, because bullets hurt whatever they hit.
rows.description_html: “Friendly Fire!“ Snake Force is an alternative top-down shooting game inspired by the classic game Snake. In this game, you’ll rescue your bros and fight along side with them. You and your bros will stand in a line, and shoot at the same point. Keep the shape of your squad, because bullets hurt whatever they hit. The game includes 5 levels, and a secret mode. The total playing time will be 30~45 minutes. If the game feels too hard for you, you may try using the Shift key. It could still be fun! Words by the developers This game was originally a personal project made for LudumDare40, finished under 48 hours. Recently we happened to have this motivation to refine this work for fun. There isn’t much content in this game. We will probably add more stuff someday when we want to. Hopefully you will enjoy it!

rows.name: Tep The Destroyer TD
rows.short_description: TEP the destroyer is a single player tower defense game where you will face alien monsters and ships in ground and space battles! Your strategy will decide the fate of your people in a sci-fi environment of varying difficulties!
rows.description_html: TEP the destroyer is a single player tower defense game where you will face over 50 unique alien monsters of increasing difficulty. Strategically place 8 types of turrets to ensure the maximum damage to your foes. 5 different armor types. 5 different damage types. Weapon effectiveness is greatly influenced by the type of enemy you are fighting. Complete the main quest line for the ultimate challenge! Infinite waves, excessive power ups, and no hope. How long can you survive before the alien horde will destroy you? An alien horde has overrun all of your peoples defenses. In desperation, the Destroyers have been activated to try and stop the alien horde and save mankind. The destroyers, a small group of ruthless, AI combat commanders that have long been forgotten. Once hailed as hero's for decimating the militaries of the world and bringing lasting peace. Ultimately, the destroyers were considered too dangerous and were placed in permanent isolation and forgotten. Take control as TEP, the strongest of the ancient AI battle commanders. After 500 years of isolation you emerge into a world of total devastation and an overwhelming alien force laying waste to everything around you. Search for new and more powerful weapons. Defend the last survivors of humanity and then track down the aliens to their origin point. Ensure complete extinction of the threat.

rows.name: Haunted House Escape: A VR Experience
rows.short_description: Enter, if you dare...Haunted House Escape - A VR Experience: A chilling mini escape adventure leading through an abandoned house. Highly realistic, immersive graphics and sounds. Be aware, you might not be the only one there.
rows.description_html: You wake up in an empty, abandoned house, all alone. How did you get here? It's stormy outside. You hear the wind creaking through the old wooden boards of the house. Why is 'Let me Out' written all over the walls? What was that noise?! Maybe you are not the only one in the house... In this virtual reality escape mini-game, the player has to find the hidden keys to escape the haunted house. The experience is available for all VR headsets. Physical actors were placed in the virtual environment, using extended reality (xR) technology. Listen to the rain tapping on the windows and immerse yourself in this realistic environment.

rows.description_html: Casual Pixel Warrior Survive the waves! Buy weapons and ammo! Unlock new stages! Purchase companions! Solve daily quests and get rewards! Casual Pixel Warrior is a wave shooter where your endurance to last an infinite fight depends on your skill, unlocked weapons and purchased ammo. This game is a casual game where you can fight endless waves of various enemies on different stages. This allows you to earn coins - and sometimes gems - to purchase items in your home base in return. Get new weapons, unlock new stages, buy ammo and even pets. You can do daily quests in order to get useful rewards to earn coins even faster. Each new day you will be rewarded free items that are selected randomly for a day. You can select from three different free items which will then be rewarded to you upon selection. And if you feel lonely in your home base, you should really buy some pets! Not only are they cute and cuddly (check for a red heart), but they will also poop fortune! Just clean their poop and you will get coins in return. But don't forget to feed your pets or they will not be amused! 5 different worlds with different themes 14 different enemies - alients, military and monsters 7 different weapons - each with varying advantages 4 different pets to comfort you Match-end statistics to show your progress Daily rewards and quests Seasonal and dynamical quests Various different Steam Achievements Greenland : A green and prospering world occupied by a military force Snowland : A breezing everlasting winter inhabited by strange monsters Wasteland : A dry desert populated by a futuristic military empire Lavaland : A really unfriendly place occupied by hostile alien forces Waterland : A moist and underwaterish place occupied by nautical aliens Handgun : A basic gun that you already own Laser rifle : Fires laser bullets and is very effective Shotgun : If you need to shoot into an approaching squad Flame thrower : Causes strong damage, but can be hard to handle Plasma gun : A very strong weapon to clean an area Rocket launcher : One of the strongest weapons, but need to be mastered Grenade : Can be thrown while any other gun is selected Dog : A good boi that loves apples Cat : A furry kitten that likes pears Fox : A kitsune that has a soft spot for oranges Goat : Give it strawberries and happiness is ensured

rows.name: NewHrdGame
rows.short_description: An ancient Chinese folk puzzle game
rows.description_html: During the Three Kingdoms period of the later Han Dynasty, 'ZHUGE Liang calculated Huarong wisely and Guan Yunchang released Cao Cao'. This is the origin of the game [/] Huarongdao is an ancient Chinese folk puzzle game. With its changeable and never tired of playing, it is called 'three incredible in the field of intelligence games' by foreign intelligence experts together with magic cube and independent diamond chess. It is synonymous with traditional Chinese educational toys such as Tangram and Puzzle ring, and is called 'China's problem'. Basic gameplay [/] By moving each slider, help Cao Cao move the lowest middle of the layout panel from the initial position and escape from the exit. It is not allowed to cross the slider, and try to move Cao Cao to the exit with the least number of steps. The biggest obstacle for Cao Cao to escape from Huarong Road is Guan Yu. Guan Yu immediately went to Huarong Road with a horizontal knife. One man is in charge of the pass, and ten thousand men can't open it. Guan Yu and Cao Cao are, of course, the key to unlocking this game. The five tiger generals are the most difficult to deal with. The four soldiers are the most flexible and easy to deal with. How to play their role should also be fully considered. Diverse play [/] First, OneVsOne There are three kinds of difficulty in one-on-one layout: general, difficult and hell; The difficulty determines the difficulty of solving the layout. The difficulty can be set when opening a room, and also the game limit time; In wartime, both sides worked out the layout of the same set, and the party who released 'Cao Cao' first won within the specified game time; Each battle will consume energy points. After winning, you can obtain experience points, which can be used to improve the player's level; In the battle, you can consume flying props to guide and crack the layout. Second, TeamFight This play is divided into two teams, each team has at least two people and at most four people; There are three kinds of game difficulty: general, difficult and hell; The difficulty determines the difficulty of solving the layout. Create room can set difficulty, game limit time , teammate number; At the beginning of TeamFight, each team member is assigned a layout according to the difficulty of the game. Within the specified time, the team with all the team members solving the layout will win; In TeamFight, you can ask for help from your teammates who have finished; At the beginning of the TeamFight, the team members will consume energy. After the team wins, the team members can obtain experience value, which can be used to improve the player level; In TeamFight, you can consume flying props to guide and crack the layout, and you can use flying props to assist teammates to crack the layout. Third, KeepGoing In the team breakthrough mode, you need to consume one MangToken prop to open it once; The minimum number of team members is one, maximum is three; First, you need to create a team. When you create a team, specify the number of team members and the minimum level of teammates; When the team is full, you can go out and enter the breakthrough room. There are five levels in total. At the beginning of each level, click the turntable to randomly draw the layout set, and then the team members start to crack the layout. When different layout sets have different level limits, you can solve all the drawing layout maps within the specified time to pass this level; After successfully breaking through the customs, you can choose to continue to break through the customs, or you can stop here and get rich victory prizes; If you fail in any level, you will not get a prize; Flying props cannot be used in the breakthrough mode. Game features [/] Novel multiplayer game. Exquisite layout of Huarong Road. The pleasure of player level improvement. Upload your avatar freely. Exquisite and diverse head frame. Rich game peripherals [/] Task system: daily task, weekly task, monthly task, counting task and permanent task; After completing the task item, you can get the corresponding task reward. Mail system: inbox, outbox; Send and receive e-mail, contact the network management and send e-mail to the network management. Leaderboard system: player level ranking, player wealth ranking, ovo ranking, TVT ranking, Eve ranking. Store: the sale of various props. Record: query the player's personal game record. Chat system: it can chat in the room, in the hall and in the carrier pigeon service. Avatar system: replace the exquisite avatar frame, and upload your avatar freely in the album. Upgrade system: if the upgrade conditions meet the standard, you can madly improve the player level.

rows.name: Scriptur
rows.short_description: Scriptur is a kinetic visual novel featuring original artworks, soundtrack, and characters. You woke up on the train, knowing not how you ended up in it and where it was going. What is the secret behind all this? Will it be possible to reveal it and restore the memories of what happened?
rows.description_html: Scriptur is a kinetic visual novel featuring original artworks, soundtrack, and characters. The main character woke up on the train, he does not know how he ended up in it and where he was going. On top of that, he has the same strange dream all the time. What does this all mean? What is the secret behind all this? Will it be possible to reveal it and finally restore the lost memories of what happened? Visual novels are a genre of video games that leans heavily on plot and literature contents, which most resemble that of a book. The kinetic novels are a sub-genre that defines visual novels with little to no choice of the characters' actions, leading to a single-optioned, linear story with a strong narrative direction. Typically, kinetic novels are known to trade variability and replayability values for a stronger and/or more emotional delivery of the plot, following the directorial idea more precisely, although the absence of that is not always the case with the multi-routed player's choice-based type visual novels. The main gameplay loop of visual novels usually involves the implementation of user controls to ensure the conduction of the player's ability to express their will to continue with the story by clicking or tapping the free space on the game screen and reading the appeared lines of dialogues or author's descriptions. Simultaneously, the game screen may change accordingly with the progression of the plot: background images change, character sprites take turns going out on the stage, the music suits the needs of the moment. It is not only suitable but also useful to subtract the conventions of the experience and see this kind of media for its origins — theatrical plays — to esteem the possibilities of digital realms in storytelling.

rows.name: Crown Delights Deli
rows.short_description: Crown Delights Deli is a visual novel with multiple dialect/language choices. As the cashier at a Brooklyn bodega, choose to talk in English, AAVE, or Spanish to a diverse cast of characters as you try to maintain a five-star rating for your boss.
rows.description_html: A note from the developers: Hey there, player! Crown Delights Deli was developed as a BFA thesis game at the NYU Game Center. Each of us on the team are college graduates who were fortunate enough to receive funding to continue development after graduation in 2021. We were all determined to create an experience that authentically represents Brooklyn, as well as the experience of code-switching. We hope that playing our game helps shed new light on how code-switching may impact your life or the lives of those around you. Thank you! - Team baconeggandcheese About the Game Crown Delights Deli is a visual novel with multiple dialect/language choices. As the cashier at a Brooklyn bodega, choose to talk in English, AAVE, or Spanish to a diverse cast of characters as you try to maintain a five-star rating for your boss. Code-switch with your bodega customers by selecting choices from three languages/dialects, subtly impacting how they interact with you. Talk in Spanish to the Hipster who is trying to practice their Spanish or chat with your classmate Gian in African American Vernacular English (AAVE). Features Authentic Brooklyn experience Subtle but impactful choices through code-switching 10 diverse characters from Brooklyn to interact with Cute and colorful art Delightful and original soundtrack

rows.name: Vertical Shift
rows.short_description: Vertical Shift is a new kind of VR E-Sport. Fly through the city and arenas equipped with your Zenith Suit, an advanced movement system. Your Zenith Suit is equipped with Grapple Hooks, Jet Packs, and Gliders, giving you ultimate control over your flight. Challenge your skills with PvP and PvE.
rows.description_html: Take to the Skies in VERTICAL SHIFT A VR Esport unlike any other. Fly through the arenas equipped with your Zenith Suit, an advanced movement system. Your Zenith Suit is equipped with Grapple Hooks, Jet Packs, and Gliders, giving you ultimate control over your flight. Vertical Shift features 4 multiplayer gameplay modes. Each mode can be played with up to ten people with crossplay. Freeze Tag Team up and work together for this fast pace reimagining of everyone’s favorite playground game! In our premiere competitive mode, two teams will face off in ten-minute matches. Each player is equipped with an EMP blast, which will freeze the other team in their tracks. Keep an eye on frozen enemies, the EMP blast can also unfreeze your teammates! The first team to ten points wins! Hot Seat Players compete in a free for all to capture and hold the Hot Seat! Steal the hot seat by tagging the golden player. Keep the Hot Seat by moving quickly! The player who holds the hot seat the longest wins! Infection One player starts as infected and hunts down all other players. Every time a player is tagged, they join the infected. You can run, but you can’t hide. Race Swing through a series of obstacles and compete to be the first across the finish line! Vertical Shift also features a single-player campaign! Explore the City of Orion, a futuristic metropolis on the brink of collapse. Join the resistance and help take down the evil government through a variety of missions and activities. Or just swing around and take in the sights! See you in the Arenas!

You can expect to laugh and be surprised. Dark Humor Tactical Turn Based Combat Challenge - Two difficulty levels so that you can have a casual or strategic playthrough. Mystery - Discover the truth about your cat. Trust Building Beautiful Art and Story 2 Unlockable Gallery Images A Lot of Blood Your cat comes with 5 different abilities to slay foes with. Quotes From Play Testers: 'Game is funny, over the top, and fantastical. Wouldn't mind a sequel.' 'The humor was amazing, I was cracking up laughing throughout the entire thing.
