rows.name: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade
rows.short_description: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade is reimagining a videogame classic: Play virtual table tennis with up to 4 players in a futuristic visual style using new gameplay elements like power ups and randomly generated arenas.
rows.description_html: Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade is reimagining a videogame classic: Play virtual table tennis with up to 4 players in a futuristic visual style using new gameplay elements like power ups and randomly generated arenas. Experience a fast-paced multiplayer game in which even the arena can change from moment to moment. Will you keep cool and come out on top? Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade has been developed by an interdisciplinary team of students as a semester project within a time frame of four months. We hope you enjoy our final results! A video game classic reimagined Chances are, you know the drill: You have a paddle to guard your goal. There is a ball. You try your best to bounce that ball into your opponent's goal. But what if there are not two players, but four? Three balls instead of one? Not to mention items, arena elements – and did you know that the arcade sometimes likes to change? More players! More items! More chaos! More fun! Up to four players Invite your friends and have fun in the chaotic arena of Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade. Supporting both multiple controllers and all-on-one-keyboard amateur wrestling, you can play it whenever you have friends around. And should your friends not be available, you can play against three different difficulties of AI opponents. Your friends do have time, but they live too far away? No need to worry, as Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade supports Steam Remote Play Together! Only you have to own the game to play with up to three friends via the internet. Chaos ensues Do you think four players in one arena is not enough chaos? So do we! That's why we added a bunch of items, both to help you and to hinder your opponents. Make the next goal count twice as much! Switch out the arena elements! Boost your paddle speed! And if that is not enough, there are the arena elements. They spawn randomly at the start of the game and might reflect your shot in a totally unexpected way. But they might also be perfect to hit your opponent from a different direction. Just be careful to keep an eye out or you will be the one who gets hit! Multiple game modes to keep things fresh You think you have mastered the game? Are you beating your friends in every match? Why not change it up by making the paddles smaller or speeding up the ball! You can have multiple balls, turn items on and off and even have the arena change at random. You can also choose between the two radically different modes of Score, where you try to get the most points before a timer runs out, and Survival, where you have a limited amount of lives. But don't worry if your friends are the ones who are always beating you: Even when you have lost all your lives, you will still be able to participate and make their lives harder with well timed items.

rows.name: AGNI
rows.short_description: AGNI is a runner game, help a mysterious cat to collect fragments through different landscapes and enjoy an endless mode for scoring!
rows.description_html: What is this world, vast and unknown? What is this mysterious cat looking for? You will explore biomes in rich and diverse landscapes, where each area offers unique visuals and music. Our worlds are randomly generated, so each adventure you make will be different and unique. Along the way, you'll come across items to pick up, and even surprises to download. The game's original music has randomized musical arrangements: each part launches a different overlay of melodic, harmonic and percussive elements. And each biome has its own arrangement, so put on your headphones and enjoy the adventure! AGNI is an easy game to play, with different difficulties for its environments for the more experienced gamers. To extend AGNI's experience, play the endless mode that unlocks in the middle of the adventure. There you will find magical items in the store to increase the fun and make the best score possible! Features: - three different environments - an infinite number of runs and music - endless mode with a store

rows.name: Pwnk: Stream Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Pwnk has a wide variety of community games to engage your live audiences and grow your stream. Create your live game show using Pwnk's mini-game battle royale! Your audiences will be able to play with you in real-time, create funny content, and even help you battle against other streamers!
rows.description_html: Engage live audiences and grow your stream with a variety of funny community games Pwnk Royale & Olympwnks are the main game mode: Create your own live game show using Pwnk's mini-game battle royale! Your audiences will be able to play with you in real-time, create funny live content together, and even help you battle against other streamers! Pwnk supports all the biggest streaming platforms: Twitch, Youtube, Facebook Gaming Also 30+ variety games with frequent updates PWNK Ball: It's like Pong but viewers can participate by pitching the ball. PWNK Rescue: Which streamer can save the most birds? PWNK Draw: Can you guess what the streamers are drawing together? Pwnk Defense: Pwnk Defense is a tug of war strategy game between 2 teams. Pwnk Snack: Can you guess which colored snack has the most area in the box? Pwnk Blitz: Can you quickly pick the correct matching item? Pwnk Doll: Can your eyes keep track of Russian Doll? Pwnk Away: Can you find who is away? Pwnk Raid: Can you raid the most coins? Pwnk Places: Can you guess where I am? Pwnk Relations: Can you guess their relationship? Pwnk Defense: Defend your team‘s base and destroy your enemies! Pwnk Life: Live your best life possible! A text-based life sim Pwnk Crossplay: Can you guess crossdressing or not? Pwnk GameWorld: Can you guess what game I'm playing based on the game map? Pwnk & Count: Can you count how many characters are remaining? Pwnk Food: Can you guess the country or territory by the food? Pwnk Products: Can you guess are these products real or not? Pwnk Man: Which viewer will become the biggest Pwnk Man? Pwnk Mandela: Can you guess the correct Logo and characters? Pwnk Loot: Can you guess the correct video game by game items or loot! Pwnk 90s: Does this belong to the 90s? Pwnk Animals: Does this animal exist? Pwnk Actor: Can you guess the movie by actor! Pwnk Who: Guess whose is it? Guess the character by the item shown in the image. Pwnk Nation: Guess the nation by the item shown in the image. and many more! Around 2-8 new games will be added to the collection each month. All games are Free and easy to play. Are you a streamer? You can play Pwnk with your viewers and with another streamer's chat. Pwnk is very community-oriented and brings people together in existing streamer's communities.

rows.name: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek
rows.short_description: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek is a dark fantasy visual novel about fulfilling your aspirations by sacrificing parts of yourself. Literally.
rows.description_html: Maria's life is falling apart: she's lost her job, her landlord wants her out, and her mother is sick. As she struggles to keep her head above water, Maria is approached by a mysterious figure who offers her an unusual deal. The stranger will fulfill any of Maria's wishes. But for each wish granted, they demand a horrifying payment: one of Maria's organs. Will the gruesome deal fix Maria's life? And at what cost? Make terrifying choices that will change the course of Maria's life Navigate Maria's broken relationships as she harbors a dark secret Explore four endings depending on what Maria decides to wish for Uncover a secret ending that changes everything Remastered version of the 2016 original with HD graphics and additional content Around 30 minutes per playthrough Blind accessible: press V to activate self-voicing mode

rows.name: The Pest
rows.short_description: Solve challenging puzzles and avoid dangerous traps of the computer defence system in this puzzle-platformer game about a tiny optimistic computer pest heading to the System's Core. Will he plunge our world into chaos, or will he have mercy? It's up to you.
rows.description_html: Johnny is a funny and friendly guy. He is curious, clever and ingenious. And also, he's a virus... Yeah, literally a computer virus, seriously. Like a dangerous computer virus meant to send the world into chaos... Do you think it can be a problem? Johnny is the unique computer virus designed to adapt to challenges he encounters. So on your way to the Core, you will need all three of Johnny's forms: Standard square form - average speed and jump height but stronger than other forms so is able to move objects Tall form - low speed and high jump height, the best to drop through narrow spaces or get to high places Flat form - high speed and low jump height, can squeeze under a low ceiling and fast enough to avoid dangers You will need to understand all three forms to help Johnny on his path. Octagon - is the headquarters of the World Security Organisation, which is responsible for order and control over the world. And now Johnny is on his way to the Core of the global security system. Just imagine what a disaster can be caused by a pest in such a system. But never mind, the system is protected with lasers, traps and unbitable puzzles, and any pest wouldn't be able to squeeze inside. They are sure of it, but with ingenuity and sleight, any system isn't impenetrable ;) So, as we accompany Johnny on his journey, maybe we should stop him? Possibly destroying the world is a bad idea? But the Programmer created Johnny with a purpose, how can 'son' go against his 'father'? Why should the world be destroyed? Oh, so many questions. I have a headache. Please, go and find your own answers in hidden parts of the system's labyrinths and help Johnny make the right decisions.

rows.name: Forest Star
rows.short_description: Help a monkey find a fallen star in this short adventure game! Meet and recruit other animals, find useful items, and discover new abilities. Multiple endings available depending on your choices!
rows.description_html: RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars' Forest Star won third place in the official RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars.' About the Game Guide a monkey across a forest to find a fallen star! Meet interesting, amusing, and occasionally hostile characters who may help or hinder you. Choose from three different companions - including an owl and a tortoise - whose unique characteristics open up new possibilities, or try going solo! Find items that you can use to replenish your health, solve your problems, or decorate your home. Gain experience and discover new abilities as you level up. See different outcomes depending on your choices, and unlock four different endings! Playtime: About 20-30 minutes. Note: This game was made for the Touch The Stars game jam (hosted by Komodo), where it won 3rd prize!

rows.name: Berry
rows.short_description: Berry is a short orthogonal 3D platformer about a tiny, blue spider. Gain new abilities, weave through projectiles, collect and purchase a variety of items, and combat various bosses in this tiny metroidvania adventure.
rows.description_html: RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars' Berry won first place in the official RPG Maker MZ Game Jam 'Touch the Stars.' About the Game Berry is a short orthogonal 3D platformer centered on delivering light bullet-hell challenges and precise projectile manipulation using its unique web-orbiting systems. Fight unique bosses and unlock new abilities in this tiny Metroidvania adventure! Welcome! Welcome! Embark on a small and crunchy adventure up Yamakuu mountain's somewhat treacherous terrain to reach an illumination brighter than any spider has ever achieved. Explore over 50 maps and combat multiple bosses while platforming, dodging, and vibing within the world of bugs. Try and consume all the flies hidden throughout the world! New Features! As the 1st place winner of the Touch the Stars game jam, Berry was already packed with tons of challenging and unique platforming mechanics; however, upon being published to Steam, Berry has been updated with new features based on user feedback! Collect hundreds of NOMI spread across the world to spend on newly added shops! Track down each of the 4 terrains’ shops, each with unique items that provide new combat, cosmetic, and utility capabilities to your tiny spider! Make use of the new shield system! Either use the shields to provide yourself with additional health or find methods to dispose and gain more NOMI! There are now a total of 20 flies hidden in the world! The more you collect, the more powerful your abilities become. Added a complete options menu and the ability to reference the game controls from the pause menu. Multiple Endings! Depending on the number of flies that are collected and consumed, the game may end with any of the 5 available endings (with a 6th true ending that requires additional conditions to be fulfilled). Will you remain a weak spider for the sake of the mindless flies? Or will you consume everything in your path and become an unstoppable force?

Track down each of the 4 terrains’ shops, each with unique items that provide new combat, cosmetic, and utility capabilities to your tiny spider! Make use of the new shield system! Either use the shields to provide yourself with additional health or find methods to dispose and gain more NOMI! There are now a total of 20 flies hidden in the world! The more you collect, the more powerful your abilities become. Added a complete options menu and the ability to reference the game controls from the pause menu. Multiple Endings! Depending on the number of flies that are collected and consumed, the game may end with any of the 5 available endings (with a 6th true ending that requires additional conditions to be fulfilled). Will you remain a weak spider for the sake of the mindless flies? Or will you consume everything in your path and become an unstoppable force?

rows.name: Lemon Run
rows.short_description: Hardest runner ever! Try and complete all 5 game modes that go from easy to impossible. (Legends have it that the creator of the game could only make it to 1500m in endless mode) Good luck!
rows.description_html: This is an Impossible runner where you can play In 5 game modes. Easy, Medium, Hard, Impossible and Endless. The goal is to get a score of 1000 for the difficulties levels and you play against your high score in the Endless level. (Legends have it that the creator of the game could only make it to 1500m in endless mode) Good luck! You can use the AWSD keys or the arrow keys and the space bar can also be used to jump. This is Lemon Tree Studio Inc.'s first mini-game and was made by Joel Diab. This is not a AAA game so you might find bugs here and there. Just know that everything was made with love and passion and this won't be my last game!

rows.name: Legend of the Phoenix
rows.short_description: Start your palace love journey
rows.description_html: Legend of the Phoenix is an Otome dress-up mobile game which focuses on ancient Chinese love stories. As the main female character, with every choice that you made at the fork road, there will be ups and downs.During your beautiful journey in the game, you will get to meet different kinds of confidants, and choose your destiny in multiple romantic relationships. At the same time, you will experience dreamlike ancient scenery, the day and night changes of the gorgeous palace scenery bring you an immersive experience. Players will also experience the fabulous traditional costumes from different countries, and players can freely design unique costumes. Game with an adorable pet orange meow, and you will not feel lonely. Other interesting and diverse game-play systems will give you the best experience. Put on the most gorgeous clothes, confess your love to him, understand each other more, and relive the love that you were expecting. rows.name: Fighting Mad Lads
rows.short_description: Fighting Mad Lads is a fast-paced party game, for two to four local players set in “Neo-City” where the rules are changing each round. It’s time to party & to fight ! Challenge your friends through 5 mini-games and become the new King of the streets (and the master of the couch).
rows.description_html: Fighting Mad Lads is a fast-paced party game, for two to four local players set in “Neo-City” where the rules are changing each round. It’s time to fight! Keep up with the fast pace and adapt yourself to the rules of each mini-game. Choose your street hero and destroy your friends in each game to become the King in the Streets. 1) Start a game with your friends. 2) When the game starts, elbow your friends. 3) In the middle of the game, stand in front of the screen to stop them from playing. 4) That’s it! You won! We promise you a 100% win but we are not responsible for the loss of friendships. Also, do not forget : No holds barred in the street. - Local Multiplayer : Play as one of the street heroes and dive into fun and dynamic couch games in free-for-all or pair up fights in 2v2 in the streets of Neo City. - Lots of mini games : 5 exciting mini-games alternating each round! You’ll have to adapt yourself constantly to the new rules. Will you manage to take the coin and put it in your bank in the arcade arena or will you take cover in area overload ? - Blow up your friends : Mixing party games and fighting, don’t forget to punch your friends and jump into the action. - Easy-to-Learn : FML is a game mixing party game and fighting mechanics but with very simple controls in a fast-paced rhythm. - Set in a cyberpunk 3D universe mixing street art and cartoon style.

rows.name: Basault VR
rows.short_description: BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite!
rows.description_html: BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite! *WARNING: do not play if you are prone to motion sickness* WAIT... WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO BE DOING? This game is a roguelite. Your goal is to survive a series of hand designed arenas against tough ennemies with your mobility and weaponry and reach the end of the cycle to unlock new Etheral Weapons! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ ...ETHERAL WEAPON? WHAT'S THAT? An Etheral Weapon is a special type of gun that you can always spawn from behind your hips. Whether your gun is empty, you dropped it off a cliff or you just want to dual wield because that's the kind of cool dude you are, you can pull out these single magazine weapons to get you out of a bind! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 18 UNIQUE ARENAS... ...made for the sole purpose of shooting, running and swinging around in. _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 10 UNIQUE GUNS... ...and more to come. Enjoy the entirely physical reloading and handling! _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ THANK YOU Making this game alone would be quasi-impossible if it wasn't for the help of these people and ressources. Please look them up and give them some love by clicking on 'Visit the website' on the sidebar :)

rows.name: Raia Nova
rows.short_description: Combine skills with many effects at once to destroy your enemies. Choose your hero and evolve them into a customized champion as you encounter strange monsters and unique characters in this crazy colorful ARPG.
rows.description_html: In this world, a great tournament was created by the sage Sagathu. But when a mysterious mind wipe spell causes fighting, chaos, and memory loss, you begin to see there is much more happening beneath the surface. The world seems full of strange happenings. Investigate the frozen fortress holding the power of the Breaker. Enter the terrifying dream world of Dhalia, the flower that draws blood. Face the greatest magic user alive beneath the spires of the Shining City. Raia Nova is challenging ARPG that lets you build and evolve your character as you progress. Destroy hordes of enemies with bombs, fireballs, earthquakes, ice beams, bubbles, magic daggers, plastic discs, crystal shards, plasma, and over 100 other abilities. Items often grant abilities but you'll have to find them, or improvise with whatever you have. Take on big bosses and develop your strategies against them. More than just fighting through levels, experience a variety of mission types and challenges. Choose your character - Krin the Spellsword, Mothball the Magician, Basa the Gladiator, Dias the Thief, and Dweller the Warden An Ultra skill for each character. Become invincible or rampage as a living statue. A large character progression tree for each character, customize what they excel at and add bonuses to abilities. A multitude of skills and items with little restriction on how they can be combined or used. Simple skills can be enhanced with many effects. Shoot a triple shot bullet that bounces off walls and causes the plague. 48+ levels across 6 regions of the world. Past the campaign, a challenging endgame. Supports gamepad, click to move, and WSAD control types.

rows.name: Christmas Mansion
rows.short_description: Dive into Christmas Mansion! Blast through snowy match-3 levels, unlock boosters, and help the Elf rebuild Winterland. Decorate cozy cottages, craft treats, and enjoy a joyful holiday journey filled with winter magic!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Christmas Mansion! Welcome to Christmas Mansion, a cozy and festive holiday match-3 puzzle adventure where snow sparkles, gingerbread crunches, and every match brings the spirit of Christmas to life.   A Cozy Winter Match-3 Wonderland Escape into a world of twinkling lights, snowy rooftops, and festive melodies. Match candy canes, ornaments, stockings, stars, and gingerbread cookies in hundreds of levels. Every puzzle brings you closer to rebuilding and decorating the Winterland! Perfect for relaxing by the fireplace anytime you need a cheerful break.   Swap, Match & Make Holiday Magic Use simple match-3 mechanics - swap, drag, and match - to create colorful combos and festive explosions! Blow away snow piles, melt icy tiles, and clear all obstacles as you progress through magical winter puzzles.   Restore & Decorate the Winter Lands Swap pieces, beat levels and help Elf decorate the winter lands. An exciting adventure and quests wait for you. Build a cozy little cottage on the hill and a cookie factory, fire up the oven and get baking! Think you could whip up a nice batch of muffins? Build an ornament factory, ski workshop and complete dozens of other quests to prepare a fantastic holiday party. Winter has tons of fun in stock for you.   Create the Gingerbread decoration telling the tale of Hansel and Gretel! Clean the scene first! Start building! Build the witch's castle! Blast through the puzzles and have a fantastic Christmas holiday again! Magical Features You’ll Love • Dozens of quests to complete. • Powerful boosters and festive bonuses. • Hundreds of joyful holiday match-3 levels with new obstacles. • Cozy, cheerful visuals and relaxing seasonal music.   The Perfect Holiday Puzzle Adventure Whether you love Christmas games, decoration adventures, or classic match-3 puzzles, Christmas Mansion brings all the winter cheer to your screen! Warm cocoa energy + relaxing puzzles + festive decorating = The ultimate Christmas escape! Download Christmas Mansion today and let the holiday magic begin!

rows.name: Legacy of Aeroja
rows.short_description: Legacy of Aeroja is a Fantasy Action Rpg made in RPG Maker MV. It follows Aeroja as they go from newborn drake to full sized dragon, dealing with the loss of their parent and the harsh winter and people around them. A tale of excess awaits.
rows.description_html: Legacy of Aeroja is a game made in RPG Maker MV that uses the ABS Plugin by Phoenix_Ru.86/PhoenixKageDesu. It is made up of five major story acts and a postgame. It is rich with side content and dungeons that contain puzzles and bosses. It has many classic RPG mechanics such as hidden bosses, unique equipment and skills, rewarding exploration of side content, and is equally as rich with story, lore, and worldbuilding. It is the first game in the LoA franchise, a fantasy world filled with backstory that combines positive aspects of both realistic fantasy and high fantasy to generate a world filled with political intrigue, culture, the impact of fantasy elements in realistic societies, and many small details that give the world life. This world is a vehicle for meaningful stories following themes not often discussed in fantasy such as toxicity or modern existential problems, and will utilize ludonarrative(writing told through game mechanics) elements to enhance every part of the experience. Most importantly, this world is something you can be a part of, so join us for our first foray into it! ABS Plugin by KageDesu(all needed credits in game end credits) Legacy of Aeroja is a non-commercial product. It is not endorsed by the original license holder of the ABS Plugin. Any changes made to the plugin fall under the same license agreement as the plugin.

rows.name: Hedgehot - Battle Strike
rows.short_description: Turn-based strategy card game where you use different creatures and spells to defeat your enemies.
rows.description_html: Hedgehot - Battle Strike : Cards in which reside magical creatures are used to challenge other users and pave a way to the top. Hedgehot - Battle Strike is a 1 versus 1 Card Game similar to the likes of Heartstone or Runeterra, where using your cards, brain and stamina, you try to defeat your opponent and bring their life points to 0. Features : Friendly Battle - Invite your friends in a lobby to challenge them to prove your skills. Online MatchMaking - Find or create a lobby for random players around the world to challenge you. Best place to refine your skills. Deck Builder - Choose your favorite cards to challenge others with. Shop - Purchase cards to upgrade your deck and create the best possible Meta. Community : You may join the Hedgehot - Battle Strike official discord to find other battlers and a place to share your experience!

rows.name: Elements of Dreams
rows.short_description: Elements of Dreams is pixel art action role playing game (much like the original Legend of Zelda). Play as the heroine who must discover four unique powers in order to defeat her nightmares and find her purpose.
rows.description_html: About Elements of Dreams is pixel art action role playing game (much like the original Legend of Zelda). Play as the heroine who must discover four unique powers in order to defeat her nightmares and find her purpose. Controls: Movement: Arrow Keys (or Wasd) Power: Space Menus: Mouse button Features: 9+ Levels: Venture through 9 increasingly difficult levels. 4 Unique Abilities: Defeat your foes with 1 of 4 timed abilities. Keep track of your power bar to figure out when you need to return to a statue to recharge. 13 Enemy Types: Each enemy has different attributes of speed, health, and damage. Some even have special abilities. 1 Boss: Defeat the World boss to discover your destiny. Infinite lives: Lose all your hearts? No worries, you have infinite lives. Level progression saves: Each level unlocks that level name in the Level Selection menu once you reach it. You can then save your progress for future plays via the menu. Procedural level generation: Replay (or reload) the 2nd to last level to have it generate in a different configuration with a different combination of enemies. Replay any level: Use the Level Selection menu to replay you're favorite levels again.

rows.name: Setr's Auto Battler
rows.short_description: A fantasy themed casual auto battler
rows.description_html: Build your team! Build your own fantasy team and try them out in the arena! Each turn you get to purchase units from the shop and try to get the strongest composition. Use this time wisely, buy and sell units, find the best synergies. Fight in the arena! When you have your desired team, send them to the arena and see if they succeed! The Arena is automated, you just have to sit back and watch as you fight someone else's team. Win matches to win the game! Can you build the perfect team to get 15 wins? Features 30+ playable units to build your team from! No time limit! Go grab a coffee and continue! Asynchronous online mathmaking, each time you battle someone who recently submitted their team! The game is in beta! New units, new features and updates are coming.

rows.name: Magic Disc Golf
rows.short_description: Magic Disc Golf lets you take control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. Find the optimal route, navigate challenging terrain, and use your speed boost to cover some extra ground. Choose from three 18-hole courses and four game modes.
rows.description_html: Play Disc Golf by taking control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. You will have to plan your route carefully, navigate challenging terrain and use your limited booster ability sparingly. Main features: Three 18-hole courses and one 6-hole tutorial/practice course. Up to four players playing on the same computer. Three disc types (Driver, Midrange and Putter) with varying range, handling, and stability. Challenging terrain and obstacles. Wind that will affect your disc’s range and handling. Highly customizable play settings: Customizable courses: select a course and then select which holes you want to play. Four game modes: Stroke Play, Match Play, Speed Play and Speed Match Play. In Stroke Play and Match play you need to reach the basket in as few throws as possible. In Speed Play and Speed Match Play you need to get to the basket as fast as possible. Disc steering. Enable disc steering and guide your disc towards the basket, or disable it for a more realistic experience. Disc boosting. Enable it to collect boost energy and use it to cover more ground, or leave it disabled for more challenging gameplay. Three time-of-day settings: Afternoon, evening and night. A minimap to help you plan your hole. Can be disabled for more challenging gameplay. Minor features: Discs come equipped with flashlights (naturally). High score tables. Manuals describing the game modes and game play features in detail.

A minimap to help you plan your hole. Can be disabled for more challenging gameplay. Minor features: Discs come equipped with flashlights (naturally). High score tables. Manuals describing the game modes and game play features in detail.

rows.name: Cells of Immunity
rows.short_description: Become a young white blood cell in training and learn how they mature and fight against invading pathogens. Team up with other types of cells, with unique strengths and weaknesses, and overcome disease for good. To serve and protect the human body at all costs.
rows.description_html: Overview of the story Play as a young Thymocyte, training to become one of the primary white blood cells that protect the human body. Meet other cells in training, and find out who is talented enough to become a white blood cell and the fate of the failures. As the story progresses, you'll have the ability to control multiple types of white blood cells, such as T-Killer cells, Macrophages and neutrophils. Each with its unique strengths and weaknesses, command them correctly to overcome all obstacles caused by invading pathogens. Use the correct types of attacks against your enemies in Real-Time action-bar combat in order to defeat your enemies. To serve and protect the human body at all costs. Game Features 1-2 Hours of Gameplay 3 Acts of Story 3+ Playable Characthers 3+ Different Classes Dozens of Items, Weapon and Gear to collect! Over 10 types of encounters! Over 20 different areas to explore! Many types of attacks, elements and status conditions. Details about the game This game is an educational Role-Playing-Game, all about the human immune system. You will experience the lives of many cells involved in the immune system. Learn about the objectives of different cell types involved in the immune response, and fight against invading pathogens. Many factors in this game, such as appearances and interactions between cells, have been altered, to fit better into a game and a good story. Despite the alterations, all events and characters in this game are based upon how the human immune system works in real life, and as a result, we aim to teach everyone who plays our game a bit more about the immune system than they knew before. Furthermore, students in medical or biological areas may find this game useful to visualize the interactions within the human body. Although some amount of scientific accuracy has been lost, this makes a much easier to understand. This game has been developed by University of Warwick students, and the story has been fact-checked by Professors of Warwick, to stay relatively accurate to the actual science behind it. The development of this game has been funded by IATL of Warwick, making it accessible for everyone to play and learn from it.

rows.name: The Open League
rows.short_description: A social, Discord-based, football/soccer sim
rows.description_html: The Open League (TOL) is a text-based football/soccer manager game with significant integration with the Discord platform. Key features include: Nightly matches, 3-week season Full 90-minute matches are simulated nightly with play-by-play text updates streamed in our Discord server. Each universe features 30 teams organized in three leagues. Top three teams are promoted to a higher league. Bottom three get relegated. A season lasts three weeks. Youth camp During the off-season, teams attend Youth Camp with the hope to find the nexg legendary player. Camp lasts a weekend. During that time, managers use scouting reports to decide which players to bid on. Most team dynasties in TOL were built on succesful youth camp campaigns. Friendly matches Managers also have the ability to organize friendly matches against other managers. They often use the off-season to organize tournaments against other teams. Persistent teams and players At the end of the season, managers keep their teams. Players develop and decay season after season. Transfer timing is everything. Simple team management We’ve simplified club management so you don’t need to play 100s of hours to get familiar with our platform. Managers can choose between six formations, three effort levels and three different mindsets. Simple does not mean easy, beware… Negotiate transfers against humans Transfers are negotiated against human managers over Discord before deals are formalized using the TOL application. Astute dealmakers thrive in TOL. Browser-ready Our web app allows you to access your club portal from any browser (including from your phone), in case you have to make some changes from a different computer… Bots TOL uses a few friendly bots in Discord to help you manage your team. For example, you can DM your assistant Chris to ask him to send out a press release to all other clubs about your latest victorious match! Multi-timezone support The Open League supports two timezones (US PST and GMT) at the moment. This means matches are played at 7:00pm PST if you are in our US server or 7:00pm GMT if you are in our European server.

rows.name: Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past
rows.short_description: He can't escape the memories that haunt him, and soon Setyo realizes he must return to Neo-Surabaya to save what's left of his family. Experience the upheaval of Setyo's mundane life in Bay City in this action-adventure prologue to Rendezvous.
rows.description_html: Buy Rendezvous About the Game I can't remember the last time we smiled and laughed together. After our parents died, you went one way and I went another. Is this really how you want to see this through? To end up like them and hope we reunite? I just wish for once that you'd stop running, stop lying, and look me in the eyes and say you missed me. Is it really that hard to do Setyo? Can you do that, for us For what's left of our family? Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past is the prologue to the upcoming 2.5D Cyber-Noir pixel art puzzle-action adventure game by Pendopo Studios. This free adventure takes place in Bay City, following security guard Setyo starting another day of his mundane job — until a familiar face from his past resurfaces. A stunning combination of 2D hand-drawn pixel art in a 2.5D world, melded with modern effects such as dynamic lighting and bloom to bring depth and life to the city around you. Multiple paths lead to items, objects of interest, and tools that help you find your sister — and many secrets along the way! Gather clues and use everything you know to solve challenges that stand on your path to redemption. For the risk-averse, sneak around threats... or directly confront them with the (sometimes improvised) weapons available.

rows.short_description: A new virus is turning people into brain eating machines, etc. You know the rest. A cure has been found and all the infected people are now normal humans again. What is the problem then? Their skin color is still green. Play as an Ex-Zombie.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST! About the Game WARNING: This game contains heavy material that might make players/audience uncomfortable. An unknown deadly virus has suddenly spread. It turns people into brain eating zombies, the whole world goes into chaos, etc. You know the rest. However, in this game, a cure has been found. All the infected people have been treated and are now normal, functioning, harmless humans again. Except for one thing, the cured people’s skin color is still green. Play as a Green man. Human Apocalypse Prologue is a game set in a post-POST-apocalyptic world focusing on story, characters, decisions, and exploration. The dark, bizarre world of this game has a deep thought-provoking story, full of interesting characters to meet, a city to freely roam and explore, tough decisions to make, an original soundtrack, beautiful visuals, lots of secrets to uncover.

rows.name: Sewer Rave
rows.short_description: Exactly what it says on the tin. Sewer Rave is a game about exploring a rat infested Rave in a Sewer. There are creatures to talk to, items to collect, fights to get into, and jams to listen to. Explore, discover secrets, and writhe.
rows.description_html: Hey there buddy , you've been cordially invited to the sewer for the biggest rat party ever hosted. We've got cheese, fruit, sewer water, and danger . Wander the sewer and find messed up rats , old food , and maybe buried treasure (?) . Come along and make a friend or two. SEWER RAVE is a surreal randomized exploration game where you crawl around a rat infested sewer during a giant rave. Search the labyrinthine sewers to discover games, secrets, and wisdoms meant only for rodents. Grab a cup of sludge and meet some rats! SEWER RAVE was originally released in 2018 and the classic rat game is finally here on Steam, with a whole whopping one new feature: a genuine Steam Achievement. SEWER RAVE is the kind of game that wants to confuse you. What's going on? Am I a rat or a human? Was that a bug or a feature? Is there a reason I'm down here? What am I collecting fruit for? If you like to be confused in a loud place and unsure what is going on, maybe it's the game for you. Maybe it isn't. I'd be curious if I were you. But I like weird games. SEWER RAVE has items to collect and NPCs to trade with. Maybe you can find them all? Oh yeah and there's fruit and cheese all over the place and you can pick it up. There's also platforming challenges. There's also creatures to get into fights with. Sometimes minigames. I don't remember. Have fun okay? Stay safe? Text me when you get home. Important note: currently, the Twitch integration is not functional. Sorry for those who enjoyed that.

rows.short_description: 《FreestyleFootball》 is a street hip-hop animation style soccer ACG game created by JCE and published by HOGA. In the game, you will collect and play as different characters in PVP team Competition. The game mode includes 4v4 team competition and club league.
rows.description_html: 《Freestyle Football》 is an online soccer game developed by JOYCITY, a well-known Korean online sports game company. The game adopts a fashionable and flamboyant visual style, incorporating elements of street art and soccer art. In 《Freestyle Football》 you can show your individuality and charm, and also enjoy the fun of teamwork. In《Freestyle Football》your mini team will consist of 5 characters including a goalkeeper. Each player will control one character to participate in the game. There are 3 game modes in Freestyle Football: 1.4V4 mode with fast-pace. 2.Friendly game where you can play freely with your friends. 3.Breakout mode where you can enjoy the game alone.

rows.name: Toram Online
rows.short_description: The MMORPG of a massive and magnificent fantasy! Let's explore the MMO world!
rows.description_html: Toram Online, the popular smartphone game, is now available on Steam! Enjoy Toram Online on your big computer screen without having to worry about your data usage or battery! Unrestricted character creations! With more than 500 billion combinations available, feel free to create your own character to your liking! Sword? Magic? Anything you like! 'Profession', which is often the case with MMORPG, does not exist in Toram. Sword? (Magic) Staff? Bow? Halberd? Feel free to decide your own fighting style! Build & Train your character to your heart's content! Equipped with a 'Skill Tree' system enabling players to enhance and strengthen their characters as they wish. Create combos and discover your own battle style! Changeable weapons and equipment color! You can color your favorite weapon with the color you like when you obtain equipment with a 'Color Info'! Moreover, you can freely create the abilities of your equipment as you proceed further with the game...! Go on an adventure with your friends across the country! RPG (MMORPG) that can be played and connects you with your friends online across the country! The powerful monster that you fail to beat on your own could possibly be knocked down by forming a party with your friends! Let's explore the vast and beautiful 3D world with many friends! Party play even by yourself! You can even enjoy party play when you are playing alone by borrowing and battling together with other player's character known as 'mercenary' or by summoning a 'partner' from your own sub-characters! 【Story Setting】 Decades ago, the world was hit by a devastating catastrophe, crumbling the ground into pieces. The gods quickly gathered the pieces scattered in all directions and hurriedly put them together. The result, a bizarre looking world resembling a mosaic. The nation that was originally there had ceased to exist. As a result of repeated clashes of principles and interests among the 4 tribes, the people split into 4 factions. At such times, an adventurer (you) came to this peculiar world. The adventurer (you) goes through a series of adventures while meeting various people belonging to the 4 factions in the world to confront the secretly proliferating mysteries behind it...... Service performance and availability are not guaranteed when Devices do not meet the recommended system requirements Virtual machines or emulators are being used VPN(Virtual Private Network) is being used

rows.name: Survival Girls
rows.short_description: A survival, base building and crafting game. Explore the island, collect resources and defend your base. Search, craft, hunt or steal to buy weapons and vehicles. Hunt and tame animals, grow your herd and attack your enemies base. A FP/TPS survival of the fittest!
rows.description_html: SURVIVAL GIRLS is my tribute game to one of my favorite games, RUST. You live on an island and need to stay alive with food and water. You build your base and defend it from others, craft items and weapons for your base, build an ATV, Snowmobile or car to race around the island. Survival Girls is focused mainly on crafting, building and raiding other players compounds! Search and collect various plants and materials to craft guns and vehicles (and soon to tame animals). The game is in a very early state and I intend to add more animals and AI and other features like air drops and events . I also would like to hear from you, the players, and try and include as many of your suggestions into the game as possible. I am a Solo dev and this is my FIRST GAME! I hope you enjoy my efforts and have a good time Surviving Girl!

rows.name: Hereford 1642
rows.short_description: A historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics. Explore the whole city and surroundings .
rows.description_html: About This Project You need to be aware that this is a historic recreation project and doesn't contain any game play that you would expect from a traditional game at this point. The game should be very enjoyable from a historic stand point and for exploring the past. Thank you Join our disord Help us with development and feedback by joining the discord About the Game A historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics. Using period maps, illustrations and drawings, together with still existing period buildings in the City and elsewhere; A scale model of the city as it once was. Over 200 unique enterable buildings together with the the city walls and gates, the castle and the bridge over the river Wye. Beyond the gates you can travel the countryside; A 4Km * 4Km map allows you to journey and explore a mile from the city in any direction. With towering cathedrals and churches seen from miles away. A highly interactable environment awaits with many hidden gems to find. Your character lives and works in the 17th century with all that entails. Period clothes, money, tools, transport, food, language, writing, to name but a few aspects. The past is another country: they do things differently there.

Period clothes, money, tools, transport, food, language, writing, to name but a few aspects. The past is another country: they do things differently there.

rows.name: Sabotris
rows.short_description: Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI!
rows.description_html: Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI! Competitive? Yes. Casual? Also yes. You choose the level of difficulty that suits your play style. Have a relaxing game against your own score, or group up with your friends or strangers and see who can get the highest score! Though warning in advance, only play against the computer AI on the highest difficulty at your own risk... It's not just about being the fastest at the game, power ups allow you to sabotage or assist your opponents. This takes the competitive edge to the next level, where you can intentionally sabotage a single player every time, or if you find Sabotris too easy, sabotage yourself! Spectating other people can be boring, so Sabotris doesn't make you do that when you lose. Instead, you get to roam the world as a miniature cube with your other friends that also lost. You can even pretend you're in another mini-game avoiding shapes being dropped by the ones that are still playing! Whether you're a fiend of playing with others or just want to relax with your friends, multiplayer lobbies are a must. Sabotris makes lobbying with friends or strangers seamlessly simple. Just host a game, and watch people join!

rows.name: Bouncy Bunnies
rows.short_description: Race against your friends in a colorful platform world filled with colors and fun obstacles. Take boost to run faster or try to find the most efficient path to be the first little bunny to reach the goal. Choose from 8 levels. Collect those tasty carrots to rack up a high score and come out top!
rows.description_html: Hey there, fellow bunny lovers! Are you ready to hop into some seriously fun gameplay? Bouncy Bunnies is the perfect game for a friendly race against your friends. In a colorful platform world, your goal is to be the first bunny to reach the finish line. You can take a boost to run faster, or try to find the shortest path to the goal. With 8 different levels to choose from, there's always something new to explore. But don't forget to collect those carrots along the way! They'll help you get a higher score and come out on top. And with keyboard and mouse support, as well as gamepad support, you can play however you like. But for the ultimate bunny-bouncing experience, we recommend using a controller. And don't forget - you can even host your own server and invite your friends to join in on the fun. So gather your bunny buddies and let the race begin! Features: 1-4 players 4 different bunnies to choose from 8 levels for multiplayer fun 1 level for single player action Carrot and power boost pickups to help you along the way Keyboard and mouse support, as well as gamepad support for even more options

rows.name: Idle Spiral
rows.short_description: This is a beautiful 'Idle', 'Incremental' game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow farther and farther from the origin. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time!
rows.description_html: What's Idle Spiral? This is a beautiful 'Idle', 'Incremental' game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow longer and longer. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time. How to play By buying upgrades, you can grow your spiral more efficiently. There will be a lot of mathematical equations, but don't be afraid. The upgrades themselves are not that strategic and you hardly need to understand this formula. However, as you continue to play, you will gradually come to understand the mechanics. Layered prestige mechanics The game has various reset mechanisms called Prestige (as seen in many Idle games!). Prestige resets much of the game's progression, but allow you to progress further and faster than before. Battle Spiral In Battle Spiral, your spiral is used as a weapon to fight various designs of spirals; to gain an advantage in Battle Spiral, it is important to consider what rewards to choose and in what order to fight the enemies. An extremely powerful boss with a very complex shape awaits you in the second half of the game! Challenges Challenges aim to achieve a specific goal under strong constraints. In challenges you will face debuffs, constraints, and fundamental gameplay changes while trying to achieve a certain goal. After reaching the goal, the challenge is completed and you receive big rewards. Endless Content Tornado Prestige is just the beginning of this game. It will take some time to progress through the game, but more content is waiting for you! Music by AKIYAMA HIROKAZU from H/MIX GALLERY

rows.name: Hacker Simulator: Free Trial
rows.short_description: Become a hacker and build your online reputation to the top by discovering a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods. Complete contracts, buy new programs, upgrade your computer, crack wifi networks and infiltrate peoples or companies online systems.
rows.description_html: Important note about this Trial version This version of Hacker Simulator is a trial version and will give you access to the tutorial and the first contracts. To access the rest of the content, please go to the full version available here: Important note: Please note that Hacker Simulator is not a realistic 1:1 hacking simulation and that the mechanics are only inspired by real-life hacking methods. With Hacker Simulator , I wanted to bring a fun and immersive experience on the theme of hacking so that you can have a better vision of some of its aspects (being alone, I certainly can't cover all of them). In order to keep your business running, you need to stay anonymous regularly by hiding behind various wifi networks. To do this, you will learn how to use the famous suite of tools called Aircrack-ng ! A lot of research has been done to bring you a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods such as bruteforce , exploits , phishing and more! You will learn a lot during your adventure, but you will also learn that hacking is not without risk. The networks you will explore will be secured and the wifi connections will be monitored , requiring a high level of attention.

rows.name: Walk with the Living
rows.short_description: Walk with the Living is a queer strategy melodrama focused on character-driven storytelling and player choice.
rows.description_html: Grief leads a swordswoman and a necromancer to raise an infamous knight from his grave. Follow the trio's intimate quest for vengeance and make choices that impact their relationships with one another and those they meet. -Enjoy beautiful sprite art and character illustrations. -Consider space and terrain in creative ways to survive fast-paced, player-phase-focused tactical battles. -Meet complex characters and form relationships, both platonic and romantic, between them to gain in-battle benefits. -Make choices that impact the narrative and the relationships between various characters. All choices have consequences, both positive and negative. -Replay and make different choices to discover dozens of secret endings and character epilogues. Weapons, items, and gold carry over with new game plus. -Characters die permanently, but there are always more stories to be told; when a character dies, new narrative branches, relationships, and recruitments become available. -Focus on narrative without worrying about battlefield character deaths in Story mode. -There's a cat! Rowan Raised from the dead against his will to bring vengeance against his former employer, he struggles to cope with existing among the living in a body that feels dead. Aoife An unwilling leader of a growing movement to exact justice on the mercenary company raiding villages of the countryside, she harbors doubts about whether her mission to avenge her sister has meaning in the wake of her sister’s death. Keir After achieving what seemed impossible by raising Rowan from the dead, he accompanies Aoife on her quest of vengeance while holding onto regrets about his late lover, Niall.

rows.reviews_html: “[The] realistic depiction of the pain these characters are holding makes it easy to want them to find some happiness. Unlike the ‘which one will I choose?’ dating sim mechanics of recent Fire Emblem games, in Walk with the Living you get to play cupid, gradually encouraging dispossessed and traumatized characters to open up to each other and (maybe) start to see their future together. . . Perhaps best of all, it's a believably hopeful story about queer people.” Gamers with Glasses

rows.name: Super Life: Franchise Lord
rows.short_description: Can you really take over the world with a sandwich? Short answer... MONEY IS EVIL!
rows.description_html: Super Life Franchise Lord is an incremental franchise management sim set in the world of Super Life RPG with an idle game progression system. Disclaimer: This game was designed for mobile devices and is best experienced on Android or iOS 1. Little Zeus 2. Slimmy Sam's 3. Taco Box 4. Angus McBangus Not actual gameplay. Start small and grow by upgrading equipment and researching new menu items to increase profitability! Complete customer orders yourself or hire employees and make them do all the work. They will still look to you to deal with customer complaints and handle workplace accidents. Purchase employee perks to hire better employees, increase employee levels to allow you to run your franchises more hands off. Raise animals for slaughter at the farm, or buy fresh ingredients from vendors at the farmers market! Buy (or steal) AmaZone boxes to collect items that help keep your franchises running smoothly or sway conversations in your favor. The Money Tree is back and serves as one of multiple daily reward systems in the game. You can also collect free coins from your coin miner and complete daily tasks for additional rewards!

rows.name: Ghoul Dungeon
rows.short_description: Welcome to Ghoul Dungeon, a level-based adventure. As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make sure you stay agile.
rows.description_html: Ghoul Dungeon is a level-based adventure. As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make use of the ability to dash in order to avoid getting hit. In addition, you will be able to use power slashes to deal additional damage. Make sure you're aware of your cooldowns! You'll also encounter capsules to to heal you or provide attack boosts. Make use of these to power through! Note: Ghoul Dungeon was a personal project I made in high school, when I was still learning game dev, and I'm no longer working on the game. Still, I hope you guys enjoy it! Current number of levels available: 4 Additional notes: - Ghoul Dungeon is playable with a controller, however this is implemented only for experimental purposes (suggested method to play is with keyboard and mouse) - Currently, enemies can only attack at a close range  however in a future update a ranged variant will be added

rows.name: Childlike(차일드라이크)
rows.short_description: Use objects not to step on the floor. Do not step on the road outside. Run away from the Guard at school. Run away from the haunted doll.
rows.description_html: 'Childlike' is a journey to follow the innocence of childhood. Play as the child facing adventurous moments, the player should think like a child to overcome fear and obstacles ahead. In the kids' imagination, kids encounter many obstacles anywhere around the house, and outside, and of course, the school. They think of floor and road as things they must not step on, otherwise, they think they're gonna fall down. And their school becomes the scariest place at night and dolls are alive, move around. As a puzzle genre game, players need various abilities to move next. Comprehension of the game - Players should look around to find items, and think about what to do to deal with the obstacles. They can grab and throw, step on the objects not to step on the floor, just like 'The floor is lava'. Being alert - Players should always be careful and check if their footsteps or turning on the lights make any attraction to villains. If they find the players, something terrible will happen. And it will make the players not let their hair down. Rapid reaction - Players should concentrate on what is chasing them and how to deal with it quickly to survive. If they act late, there is no next. Through this game, the player can recall innocent minds as a child. *There are some English interfaces but all of the subtitles are Korean.

rows.name: Tavern Crawl
rows.short_description: Tavern Crawl is an alcohol-fueled adventure starring Fish, a young mouse on a quest to save his kingdom’s supply of booze from a gang of thieving rats through combat and crafting cocktails.
rows.description_html: Tavern Crawl is a student-made, 3rd-person adventure starring Fish, a young countryside mouse who dreams of adventure. His kingdom uses alcohol collected from the city they live below as currency, fuel for fires, and resources to craft delicious and useful cocktails. When the alcohol mysteriously dries up, Fish volunteers to leave his home and investigate where the precious resource has gone. Fast Paced Combat Use your needle sword and bottlecap shield to fight those that would keep you from your destiny. Crafting Cocktails Use the alcohol collected from fallen enemies to craft cocktails with all sorts of useful effects. Explore the Sewers Explore the rich world of the sewers, filled with a host of characters and secrets for you to discover.

Kandra 's goal as one of the last remaining Moonwalkers is to find her friends and recover the magic feathers. Find collectibles! Collect feathers , gems and other collectibles to unlock abilities, open portals and progress towards your goal: collecting all the magic feathers and returning magic to the world. Defeat enemies and bosses! Fight against enemies that want to block your waym, from mere minions to bosses . Use different skills for different combat situations. Get new skills for Kandra! Unlock new skills to face enemies in new ways and overcome environmental challenges . Explore the different worlds and bring back the magic! rows.name: Sigh of the Abyss: Shadow Bonds ▪ Prologue
rows.short_description: Embrace the monster within to free yourself from a curse in this dark fantasy visual novel, an introduction to the characters and setting of Sigh of the Abyss.
rows.description_html: Shadow Bonds is an introduction to the world and characters of Sigh of the Abyss . You have been chained to a stranger, a boy foolish—or brave—enough to flee the gilded cage where magi are kept docile and pliant. The curse will kill you both unless you find a way to break it. Anyone else would already be dead, but not you—for you hear the ancient voice of the Abyss, and have been blessed—or cursed—with powers dark and terrible. Did the Abyss bestow upon you supernatural strength and agility? Do you have the power to manipulate the shadows and see what they see? Perhaps your dark gift is prying open the minds of others only to break them and have them do your bidding. Embrace your emotions. The four humors color the tone of your responses and your personality: will you be the carefree sanguine , the thoughtful phlegmatic , the anxious melancholic or the fiery choleric ? Will you stay friends or seek something more? Learn more about your companions, see how they react to the curse placed upon you, accept or reject their aid. Shadow Bonds will give you a glimpse into the friendship and romance system of Sigh of the Abyss . An introduction to the characters and setting of Sigh of the Abyss Customize the protagonist's name and skills A branching narrative with hard choices and terrible consequences Three unique endings with several variations each Sample what the romance interests have to offer, or stay friends Learn more about the rich setting of Sigh of the Abyss through codex entries

rows.name: Welcome To Your Immune System
rows.short_description: Welcome to Your Immune System is an addictive retro arcade-style video game where you defend human cells from invading bacteria. Use all the weapons in your arsenal from macrophages, killer T cells, to cytokines and learn how these work in real life.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Your Immune System is an addictive arcade-style video game where you defend human cells from invading bacteria. Use all the weapons in your arsenal from macrophages, killer T cells, to cytokines and learn how these work in real life. WTYIS was created with advice from world-leading vaccine researchers. The game is based on the fun retro 2D arcade games of the past such as Asteroids and Space Invaders. You only need a mouse and a keyboard! Can you hold out before all of your cells are infected??? Who Is the Game For? The game is totally free and is fun and educational for people of all ages. They are specifically designed to engage 11 - 14-year-old students and designed as a tool for teachers, researchers, and parents looking for a fun way to engage young people with the topics of immunology, vaccines, and the history of science. You can play the game in five languages - English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese. Find out how the BCG Vaccine was invented with our companion game Albert and Camille's Litlle Lille Adventure - /

rows.name: Ultimate Super Powers Old Maid～3Days～
rows.short_description: Created in 3 days! The Ultimate Combination of Old Maid and Mahjong! This is the most exciting game ever created!
rows.description_html: 🎊Produced in 3 days! 🎊 The Ultimate Combination of Old maid and Mahjong! 'Ultimate Super Ppowers Old Maid～3Days～' is a game based on the card game Babanuki. It is an irregular Old Maid where the player's actions are determined by the ability tiles that are replenished each turn, apart from the cards such as Numbers and Jokers. When the game starts, each player is first dealt a hand of five cards with hands and feet for some reason, and six ability tiles. In addition to 'draw one card from the opponent's hand,' the ability tiles also contain special effects that are not found in the regular Old Maid, such as 'increase the opponent's hand' and 'discard your hand. The player must use this Ability Tile to eliminate his or her own hand, as in the Bubba Draw, in order to win. One of the characteristics of an Ability Tile is that it has a fixed maximum number of tiles that can appear on the field. For example, one player can monopolize one Ability Tile, and while that player is monopolized, no other player can draw that Ability Tile until that player uses the Ability Tile they are monopolizing. The game is characterized by the fact that both players can read each other's ability tiles as well as the opponent's hand, which creates a deeper gameplay than in ordinary Old Maid. ｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰ This game can be freely posted, distributed, and monetized on social networking and video services.

rows.short_description: Juglio encounters the Splendor Man... What happens next is unthinkable.
rows.description_html: It's a dark, deadly night, and our good friend Juglio is out for a joyride. His joy and ride are both rudely ruined when a mysterious, and splendorous, dark figure makes him swerve off the road and mangle up his beater. Could this have been the legendary Splendor Man? Yes, it was him. Will Juglio be able to survive his way out of the Forest of Evil, or will he succumb to the evil schemes of Splendor Man? GENRE Psychological Horror Comedy Experience GAMEPLAY Navigate through the woods and use your wits to escape in one piece...

rows.name: Vanildo's Journey
rows.short_description: Vanildo, a skilled retired adventurer is forced to return to work because of the peculiar events that are taking place in the city of Pirarotoba, including the disappearance of his old friend.
rows.description_html: Vanildo's Journey is a playful adventure game, focused on humorous characters, comic events and exploration elements with touches of suspense and mystery. The game tells a story full of twists, unique and charismatic characters, secrets hidden by the map and a simple and intuitive turn-based combat. In addition to offering a casual and pleasant environment, RPG brings a rewarding game style for curious players who seek to explore everything and 'replay' more than once, seeking to make different choices and paths, and may even find different endings in the same scene. Players must enter with a clean and open mind, looking for a dynamic and pleasant game, thus, they will achieve a satisfying experience that mixes gallows humor with a tense and dismal environment.

rows.name: ScreenPlay CCG
rows.short_description: A comical CCG where movie characters rule on and off screen. Build decks with genre tropes and eccentric stars, and outsmart rival directors in simultaneous-turn battles. Complete your Leads' story arcs to win chaotic cinematic showdowns.
rows.description_html: A comedy-fueled collectible card game where movie tropes come to life—and run the studio too. ScreenPlay CCG is a digital card game set in a delightfully absurd universe where the characters from your favorite genres aren’t just starring in films—they’re the ones calling the shots. Literally. These eccentric directors produce, direct, and even sabotage each other’s blockbusters in the most chaotic filmmaking process ever committed to cardboard… or, well, digital cardboard. Build decks using genre-savvy characters, absurd plot twists, and iconic film tropes to outwit your rivals in a game that rewards strategy, timing, and a healthy appreciation for how ridiculous cinema can be. 🎞 CCG Meets Fighting Game Strategy Outthink, outplay, out-direct. Unlike traditional CCGs that rely on slow turns and predictable patterns, ScreenPlay borrows from fighting game mechanics. You and your opponent plan your moves at the same time, then watch the result unfold like you’re watching a classic masterpiece in the making. Whether you’re pulling off a perfect dodge, reading an attack two scenes ahead, or throwing down a plot twist that makes everything go off the rails, victory comes from reading your opponent as much as your deck. Want to bluff your way through a thriller? Go full ham in a melodrama? You can do that. This is a game of mind games and movie magic. ⏱ Simultaneous Turns No waiting, no stalling—just pure, unpredictable chaos. In ScreenPlay , both players secretly script their scenes (i.e., their turns) in advance. Once you've locked in your decisions, the game cuts straight to the action, playing both turns out simultaneously. The result? A fast-paced, brainy experience where timing and prediction are everything—and there's no room to pause for popcorn. Every scene is a gamble. Did your Horror Lead strike when your opponent adventurously dodged? Did they perform a dramatic scene while you expected an action movie-style assault? You won’t know until the camera rolls. 🏆 Win by Telling a Better Story Victory isn’t about HP bars—it’s about completing your character arcs . Every Lead character has a distinct narrative journey. Over the course of a match, you’ll earn Narrative Points by playing synergistic cards and making smart choices. Complete the arcs of any two of your three Leads, and you win the game. No explosions required—though those help too. This mechanic rewards clever deck construction, genre mastery, and good ol’ fashioned timing. It’s a game of stories within a story, where every match feels like a mini movie—even if the script makes no sense and half the cast is mysteriously missing in act two. Just remember: knowing your opponent’s Leads and their story goals can help you sabotage their arcs before they reach their big finale. 🎭 Lead the Cast with Genre-Bending Characters With over 22 unique Leads available at launch and many more in development, ScreenPlay is packed with genre-hopping personalities ready for the spotlight. Each Lead comes from a different cinematic tradition and brings a signature set of abilities and cards. Whether you're leaning into the brooding mystery of Richard Spade, the razor-sharp wit of Roast Comic Frog, the righteous vengeance of Maximus, or the pure chaos of the Illuminati Lizard, every character changes how you build your deck and approach the game. And with the ability to mix and match any three Leads, the combinations are practically limitless—well, not actually limitless, this is still an indie game. But you get the idea. 📚 Every Game is Its Own Movie Deckbuilding isn't just strategy—it's screenwriting. You’ll start each game by choosing three Leads and constructing a 40-card deck tailored to their unique arcs. Some cards represent their strengths. Others exploit genre clichés or set up over-the-top payoffs. Want to lean into a character’s Plot Armor? Go for it. Here, “lazy writing” is just another path to brilliance. The result is a game where every match feels like a short film that spirals out of control in the best possible way. Build tension. Subvert expectations. And maybe—just maybe—pull off a finale worthy of a standing ovation. 🎬 Solo Play for Aspiring Auteurs Not ready for the festival circuit? No problem. Start off with a guided tutorial and a pre-built deck to ease you into the chaotic world of ScreenPlay . Then, grow your collection by completing daily and weekly challenges, or by taking on boss bots in a rotating lineup of single-player game modes. There’s always something new to do—even if your cast is constantly forgetting their lines. Future updates will bring full-blown movie campaign modes, letting you explore the bizarre backstories, rivalries, and plot holes of your favorite Leads. Just pray they don’t go on strike before then. The devs writing the scripts themselves? Terrifying. 🌐 Multiplayer Mayhem Challenge filmmakers around the world in a battle for box office supremacy. Jump into competitive ladder matches against players of your skill level or explore alternate multiplayer formats for chaotic genre mashups. Want to make a romantic horror musical with a sci-fi twist and a noir detective lead? That’s not just possible—it’s encouraged . Show off your deckbuilding brilliance, master the meta, or just enjoy the ride. Because in ScreenPlay , even the worst movie can still win Best Picture if you play your cards right. Oh, and don’t forget to join the community on Discord—weekly tournaments, bonus prizes, and the occasional pun war await. 🧰 Craft Your Own Blockbuster Build your collection your way—whether through grind or glamour. Earn cards by completing missions, opening booster packs, or climbing the competitive ladder. Got extras? Use the in-game crafting system to recycle duplicates into the cards you actually want. Feeling like a silver spoon-fed producer? You can also buy cards directly. We get it—not everyone wants to hustle in the editing bay. No judgment (well, maybe a little). 🎬 Expansions, Sequels & Spin-Offs New content, every quarter. New drama, every time. Every three months, ScreenPlay gets a fresh injection of content—new Leads, new cards, new movies, and new ways to play. These expansions keep the meta fresh and the production mayhem rolling, giving you endless ways to reinvent your cinematic masterpieces. It’s like rebooting your favorite franchise, only on purpose. And with fewer angry fans. 🎤 Why ScreenPlay CCG Stands Out 🤺 Simultaneous turns for fast-paced, mind-game-rich strategy 🎭 Over 22 Lead characters across a wild spectrum of movie genres 📚 Story arc-based win conditions for narrative-driven gameplay 🧠 Deep deckbuilding with real strategic variety 🎮 Single-player and multiplayer modes with evolving content 😂 A comedic, self-aware tone that softens the sting of even the most dramatic defeats So—ready to make your directorial debut? ScreenPlay CCG is your all-access pass to a world where genres collide, characters clash, and every match is a chance to create the worst great movie ever made.

rows.name: The Planet Crafter: Prologue
rows.short_description: Experience the first stages of terraforming an entire planet in this space survival open world terraforming crafting game prologue. Explore, survive, collect, build your base then create oxygen, heat and pressure to make an hostile planet livable for humanity.
rows.description_html: This is a prologue for the full game 'Planet Crafter'. From Hostile to Habitable You are sent on an hostile planet with one mission: Make it habitable for Humans. You'll have to survive, collect resources, build your base and machines in order to heat the planet, create an atmosphere with enough oxygen and eventually geo-engineer an entire planet! Survive, Collect, Craft Gather minerals and resources to survive. Craft all the tools you'll need in order to fulfill your mission. Explore old crashed ships and ruins and discover a planet full of mystery. Build you own base You'll need a base and all sorts of machines to make yourself at home, and be able to bring life on this planet! Key Features: Character Thirst, Oxygen, Temperature, Health Mechanics Base Building Crafting Mining ores Build machines to create atmospheric pressure Build machines to heat the planet Create a biosphere with oxygen Create life on a planet !

rows.name: Invisible Crush
rows.short_description: A hard core arcade casual gam
rows.description_html: Invisible Crush is a simple and violent hand disabled arcade game. With cool special effects and bursts of blows, it brings you a refreshing game experience; Players control the ball to kill enemies threatening the base, and enemies with different skills will continue to generate and approach the player's base from two worlds. Players can only be in one world at the same time, and can't see the enemies in this world. They can only observe the enemies in the opposite world through the gap between the two worlds. Players need to remember the location of the enemy in the opposite world so that they can accurately kill the enemy after switching the world. Game features: [invisible enemy] When you can't see the shape of your enemy, how will you face it? [refreshing shock] Blast the enemy and protect the base [various forms show their skills] Switch between different forms, unlock a variety of enemy killing methods, and open fancy critical attack on the enemy [boss clearly determines the target] Level giant monsters appear and concentrate their fire to kill

rows.name: Epic Tower for Tireless Lovers
rows.short_description: Embody an almost fairytale like princess. Housed at the top of a tower she faces an abundant amount of suitors who show up to win her over. Take the control of the princess, create your own tower, place traps and send suitors packing in this colorful and offbeat universe!
rows.description_html: Embody Margo, an almost fairytale like princess. Housed in her room at the top of a tower, she faces an abundant amount of suitors who show up to court her. Until then, a grandma dragon was protecting the tower but as she retire the tower is defenceless. The princess will have to kick out suitors by herself. Create your very own tower, connect castle rooms, place traps, sneak in galleries, unlock new traps, request your allies, and send suitors packing before they reach your bedroom! Epic Tower for Tireless Lovers has two distinct phases : a thinking and building phase and an action phase. During the first phase, you'll arrange your castle to create a maze so suitors get lost and you'll place traps to snatch intruders. The second phase allows you to move in the castle you made to eliminate suitors who are roaming in your tower. You'll have to activate and repair traps, call out your allies while keeping an eye on your bedroom door to avoid suitors to go in.
