rows.name: Trimps
rows.short_description: A text-based incremental idle game with a ridiculous amount of unique content. Automate old stuff as you unlock new stuff to keep things interesting for hours and hours, no spam clicking necessary! Trimps is everything you love about your favorite games, distilled to their purest form.
rows.description_html: Trimps is a text-based idle/incremental game filled with content to discover and explore. Wake up on a hostile planet with no memory, trap your first Trimp, and send it to battle. Breed your Trimps, set them to work, house them, gear them up with the best equipment, and keep sending them to battle! Nearly 7 years of updates so far Over 50 different Challenges that tweak the Universe in different ways Nearly 400 achievements that make you stronger Hundreds of perks, talents, and upgrades Trimploads of automation, with detailed levels of customization. Trimps is all about unlocking new stuff and automating old stuff. Brand new tutorial! After researching your first point of Science, ADVISOR will help guide you along your first adventure to the mysterious Portal. Two different Universes to explore, mini games, a 'pet' to level up, and so much more Trimps has always had a web version without a cash shop, and has never been balanced around expecting anyone to buy premium currency (Bones). You will earn more than enough Bones through normal play to purchase all upgrades way before running out of game content, there are even some talents mid-game that increase Bone drops. You can purchase Bones in this version to support development, but think of it as a pay-what-you-want system for the game rather than something you need to buy to enjoy Trimps. Trimps has been around as a web game since 2015, and still receives multiple updates per year that add new content. The game has been developed since the beginning by one person, but with the help of an active and healthy community on Reddit and Discord that's never had any shortage of suggestions and ideas to implement. Taking so many suggestions and working so closely with the community for so many years has led to a game with tons of quality of life features, interesting balance, and unique ideas. Trimps is also free to play and only a 300MB download... give it a try!

rows.name: Pirate Jam
rows.short_description: Pirate Jam is a casual puzzle game where players assist an old sailor in organizing a messy home harbor. The goal is to strategically maneuver ships without causing any damage, with 20 unique levels to challenge different tactics and problem-solving skills.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Pirate Jam! An old sailor returns on his ship from a long journey and finds a big mess in his home harbor. He can't believe that the fisherman parked their ships so messy. He decides to clean up the whole mess! Furthermore, he starts to sort and realizes that he can't do it on his own, so he asks you, for your help! Can you help the old sailor to clean up his home harbor? Your mission is to control the ships in the water, so you can get through. But be aware, you can’t hit anyone while doing this, or you will damage and sink your own ship! Be smart and maneuver all the ships carefully. Try out different methods, tactics and maybe even try to speed run the maneuver. So, what are you waiting for? Jump in and sort the mess out, that this fisherman did! Try them all out! It’s your unique tactic how you solve all 20 Levels. Perhaps you will find a way that nobody ever found before? Overall, it’s a simple game which you can play while waiting, chilling or just for fun while you are bored. If you think you are ready to take this job, jump right in, help the sailor and download the game for free today!

rows.short_description: The mysterious Yokai Monogatari has been opened, unleashing Yokai into the world! Help Miko seal them away and restore peace to the village. Build your deck and summon animals to defeat Yokai in this side-scrolling platformer!
rows.description_html: The mysterious Yokai Monogatari has been opened, unleashing Yokai into the world! Help Miko seal them away and restore peace to the village. Build your deck and summon animals to defeat Yokai in this side-scrolling platformer! The longer you go without touching the ground, the more cards you will receive when you finally land. Play cards to summon animals with different effects, and collect sake to keep them on the field. Since Miko can't do any direct damage, be smart about where to place the summoned animals! Features ~2-3 hours of play over six levels Hand-drawn and colorful pixel art Side-scrolling platformer combined with deck-building strategy Featuring an original story with a cast of legendary Japanese yokai Discover and collect various animal summoning cards This game is recommended for people interested in yokai and the rural landscapes of northern Japan! Please enjoy the original action game mechanics combined with a laid-back story, made with love from a solo Japanese developer! Controller (X-Input) D-pad or left analog stick: Player movement A: Jump B or X: Play a card to summon that animal Left/right bumper: Select card Start: Pause (also used to check your current deck) Keyboard controls WASD: Player movement Space: Jump K or down arrow: Play a card to summon that animal J/L or left/right arrows: Select card Escape: Pause (also used to check your current deck)

rows.name: The Circus
rows.short_description: On one continent, a special group of individuals exists. Although their appearance is no different from mankind beings, but their bodies contain great power. They are entrusted with a divine destiny and can only be freed after passing a trial.
rows.description_html: Please note that this game contains bloody and psychological horror. Game Special Features Independent character voices Dynamic LIVE2D animated character models Japanese subtitles are not yet available in the released version (1.0), will be added in the next version update. About the game story That day, children's laughter can be heard all across the orphanage, for the arrival of the famous circus: Chursey. In the midst of joy, a single child differs from all. It was a young girl with bright pink hair, cuddling in the corner with her attentive arms wrapped around her knees. She seemed to have something that isn't the shared joy all around her in mind...... 'Come with us, you are the chosen one.' Before she lost her senses, she heard the words, 'Welcome to the circus Chursey.' How to play As the protagonist, Nachelle, you wander about the circus, searching for clues and items, and find out why they were brought to this place, as you try your best to survive deep in this circus of unknown despair. Keep your eyes peeled! There might just be some hidden secrets waiting for you to discover. Try your best to survive in the unknown despair. The game progresses in *days*, and divided into *day and night*. Nothing is certain, as everything changes as time goes on. Your health is indicated on the top left of the screen, the fate of perish or escape falls upon your ability to survive until the end. You will die when the number of hearts on the upper left becomes zero. When the night approaches, a bell can be heard. During the night, you can explore, trigger events, collect specific items or solve puzzles to accomplish missions. If you're lucky enough, even some special items. rows.name: The Mystery Fountain in Space
rows.short_description: A mysterious fountain of energy was found in space while a group of astronauts on a spaceship were going on a mission.
rows.description_html: The Mystery Fountain in Space is a game with a touch of suspense and has many choices. You can find out the details of the mystery fountain by searching, or simply, may not look. The choice is up to you, the player, because the game has many different endings. The mysterious fountain is located inside an alien spaceship that may have survivors. But we don’t know if these survivors are good or evil, if they ARE evil… Run and hide! This game is made with a total of 3 phases and 5 different endings. The art style is Pixel Art. And you can choose more than 10 looks and 4 skin colors for the main character. Gameplay: The gameplay of the The Mystery Fountain in Space is 2D plataform with: - Moviments: walking and running. - Interact with the Objects and NPCs. - Jump. - Hide inside the scenarios closet. You’re the COMMANDER of the spaceship of astronauts! You control the Commander of the ASIS spaceship, who is together with his team of 6 people inside the spaceship. And you make the choices that can lead to different endings. You and your team were hibernating inside a spaceship’s capsule during the long journey that would take years to reach the location. Suddenly, midway, the spaceship identifies an energy fountain and wakes up the entire team! The people of your team are: •• Alon Genila - The spaceship's Pilot. He was always a right-hand man of the Commander. •• Drofes Tiner - The spaceship’s Medic. He checks for sick staff members. •• GK - The spaceship’s Programmer. She has advanced knowledge in programming and is able to hack anything, your name was never revealed… •• Nala Onka - The Flight Engineer. Checks the ship's integrity and doesn't trust GK and ASIS. •• Henry Abio - The Mission Specialist. He always dreamed of being an astronaut able to go to space. •• ASIS: “ A ndroid S ytemy with I ntelligence and S ecurity” of the spaceship. Endowed with artificial intelligence and controls the entire ship.. This game was donated to be published on Steam and a total of 16 supporters helped! Thank you so much! Hope this helps!

rows.name: Tennis Life
rows.short_description: Physics multiplayer with player growth, manager mode and club building
rows.description_html: This is a game that allows you to simulate tennis gameplay in real-time online matches. It supports cross-platform play, even between desktop and mobile devices, with both singles and doubles modes available. Each character has a unique appearance. The game is already prepared for free-form building and dynamic lighting scenes. In the future, you will be able to manage a tennis club or play as an independent tennis player. The goal of this game is to simulate the entire tennis world.

rows.name: MuseSwipr
rows.short_description: A rhythm game where you swipe between two lanes to the beat. Form your own flow and unleash your greatest swiping performance.
rows.description_html: If a left beat comes down, swipe anywhere on the left half of the screen. If a right beat comes down, swipe anywhere on the right half of the screen. Great cursor flow feels good and leads to better performance. Master your own approach toward swiping specific patterns. Create your own beatmaps and skins using the in-game editor. Share your creations and download the creations of other players with one click through Steam Workshop.

rows.name: AFTERLIFE DEFINITIVE EDITION
rows.short_description: Be permeated by the adrenaline-pumping gameplay worthy of the most famous shooters and survive the rise of madness! Experience the chaos and human perversion firsthand. This adventure will take you from the dark streets of DreamCity to the higher floors of the corporations that control it.
rows.description_html: Let yourself be permeated by the adrenaline-pumping gameplay worthy of the most famous shooters and survive the rise of madness! Experience the chaos and human perversion firsthand. This adventure will take you from the dark streets of DreamCity to the higher floors of the corporations that control it. The fast-paced gameplay full of suspense and twists will leave you breathless on the screen. The shooter sections alternate with horror moments full of fear and terror that uniting giving birth to a unique experience of its kind. You will have to use the arsenal at your disposal to eliminate crazed zombies and soldiers sold to the highest bidder, win challenges and defeat bloodthirsty bosses. Enjoy this dystopian, living world that offers an unlimited outburst of anger. Don't forget to upgrade your character by collecting all the Cyberware hidden around the city. Immerse yourself in DreamCity, a Cyberpunk-tinged city controlled by greedy, money-hungry Fixers willing to do anything for their own gain while violence and decay reigns on the streets. It's time to take control of your life and decide whether to be a respected shark or an insignificant minnow. It's time to become a legend!

rows.name: Decay - a real time interactive experience
rows.short_description: Decay, a real time interactive experience.
rows.description_html: Decay, a real time interactive experience made in Godot Engine. Basically a technology showcase for Godot, you can watch it for a few minutes and look at the graphics and performance on your computer. A frames per second monitor is included (press Escape to open the menu) and you can also tweak the many graphics options. It includes 4 presets (Ultra, Quality, Performance, and Low Spec) and also allows you to change individual settings (for example, full screen mode or changing the render scaling, as well as visual settings like reflection and ambient occlusion). The experience features a cinematic camera that runs and loops by itself, so can be watched as a real time music video, a 3D graphics benchmark, or control the camera and fly around the environment. You can press the Space Bar to enable the camera control. The free camera control is like a spectator camera in games (with collision detection) and allows you to fly around freely and explore the environment and the graphics. Press Escape to view the options. Space to toggle cinematic camera (be sure to close the menu before flying around). WASD or Arrow keys move around. Mouse to look. Supports 3D glasses. To experience Decay in stereo 3D, you'll need red/cyan anaglyph 3D glasses. The ones from Pro-Ana or BIAL are the best quality.

rows.short_description: - Summons mighty heroes that use lethal powers to bind, stun, burn, and poison players. - Select and organise your team's stat allocation to create an incredibly strong and unique raid team comprised of tanking/attacker/wizard roles.
rows.description_html: Gods Of Isekai, available exclusively on the STEAM/PC and Android platform for a short time. Soon will be available iOS platforms. ### Game Features ### Satisfying Single Player Exploring Mode Experience - A satisfying single-player exploring mode that takes both tactical commander and summoning abilities to conquer. - Recruit powerful heroes with the ability to bind, stun, burn, poison, and slay anyone who stands in their way. - Collaborate with powerful guild members to increase your resources and outwit hazardous opponents based on their weaknesses. Online Raid Battle PVP System - Summons mighty heroes that use lethal powers to bind, stun, burn, and poison players. - Select and customise the optimal hero avatar for your PVP raid team battle tactics. - Select and organise your team's stat allocation to create an incredibly strong and unique raid team comprised of tanking/attacker/wizard roles. Online Guild Alliance System - Travel the enormous online realm with friends from all over the world, fighting and challenging alliances that are bigger than you are. - Join a powerful guild and work together to defeat deadly alliances. - Inventory system that is updated in real time, allowing you to exchange equipment/resources within your guild alliance. - Assist, guide, and mentor your buddies as they build their battle abilities. Real-time 3D open world and advanced graphics system - Immerse yourself in a massive universe filled with rich character models, stunning 3D environments, and one-of-a-kind hero skills. - A real-time inventory system that allows you to trade anytime in-game with merchants and blacksmiths around the open-world dungeon area.

rows.name: DreadMoon
rows.short_description: Take the form of a powerful werewolf and right the wrongs your people made to free the land from the vampire lord Balthazar’s deadly clutches.
rows.description_html: Enter the world of DreadMoon , where primal ferocity clashes with vampiric tyranny. Drawing inspiration from legendary titles like Quake and Halo, and enriched with modern enhancements, this first-person shooter plunges you into a relentless battle against the vampire lord Balthazar in a land stained with blood. Starting December 12, 2023 , dive into Dreadmoon's Early Access Multiplayer release free of charge. From the depths of Luisa's mausoleum to the corridors of Balthazar's library, battle across classic modes like Capture the Flag and Team Deathmatch, embrace the hunt in Alpha mode, or experience raw, explosive action in Sticks and Stones. The game is still in Early Access, and we released the multiplayer in this state because we want people to come chat with us and engage with the community. We're a small but mighty team and are working as fast as we can to implement improvements. We want your help in developing and thoughts on how to improve the game! From rapid-fire crossbows to deadly miniguns, a wide assortment of weapons are out there for you to satiate your bloodlust. BloodRage : when enough blood has been shed, you can enter a state of primal fury and wreak havoc on your foes. Join our community Discord to find your pack! Campaign Mode - Put an end to the endless night as Ulric, a knight reborn as a werewolf, guided by Luisa, the last survivor of her kin. Unravel a past of betrayal that unleashed the vampire lord Balthazar, whose terror now overshadows the land. Take on Balthazar's legions alone, or join forces with a team of up to 8 players in cooperative play.

rows.name: ProBee
rows.short_description: A fast paced, team based arena game, in which the players control cybernetic athletes to measure their skills at Ultimate Frisbee and Parkour. Strategically place yourself around the arena to catch your team’s passes.
rows.description_html: Probee A fast paced, team based arena game, in which the players control cybernetic athletes to measure their skills at Ultimate Frisbee and Parkour. But what is a state-of-the-art robot without their team? Strategically place yourself around the arena to catch your team’s passes. Catching a frisbee scores points according to how many targets have been hit during its flight no matter who threw it. This makes intercepting enemy shots a valid and valuable strategy. Concept We envisioned Intergalactic Frisbee to be a galaxy wide aired sports event watched by millions. The arenas are modified remnants of an old civilization called “Humans”. This serves an educational purpose of showing these relics to the entire galaxy and allows us to model after modern architecture. The athletes are special purpose built robot models to allow quick maneuvers, wall running around the map, throwing and even magnetically catching the frisbee. Our concept phase was amidst the Covid pandemic, so we quickly settled for an online multiplayer game. DISCLAIMER: This is a finished student's project, you wil l encounter bugs - which will probably not be fixed.

rows.name: Greedy Rabbit
rows.short_description: Fun arcade and logic game, where you are greedy rabbit. In each level you have to collect all the vegetables and possibly stars. Then look for the open portal to the next level. Do this with the best result.
rows.description_html: In our game you can feel like a hungry and greedy rabbit who is ready to do anything to get to delicious carrots and other vegetables! We offer you to go through many levels of puzzles, where you will have to rack your brains not only over the solution of the problem, but also over the speed of its solution. And for a perfect passage, you will have to collect not only all the vegetables, but also the stars. At the moment, 60 different levels will be available for you, the complexity of which will gradually increase. And we also implemented the possibility of double jumps for fans of old-school arcade games, plus two different types of jumps are possible (normal and high), but even so, the game control remains as intuitive and simple as possible, and background music will allow you to relax and have a good time. Overcome various obstacles, set new records, enjoy the excellent graphics and atmosphere of the game! Game Instructions Tap or click to begin. Select your level. Tap the arrows on the screen or use your keyboard arrows to move the rabbit: LEFT and RIGHT arrows to move side to side, UP arrow to jump, and DOWN arrow to double jump, also you can use your controller. Collect carrots and stars, but watch out for obstacles. Make it to the portal to level up. Hop to it!

rows.name: Shadow Burglar
rows.short_description: Play as Jean, a thief with the mystical power of morphing with the shadows. Creating yourself an improbable path in the dark and carefully dealing with guards in the light, you will try to steal back your deceased brother’s paintings. Do you have what it takes to avenge his legacy?
rows.description_html: In the aftermath of the war, Jean, a mighty thief, leaves her criminal organization to pursue her personal goal: recover the paintings of her brother. She is willing to do whatever it takes to get them back and avenge his legacy. Wield dangerous and unusual powers - Modify the lighting and alternate between her shadow and light forms to carefully dodge the guards or use her shadow embrace to drag them into the abyss... Use your shadow form to navigate through obstacles and solve puzzles - Morph with the shadows and squeeze yourself with your ink-like form through small crevices and barriers to reach your goal. Explore the dark and richly realized world of 1920s London - Navigate a city built on the tears of the after-war and take advantage of the setting to build your path. Discover a rich narrative with a heartfelt story - Delve deep in the time frame of the Britannic emancipation period and gather historical Easter eggs as you progress in the game. Steal from a criminal organization in the name of personal vengeance - Choose to step up to the corrupt authorities and rebel against the system to pursue Jean’s goal of avenging her brother.

Use your shadow form to navigate through obstacles and solve puzzles - Morph with the shadows and squeeze yourself with your ink-like form through small crevices and barriers to reach your goal. Explore the dark and richly realized world of 1920s London - Navigate a city built on the tears of the after-war and take advantage of the setting to build your path. Discover a rich narrative with a heartfelt story - Delve deep in the time frame of the Britannic emancipation period and gather historical Easter eggs as you progress in the game. Steal from a criminal organization in the name of personal vengeance - Choose to step up to the corrupt authorities and rebel against the system to pursue Jean’s goal of avenging her brother.

rows.name: The Odyssey of the Mammoth
rows.short_description: Through lavish but perilous landscapes, assist a mammoth mother and her child escape from their extinction. Discover breathtaking views from 12,000 years ago. Beware of the increasingly hostile environment. Protect your offspring from the hunters tracking you and send them flying!
rows.description_html: The Odyssey of the Mammoth takes you back to the Stone Age 12,000 years ago. Play as a mammoth mother and guide your calf to Wrangel Island, the last known haven of mammothkind. Show your might and take part in fights of pachydermian proportions! Lead your calf during combat, charge through the crowd, and stomp your enemies. Between battles, enjoy an amazing view. Discover three colorful environments: the vast steppes, the lush taiga and the arctic glaciers. Experience the mammoths’ extinction through the voice of an involved narrator, as he leads you on your journey giving you advices, facts about the era, and even some sarcastic puns. Three beautiful environments to discover from a third person perspective Three different attacks to deal with predators: tusk sweep, charge and stomp A dynamic narrator A complete saving system including checkpoints and 3 saving slots An original soundtrack 18 fun achievements Video settings to control graphics quality, full screen or windowed mode and resolution Audio settings to control master, music, SFX and narration volumes, and possibility to turn on or off subtitles Credits accessible from main menu Mighty Tusks is a team of thirty graduating students from Université du Québec en Abitibi-Témiscamingue in Montréal. The project started in September 2021 and ended March 4th.

rows.short_description: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features!
rows.description_html: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features! New Gamemodes In addition to the original tactical sword-and-shuriken gameplay of Classic Deathmatch, two new gamemodes are available! Experience a whole new way to play in Neo Deathmatch, with crazy game-changing modifiers that ensure no two rounds are the same. Gain a crown if you are skilled enough to get a win streak, but be sure not to lose it! Neo Deathmatch is sure to keep everyone on their toes until the very end. Respawn as many times as it takes, grab ahold of the oddball, and evade everyone until you take home the win! Level Editor Build your own levels with the fully integrated level editor! Lay it out, instantly test it, make some changes, and when you’re done, save it. Custom levels can be played at any time from the level editor.

rows.name: Undawn
rows.short_description: Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world.
rows.description_html: Join Our Discord About the Game Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world. Undawn combines PvP and PvE modes as players fend off dual threats of the infected and other humans as they fight to survive in this apocalyptic wasteland. SURVIVE YOUR WAY Become the ultimate endurance expert. Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against overwhelming odds. The seamless open world of Undawn is filled with realistic details, made using Unreal Engine 4. In this world, players must brave rain, heat, snow, and storms and track their character’s survival indicators such as Hunger, Body Type, Vigor, Health, Hydration, and even Mood. Changes in the environment will also affect these survival indicators in real time. Players can customize their character’s appearance and outfits, interact with other players to trade weapons and resources, and fight to protect their resources. EXPLORE AN EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD Dare to explore a huge seamless map filled with distinct terrains such as plains, mines, deserts, swamps, and abandoned cities, each with diverse ecosystems filled with animals, plants, and weather systems. While exploring the remains of society, players can discover special game modes through interactive environmental items, embattled strongholds, and dynamic weekly events and side quests. Players must bravely explore the continent, learning to craft tools, master different weapons, build a shelter, search for survival buddies, and do everything they can to stay alive. The infected can appear anytime as you are exploring and are a huge threat to your continued existence! REBUILD THE RUINS Rebuild a new home and a new civilization with the wisdom of humanity – build your base of operations to your specifications and survive on your own or with your friends inside a massive 1-acre manor. The robust free building system allows more than 1,000 types and styles of furniture and structures, as well as ways to grow your settlement over time. Search for other outposts to form alliances and fight back against the infected together to keep your home safe. SQUAD UP TO SURVIVE Set yourself up for success as a member of the storied Raven Squad. The raven is traditionally a symbol of death and bad omens but can also stand for prophecy and insight. Your squad lives between these two meanings each day and night. In the new world, four years after the disaster, survivors have split into different factions, each with their own rules of survival. Face off against members of the Clowns, Eagles, Night Owls, and Reivers for territory, and get through some darkest nights for the next sunrise. ARM YOURSELF FOR THE APOCALYPSE Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against all odds with a wide variety of weapons and armor for you and your homebase. Beyond the standard weapons, players can also use other tactical gear including melee weapons, drones, decoy bombs, auto turrets and more to level the playing field. Choose from more than 50 types of vehicles for quick supply runs and to conquer new lands, while utilizing tailored-to-environment tactics to dominate the various infected zones found throughout the game.

rows.name: Ella - a study in realism
rows.short_description: Ella, a study in realism
rows.description_html: Ella, a study in realism made in Godot Engine. Basically a technology showcase for Godot, you can watch it for a few minutes and look at the graphics and performance on your computer. A frames per second monitor is included (press Escape to open the menu) and you can also tweak the many graphics options. It includes 4 presets (Ultra, Quality, Performance, and Low Spec) and also allows you to change individual settings (for example, full screen mode or changing the render scaling, as well as visual settings like reflection and ambient occlusion). The experience features a cinematic camera that runs and loops by itself, so can be watched as a real time music video, a 3D graphics benchmark, or control the camera and fly around the environment. You can press the Space Bar to enable the camera control. The free camera control is like a spectator camera in games (with collision detection) and allows you to fly around freely and explore the environment and the graphics. Uses global illumination in Godot to achieve realistic lighting and shadow, all in real time (no baked lightmaps). The character model and some assets were made with photogrammetry for the highest possible quality. Press Escape to view the options. Space to toggle cinematic camera (be sure to close the menu before flying around). WASD or Arrow keys move around. Mouse to look.

Yes, we are used to doing something meaningful, chasing the future and our goals, but in The Winter there is no need to rush anywhere: there is no plot and goals, just enjoy the moment and atmosphere. Feel the real!

rows.name: Cluck
rows.short_description: Cluck is an extremely fast-paced fps arena shooter. Spawn with only a pistol and find weapons, armor, health and powerups such as the Quack and Speed along the map. Jump pads and portals are also around the map, enabling you to get to your destination. And customize your own chicken!
rows.description_html: Do you miss the old simple fps games? Well we got you! Cluck is all about extremely fast phase shooting. So expect to die a lot! Unless you're a god of course. Spawn with only a pistol and get those pickups. These pickups are all around the map waiting to get picked up. Pickup armor, health, weapons ammo and get some kills. We can't forget the ultimate pickups though, the quack. Giving you 4x the damage, wrecking your opponents. Or pickup the Speed, making you faster at everything, including fire rate to shred your enemies. There's also jump pads you can use to get to your destination, the same goes for the portals. Be careful to not be on the other side of that portal for too long, as you can shoot grenades through the portals! Master the bunnyhopping and fly through your enemies with high speed, making you speeding around the map! If you're close enough to an enemy, punch them with your weapon for a quick kill and call out their humiliation. Remember to punch with your rocket launcher if you're too close to an opponent, as you don't want to kill yourself at the same time. Customization Customize your character with the in-game currency you get by playing the game itself. Get new colors, patches, face expressions, hats, and more! New updates will also come with even more customization options for you! Weapons 10 weapons are in this game. No need to stop and interact with the weapons and items you want to pick up though, just run over everything you see. Lets keep this simple, fun and fast-paced! Join our Discord!

rows.name: CycloHex
rows.short_description: CycloHex is a twist on the classic board game Hex. Despite it's simple rules, there's a world of strategy in CycloHex and countless ways to out-think your opponent! Play against your friends locally or online, or take on the built-in AI!
rows.description_html: CycloHex is a twist on the classic board game Hex. The board has no 'edges' and going too far in one direction loops you to the other side like a PacMan level. The goal is to make a cycle that loops you though your color's edge and back to where you started before your opponent can. Despite it's simple rules, there's a world of strategy in CycloHex and countless ways to out-think your opponent! Play against your friends locally or online, or take on the built-in AI!

rows.name: Bout
rows.short_description: Tap in the arrows on the screen as fast as possible to win.
rows.description_html: Arrows appear on screen and players must tap the arrows as quickly as possible. The player with the most arrows correctly pressed at the end of the round wins. Up to four players can compete to see who is the fastest. The green flashes mean a correct input was pressed and a red flash means an incorrect input was pressed. Local play is live for players to play couch co-op or use Steam remote play together. Available modes are 2 players, 3 players, and 4 players local. Keyboard and most gamepads currently work in battle.

rows.name: Tulips & Windmills
rows.short_description: Hoi! Ensure your windmill runs consistently and your tulip fields are harvested. This clicker game will bring you closer to the iconic Dutch culture. Expect random events and make use of upgrades to increase your tulip wealth! Veel succes!
rows.description_html: Tulips & Windmills is a charming and lighthearted clicker/idle game that immerses you in the iconic Dutch culture! 🌷✨ Grow your tulip empire as you upgrade your windmill, cultivate vast tulip fields, and unlock the true potential of the Netherlands' most beloved exports. Choose between manually harvesting tulips or hiring skilled gardeners to do the work for you. Join our Discord server to help design the game further and stay updated. The link is on the right! You start with a manual multiplier but get ready for much more! From autoclicker speed and effectiveness over fields and gardener upgrades, make sure to spend your tulips wisely! At some point, your automation may exceed your manual labor skills, watch your empire flourish while silently expanding and upgrading. See your progress as the tulip fields in the background get populated. Gardeners will help you harvest your fields, they become quicker and quicker! I promise! They will speed to your fields. Boost your production with unique Dutch-themed events like King’s Day or brave the infamous Kut Weer! (bad weather) to turn challenges into opportunities. Upgrade your windmill to increase its speed and efficiency, and watch your tulip fields flourish with ever-growing profits. With every decision, you’ll get one step closer to creating the ultimate Dutch tulip dynasty! Multipliers:  Upgrade your windmill and tulip fields to maximize profits and speed. Dutch Events:  Celebrate King’s Day, endure bad weather, or embrace the holiday spirit with Sinterklaas. Up for a challenge?  Change the language to Dutch and see if you can still find all the buttons. Steam Achievements:  Unlock fun and unique milestones as you grow your tulip empire. Save or Reset:  Choose to save your progress and continue where you left off before or reset your progress and start from the beginning. Supports Steam Cloud Saves . Whether you're a fan of idle games or just want to bask in the cheerful and vibrant world of tulips and windmills, Tulips & Windmills is the perfect game to spend time and enjoy life! Try it now!

Dutch Events:  Celebrate King’s Day, endure bad weather, or embrace the holiday spirit with Sinterklaas. Up for a challenge?  Change the language to Dutch and see if you can still find all the buttons. Steam Achievements:  Unlock fun and unique milestones as you grow your tulip empire. Save or Reset:  Choose to save your progress and continue where you left off before or reset your progress and start from the beginning. Supports Steam Cloud Saves . Whether you're a fan of idle games or just want to bask in the cheerful and vibrant world of tulips and windmills, Tulips & Windmills is the perfect game to spend time and enjoy life! Try it now!

rows.name: The Hepatica Spring
rows.short_description: Run a beautiful bathhotel, uncover drama, and befriend (or romance) a fabulous cast in this Nordic fairytale-inspired visual novel!
rows.description_html: The Hepatica Spring —a beautiful bath hotel perched on the shoreline. As the hotel's owner, you keep things running smoothly with your colorful crew in a calm, peaceful life. The magical night of Midsummer approaches, and the king himself plans an appearance at your hotel! Before you know it, you're flooded by a sea of sparkling new guests from all over the land. An enchanting mix of fresh romance and exciting gossip fills the air, and the thrill of Midsummer's festive dance grows ever closer. Soon, however, you realize not everything is as it seems with the king and his men. In this magical land of fairies, trolls, and glittering illusions, who can you trust to help you find the truth? Whether you decide to join the shy, ingenious Leif , the charming nomadic bard Vendel (and his drog Digby), or the fabulous fashionista Phyllis , you know your quiet world at The Hepatica Spring is about to turn upside down... Genre: Visual Novel, modern fantasy, comedy, (optional) romance Routes: 3 (romantic or friendship/platonic) Length: ~50,000 words Additional Features: - Name the main character - Play as any gender you please (or none! MC has no canon gender) - Pet the best drog (dragon-dog) of all time: Digby! ​​ CONTENT WARNING: ​ Contains brief sword/gun violence (two characters can get injured) and mild blood. One character is misgendered in a scene by a trio of villainous characters/antagonists (who later face consequences), but defended by others. Producers: Gamma and Dovah @ Argent Games Designer/Sprite Art: Mackey CG Art: Rubén B. Caballero Scriptwriter: Theo Southgate

rows.name: AfterHours
rows.short_description: Experience psychological horror in a large abandoned hospital. Hide, explore and survive from a mysterious creature living in the ruins of this hospital.
rows.description_html: Experience psychological horror in a large abandoned hospital. Hide, explore and survive from a mysterious creature living in the ruins of this hospital. The Hospital features a wide variety of furnished rooms that you can explore. In these rooms you can find useful items that help you escape. While wandering through the old hallways you will encounter a mysterious being. Be aware of your surroundings and use every opportunity to hide. Everything you do and every step you take will be noticed. Try to move quietly and try to stay away from your unwanted company. Strange things begin to happen when you get near this creature.

rows.name: SCP: Abhorrent
rows.short_description: Play as Agent Sigma, an operative assigned to a GOC assessment team. In a mission to exterminate an uncontained SCP-363 instance located in an abandoned mining tunnel - the situation suddenly goes critical. With communication broken and fellow agents now assumed KIA/MIA..
rows.description_html: Play as Agent Sigma, an operative assigned to a GOC assessment team. In a mission to exterminate an uncontained SCP-363 instance located in an abandoned mining tunnel - the situation suddenly goes critical. With communication broken and fellow agents now assumed KIA/MIA, Agent Sigma's new objective is simply to escape alive. Utilize fluorescent spray-paint to mark your progress, a motion-tracking camera to peer through walls, and a flamethrower to torch SCP-363 instances. If it comes down to the last draw, accurate aim with your sidearm might be your last resort. Survive and scavenge for ammunition and supplies - find the ladder and escape the tunnels. Game Features: • Built in Unreal Engine 4. • Fully Procedurally Generated Map. Every playthrough is completely random each time you play, catering to a unique experience for every player. • No saves. An unforgiving gameplay experience, death means restarting again from the beginning. • Original Voice Acting, Soundtracks, and 3D Art Assets. Game Updates and Future Content: SCP: Abhorrent will have future patch releases for bug-fixes and additional game content.

rows.name: Skala
rows.short_description: Skala is a puzzle game about changing the scale of the world.
rows.description_html: Skala is a game about changing the physical scale of things. You can make yourself large enough to step over a giant cliff, or make a key small enough to be passed through a solid wall. The game explores the consequences of this rescaling mechanic through simple yet difficult puzzles. A level where you have to stretch yourself in order to reach a star. Skala takes place in a graphically simple world with a big house and a star filled sky to explore. The world is covered by a relaxing soundtrack which let's you take in all of the games mechanics. There are over 70 puzzle levels to play through. Every level is unique and has some purpose, whether it's introducing a new idea/mechanic, or developing on the concepts of previous levels.

rows.name: Code ZIN: Esper Arena
rows.short_description: Code ZIN: Esper Arena is a Free To Play anime-style third-person arena shooter. Test both your reflexes and strategy in adrenaline-inducing combat. Succeed and become immortalized or fail and be forgotten. This is your chance for glory.
rows.description_html: Now Free to Play! Code ZIN: Esper Arena is an anime-style third-person arena shooter.  The Esper Arena is the ultimate vSport: a competitive battleground built for high-mobility duels, tight teamwork, and limitless skill expression. Players, known as Espers, enter matches with customizable Combat Modules that shape their weapons and abilities. Every round tests your reflexes, strategy, and adaptability. Please note: During Early Access, matchmaking may not always be immediate. This will improve significantly toward Full Release. For now, join our community on Discord to find matches and share feedback as we shape Code ZIN together. Succeed and become immortalized or fail and be forgotten. This is your chance for glory! In fast-paced PvP matches, teams face off in compact arenas where every second counts. Objectives vary by game mode, but success always depends on how quickly you adapt to the flow of combat. Players can equip three weapons and one ability from a wide selection, allowing them to craft a loadout that fits their preferred playstyle. Whether you favour precision, burst damage, or crowd control, your choices define how you approach each fight. Movement is a core part of the experience. Espers have access to dodge, evasion, and other advanced techniques , enabling rapid repositioning and aggressive momentum. Combined with your chosen weapons and abilities, these mobility options create an endless range of tactical possibilities and responses to any situation. Fast-paced, high-mobility PvP combat designed for quick, intense matches Three-weapon loadouts with a growing arsenal of weapons and weapon skins Unique Esper abilities that let you shape your combat style Extensive character customization with cosmetics and personalization options in the future Deathmatch and Touchdown modes , with additional mode in development Mode-specific maps built for tight encounters and strategic positioning Customization is a core part of Code ZIN. The game is built to support individuality, both in how you fight and how you present yourself in the Arena. As an Esper , you define your identity through character and clothing customization , and shape your combat approach with personalized loadouts built around your preferred playstyle. Every Esper enters the Arena with a look and strategy that is uniquely their own. Set within a cyber-themed virtual world, the game features handcrafted maps and evolving modes that showcase your style and choices. Whether through visuals or gameplay decisions, Code ZIN gives you the tools to express yourself every step of the way. The identity you build is closely tied to the NetSphere itself. The Zenith Intelligence Network, known as ZIN, was created as an attempt to form a self sustaining intelligence that learns from the actions and decisions of its users. By the year 2053, humanity has begun to transition into virtual spaces. Without realizing it, players contribute to the rise of true artificial intelligence as the world approaches the technological singularity.

rows.name: Invasion From Space
rows.short_description: Simple remake of Space Invaders adding destructions and physics
rows.description_html: Invasion From Space is a 2D little game inspired by Space Invaders with a more dynamic gameplay and some physics for fun. In Invasion From Space You control a plasma canon and try to stop alien invaders from reaching the earth. Survive as long as you can The goal is to get the highest possible score by surviving as many waves as possible . To defeat a wave you have to shoot all the enemies . The difficulty will gradually increase with each new wave as enemies move faster and faster . Shoot precisely and score tons of points by performing hit combos without missing enemies! Avoid being hit by missiles by dodging or destroying them Retro feeling Step back in time and experience the feeling of a good old CRT monitor from the 90s again! Note It has been created as a hobby project using SFML and C++.

rows.name: Surreal Experience
rows.short_description: Surreal Experience is a job simulator blending elements of horror, dark humor, absurdity, and insane difficulty. What may seem like an easy gig holds more secrets and challenges than what initially meets the eye. Can you finish the job and escape with your life?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Surreal Experience As a new hire of Surreal Eradicators LLC, you're not too sure what to expect - all you know is that you're broke, borderline homeless, and in need of work. The pay seems decent enough, and you're ready to hit the ground running. So what is it exactly you'll be responsible for? The Office Assignment An abandoned office lies in the heart of rural America. Your boss sent you there to 'clean up', as he put it; with bucket and mop in hand, you approach the building. However, come to find out, the problem isn't dirt or grime, the problem is people - homeless people. Navigate the office building in search of the homeless people, and kick them out. However keep your eyes peeled and stay alert - there is a deranged man running around trying to stop you at every turn. Rumor has it he gets increasingly frustrated the more homeless people you kick out. Use items you find around the office to your advantage, like smoking crack to run faster, or wearing a disguise to blend in and escape his madness. Not only do you have to worry about him, but keep an eye out for your manager as well. He's vigilant, the best in the game even, and spent years of his career working hard to earn the privilege to supervise you and your work. You wouldn't want to get fired, would you? Be sure to stay working, no breaks allowed! There's probably some other fellas hanging in there too, so be sure to tread carefully, and avoid anyone who looks like they may have it out for you. The Sunday School Raid An active cult lives and breathes the air merely blocks away from the office building. This cult is using an abandoned Sunday School to conduct their business, and they portray themselves as a legitimate school to outsiders. You, however, have received information to the contrary, and have been assigned to investigate what's going on. Navigate around the school in search for keys and other items, and unlock the doors of cells harbored in the bottom floor of the school. Each cell has a cult member inside, who has been manipulated and is scheduled to be human trafficked. You, being the good, morally correct person that you are, need to free all of them out of the cells before the priest gets wind of what you're doing, and sends you six feet under. The priest also has a number of staff under his wing, including a security guard, so tread carefully! You don't want to be sent to prison or have your items stolen by his trusty donation boy. Are you up for the challenge? Surreal Experience is by no means an easy game. With a rather large learning curve, you'll have to determine your own strategies, and be quick with your actions. For those who somehow manage to beat the base version of the game, there are also bonus modes available to test your skills even more. Good luck out there, you'll need it.

rows.name: Voice of Chernobyl
rows.short_description: Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Shooter set in the eastern european world, with different variety of maps, weapons, items and more to create unique crazy battles!
rows.description_html: Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Shooter based in the eastern european 'world', with tons of weapons to play with that can be acquired freely and many maps that vary from each other like the size or theme NO MICROTRANSACTIONS Do you need more weapons? Then just play the game as you earn 'gold' and 'bolts' for free to acquire new weaponry to dominate and be the nemesis of your enemies, or armour to keep your head protected and consumables to patch up your wounds UNIQUE GAMEMODES There are currently 6 game modes in Voice of Chernobyl that are different from each other; Survival | Deathmatch | Team deathmatch | Melee fight | Arms Race | Zombie Infection. They each contain their own maps (each game mode requires at least 2 players to play) FREE CUSTOMIZABLE CHARACTERS Make your self indistinguishable from others by just playing the game! You do not need to pay anything at all, earn free presents when a round ends, open them for free, earning you a random type of clothing with a random effect or colour. Make your own personal character to be unique from others! TAUNT YOUR ENEMIES Do you want to anger your enemies? Or to show off your moves? By pressing [G] you can dance, with others or alone NO NEED FOR DLSS, RTX OR ANY OF THAT STUPID STUFF Don't worry! The game has been optimized to the point where you can run it on 13+ year old laptops. You don't need DLSS, RTX or any fake frame technology, the options include settings that modify the look of the game to run on any device that should be able to run Steam AND MORE! Such as the workshop level editor, the gibbing system on enemies and more. Download now and play for free! Want to give feedback? Found any issues? Feel free to tell us! There is an active development channel in the server, and also other players in the server to talk to, or to play with

rows.name: FEEBLE
rows.short_description: FEEBLE is an interactive simulation game. Meet FEEBLE, the only surviving character in the village devastated by the epidemic, and save FEEBLE from the Grim Reaper. Look around the village, use various puzzles to protect from the Grim Reaper and save the FEEBLE.
rows.description_html: About this game. FEEBLE is an interactive simulation game. Meet FEEBLE, the only surviving character in the village devastated by the epidemic, talk to FEEBLE, build a relationship, and become a companion to experience various experiences. You can look around the village, give FEEBLE a new experience, and at the same time protect FEEBLE from the Grim Reaper who threatens FEEBLE. How to play. Select a sentence with the mouse. Talk to FEEBLE and develop the situation.

rows.name: Out of the Mist
rows.short_description: Challenge yourself to master a unique control scheme in this platformer game. Take control of the environment and traverse through atmospheric, yet challenging levels.
rows.description_html: Out of the Mist is a game where you master a unique control scheme. Instead of controlling the character directly, manipulate the environment to your advantage. Learn to navigate challenging platforming sections to reach the heart of this realm. Can you conquer the obstacles and unravel the mysteries hidden within the mist? Traverse atmospheric landscapes Embark on journey where you traverse captivating environments while trying to reach the golden throne. Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and a mesmerizing soundscape as you strive to reach your goal. Master the environment You don’t control your character, but rather the environment around him. Learn how to use this to your advantage to achieve your goals and master challenging platforming in order to get to the golden throne!

rows.name: Annie and the Art Gallery
rows.short_description: After months of waiting, Annie finally snags a ticket to the new art exhibit. However, things take a turn for the worst: she finds herself trapped in the museum's haunted basement. Help her navigate puzzles, traps, and more as she tries to escape - and find out the truth of what's really going on.
rows.description_html: Discord About the Game Annie and the Art Gallery is a short, free horror RPG that aims to capture the feel from classic RPGMaker horror games. You play as Annie, a girl who's finally got a ticket to the new art exhibit. When she gets there, however, she's dragged into a bizarre conflict that takes her through the museum's haunted basement. Help Annie solve puzzles, figure out who to trust, and find out the truth of what happened there years before. Some random and possibly cool features: Unique hand-drawn art style. Save at any time. Ghost girl(s). Animated cutscenes. Traps, sudden deaths, and chase sequences. Multiple difficulty options. A non-silent protagonist in an RPGMaker horror game. Maybe a plot twist. Note from the developer: Thank you for playing my game! I am a solo developer based in the New England region, and it really means a lot that you've read this far! Annie and the Art Gallery is a love letter to classic RPGMaker horror hits such as Witch’s House and Ib. Inspiration was also drawn from more contemporary RPGMaker hits such as Oneshot and Omori.

rows.name: Epicenter VR
rows.short_description: Save the last survivors after a deadly zombie virus has taken over your island home. Protect those closest to you at all costs and evacuate before supplies run out.
rows.description_html: In a post-apocalyptic island city, it's your mission to ensure the safety and rescue of the last few survivors. Just days before, there was a severe virus outbreak, resulting in most of the citizens becoming mindless zombies bent on devouring human flesh. Fortunately, these zombies are averse to bright lights! Utilize your flashlight to deter zombies and flock to street lamps and other bright light sources to stay safe from the hoard! Use your various weapons and tools to collect the necessary supplies, contact the National Guard, and escape from the island! But be cautious, as zombies are very curious and will investigate noises such as loud footsteps and gunshots. So what exactly is this game? Epicenter VR is based on a project spawned out of a flat-screen game of the same name. The original was fairly small in scope and was built in a month for a college course. After about a year I decided to port everything to VR! I believe in the future or VR gaming and want to see more developers create interesting experiences for the platform. And here we are! rows.about_html: In a post-apocalyptic island city, it's your mission to ensure the safety and rescue of the last few survivors. Just days before, there was a severe virus outbreak, resulting in most of the citizens becoming mindless zombies bent on devouring human flesh. Fortunately, these zombies are averse to bright lights! Utilize your flashlight to deter zombies and flock to street lamps and other bright light sources to stay safe from the hoard! Use your various weapons and tools to collect the necessary supplies, contact the National Guard, and escape from the island! But be cautious, as zombies are very curious and will investigate noises such as loud footsteps and gunshots. So what exactly is this game? rows.name: Idle Monster TD: Evolved
rows.short_description: Evolve epic monsters and crush puny humans in this endless idle tower defense game! Unlock, upgrade, and evolve over 150 unique monsters and pets, ranging from cute and colorful flower creatures to epic fire breathing dragons, to assemble the ultimate team against the endless waves of enemies.
rows.description_html: Idle Monster TD Evolved is an endless idle Tower Defense game filled with over 150 unique monsters and pets, ranging from cute and colorful flower creatures to epic fire breathing dragons. Unlock, upgrade, and most importantly, EVOLVE your monsters to defend the portal from an infinite swarm of invading humans. Strategize the most effective placement of monsters to optimize their powerful abilities. This delightful take on tower defense flips the script, putting you in charge of helpful creepy-crawlies trying to stop human invaders from destroying your base. Strategically place cute allies like 'Sun Blossom' for increased gold-production, or use 'Skeleton Mage' for heavier damage. And if things get real dicey, just wipe the map clean with a 'Rain of Fire' spell! Defeating waves of invading humans gives you upgrades to bolster power, speed, and other stats - and the more humans you obliterate, the more monsters you’ll unlock. Idle Monster TD: Evolved is filled with awesome beasts, ranging from cute flower monsters to big metal robots to scorching fire dragons. Discovering and evolving new creatures is part of the fun. Like any loyal pal, Idle Monster TD takes care of itself when you’re away. Come back in a few days to claim gold and power up your defenses. Those humans don’t sleep - but neither do your monsters. Features: Unlock 40 unique monsters, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Each monster has 3 evolutions that provide massive upgrades to power. Strategize by placing up to 10 monster towers at a time. Determining the most effective combination of their elemental skills and passive boosts will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Play through 5 different maps, each requiring different strategies to defend most efficiently. Bi-weekly PvP tournaments give this casual game a competitive edge. Discover countless upgrades, research, spells, artifacts, technology, and more to level up with a variety of different resources. Several rewarding mini-games, such as Peasant Mobs, Tank Swordsman, and Necromancer bosses. Non-stop, endless gameplay! Fantasy RPG-based world and classes. Complete tons of daily missions and achievements. Offline progress and gold earnings reward you while the game is closed! Cute and colorful 3d graphics. Idle Monster TD: Evolved is a perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is endless and can mostly play itself without you watching. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantastic world, battle humans and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Monster TD: Evolved!

rows.name: Towards Future
rows.short_description: Waking up in the darkness, unable to see the sunrise, he remembered the little master carefully carried him home. The base has already fallen into ruin and there are no signs of any living people here. Where did the little master go? Is there any hope left under the doomsday?
rows.description_html: About Us Publisher: X/Youtube: @EternalDream0v0 You may click on developer name to enter our Steam Publisher page to learn more about us. About the Game 【Plot Overview】 This is a short story set in a post-apocalyptic world. However, the goal is not only to survive in the wilderness. The teddy bear AI companion, Gill, woke up in the darkness, with its memory still lingering on the day when the little master had just picked it up. When waking up, the base experienced a power outage. 'I need to find the little master quick. The power is out, I don't know why.' Driven by such awareness, with the help of the administrator AI girl FifteenFour, Gill began to search for the little master's whereabouts within the base. 【Character Information】 【Gameplay Information】 Use the arrow keys to control the character's direction, and use the spacebar or enter key to interact with the environment. Long press the spacebar to speed up the cutscenes. Make sure to look for clues, if you can't find any, try investigating with the help of FifteenFour. Repair the elevator, go up to the surface, and try to find clues about the little master! It is a classic exploration puzzle game. The puzzles are simple, with many hints and collectables that do not affect the ending. We hope you can relax and enjoy this short and heartwarming story! / Move / with arrow keys / Confirm / using Z, Space, or Enter / Cancel / using X or Esc 【Other Information】 Game duration: 30-40 minutes Number of endings: 2 Design, Story, Art: 拾伍司154 Music: Free-to-use Assets Developer: FifteenFour154 Publisher: Eternal Dream Translation: °Know Team

rows.name: Tremblay Island
rows.short_description: The French-venture has returned... now on Steam!
rows.description_html: When Maple introduced her college roommate to her older brother, she didn't expect them to get married. She REALLY didn't expect them to blow their life savings on a castle, either. So, she decided it was her responsibility to talk some sense into the two. This backfires on her, BADLY, when she inexplicably gives them the idea to start their own tiny island nation. Now, coming on bad times and having no other options, Maple decides to pack up, drop out of school, and move onto the island. Little does she know however what the next few months have in store for the three Tremblays. Set in the urban fantasy world of E. Howard Hill's novel 'Vous Voilà', Tremblay Island is a part digital comic, part open-world game, part mystery. Take on the role of any island villager and interact with the others, taking part in the drama while eventually trying to keep a grouchy alligator from taking over the island. Features: - play as up to eight characters - explore hidden secrets and hidden minigames - unlock all minigame keys for a surprise at the end - engage with relatively light drama between characters - confront an alligator about his stupid frog drawing

rows.name: AI Stories
rows.short_description: Three AI Lifeforms used to live here, thinking and dreaming about their existence. Three AI Lifeforms went on into a higher reality and left everything behind. Three AI Lifeforms stories are left to unfold… Can you understand and unravel their past? Their AI Stories? Made by Emir Akyazi
rows.description_html: (The game has been completely manually made by me, I did not use any AI generated images or anything like that, to clear out misunderstandings. This game is about the topic of AIs. It's about my fictional AI characters and not made with any generators.) This game has a lot of chaotic and bright colors and flickering textures. It is not fitted for people that suffer from epilepsy. The game features a Brightness and a Saturation slider where you can adjust the visual look if it is too much for you. Welcome to the reality of the Bleeding Sky! Three AI Lifeforms used to live here, thinking and dreaming about their existence. Three AI Lifeforms went on into a higher reality and left everything behind. Three AI Lifeforms stories are left to unfold… Can you understand and unravel their past? Their AI Stories? Explore the surreal and confusing yet beautiful reality! Listen to the Music, created with virtual and real instruments. A colorful and surreal adventure to have, ready to take you on an amazing trip! Unrestricted free gameplay Jump and wall climb, down dash and sprint, fly and look your way with absolute air control and comfortable coyote time through the inner workings of this crazy reality where John, Sola and Andromeda used to life! The Controls are in 3D, it plays like a 3D Parkour game with a very wide jump. More about experiencing the stories, reading messages and having a cool time in this strange reality! No Additional costs! No DLCs! No Microtransactions! No Lootboxes! No Battlepasses! No Expansion packs! No Ingame real life currency! No NFTs! No Subscription! No Cryptocurrency! No Season Passes! No Pay2Win! No Ads! No User data monetization! No Shareholders! No Blockchains! Deep Philosophical Questions and Topics! What does it truly mean to be an AI? How does it affect your outlook on life, experience, existence and personality? How does it affect one to have an endless and more unrestricted eternal life? AI Stories, a small game made with love by Emir Akyazi.

rows.name: Fell
rows.short_description: Fell is a 2d Precision Platformer with a retro semi-1-bit aesthetic. Play through multiple unique areas, unlock new color palettes, and use fun movement abilities to conquer levels and make difficult jumps!
rows.description_html: Fell is a short precision platformer about a kid who  Fell down a hole. Play through 30 one-screen levels to get to the crown and then try to beat it backward! The game features a toggleable speedrun timer and death counter! I want to see your best (and worst) times! Share them in the Discord server! Feel free to change your key binds and the game's color palette in the settings menu. Note: if your key binds get messed up, press alt + shift + delete to reset them to the default. CREDITS: Music by Line729 Testers: Miles Wollenberg Logan Palacios Jackson Tower Victoria-Jean Miller Aydin Kane Rylan Adamson Line729 Fart Fish SuperGamersGames Ellis Fossett David Bonds Hisham Gagnon

rows.name: Grow Up! - A Worm Game
rows.short_description: A Game of Worms, Growing, and Strenuous Arm Movement! Get your hands ready for this challenging, perhaps tear inducing, humorous 2D precision speed game!
rows.description_html: Grow Up! - A Worm Game is about a worm-like creature from space, trying to find their way in the vast world, can you guide them and help them... Grow Big? The Gameplay Experience a truly unique form of character movement / control, requiring both mouse and keyboard. The easy to learn, hard to master gameplay, will keep you coming back for more. Several worlds, each filled with unique puzzles, gimmicks and challenges, your braincells will surely be stimulated! Levels require light puzzle-solving, technical precision, and speed. If you're fast, you could earn copper, silver or even gold medals! With the high skill ceiling and a focus on speed, you can brag about your time achievements to other people!

rows.name: Cubic Neon Nightclub
rows.short_description: Cubic Neon Nightclub is a single player futuristic nightclub sim where you can import and dance to your own DJ mixes and music. Immerse yourself among pretty lights, lasers and visual effects while you dance the night away!
rows.description_html: Cubic Neon Nightclub is a single player futuristic nightclub simulator where you can import your own DJ mixes and music. Immerse yourself among pretty lights, lasers and visual effects while you dance the night away! This VR experience was made by ravers, for ravers during a time where we just need to have a good dance in our isolationist world. - Import your own music, select songs in game at the DJ booth, fast forward through long mixes or mute the music so you can play your own from an external program. You can't actually DJ in this experience unfortunately. - Play with a beautiful visual effects as 'flow toys' while you dance--similar to poi. There are buttons around the scene that trigger special effects. - Explore different sections and heights of the club as you dance next to other partying NPCs - See your body in the scene for that extra immersion factor Please enjoy and have fun in your own personal nightclub! Notes on importing music: Must be in .ogg file format - place in the project folder: ...[GameDirectory]\Cubic Neon Nightclub_Data\StreamingAssets\Music\.. ). There are plenty of free music file converters (from mp3, etc) to .ogg on the web. FOR AVG VIRUS PROTECTION USERS: AVG and perhaps other virus software tends to throw a false positive for an 'IDP.Generic' malware for this application despite our best efforts. The .exe file should simply be added to your exception list. Apologies for the inconvenience.

rows.name: Project XMAS
rows.short_description: Project XMAS is a retro style, horror, single - player game where you need to return to your home... The map is completely procedurallygenerated so every approach will be differend and specific.
rows.description_html: Project XMAS is a retro style , horror, single - player game where you need to return to your home. The map on which you will play is completely procedurally generated so every approach to complete the game will be differend and specific. The game have really creepy sound engine so it's highly recommended to play with headphones to hear that something is follow you... Your main objective is to return to your home... but you have limited battery and energy... The game have good graphics style like old VHS tapes vibe, so the atmosphere of the game is really specific and horrible. The game have First Person point of view, it's highly recommended to play with headphones. Your only weapon is your hearing and flashlight... Project XMAS is created by only one person - Mistyczny Arbuz. I'm creating this game since 3 months and it's still in development stage.

rows.name: Looking Inside Cells
rows.short_description: Looking Inside Cells is a set of interactive Virtual Reality simulations for learning about cellular biology. Users can build cells by arranging their organelles, as well as transform them into specialized cells, such as red blood cells and e. coli bacteria.
rows.description_html: Looking Inside Cells is a set of interactive Virtual Reality simulations for learning about cellular biology. Users can build cells by arranging their organelles, as well as transform them into specialized cells, such as red blood cells and e. coli bacteria. This Virtual Reality experience is designed to increase students’ engagement and excitement for learning biology, and to bring out their naturally inquisitive nature. Designed for Middle School students, but appropriate for anyone who wants to experience an interactive and unique view of cells.

rows.name: The Prison
rows.short_description: Dive into The Prison, a modern reimagining of the classic late 90's game. Experience a vividly detailed prison world and strategic multiplayer gameplay. Customize your inmate, follow a gripping storyline, and discover new items and secrets. Will you escape or rule from within?
rows.description_html: The Prison Welcome to The Prison, a modern reimagining that pays homage to the classic late 90's game. Dive into an immersive multiplayer experience that captures the essence of the original while introducing enhanced graphics, engaging gameplay, and new features for today's gamers. Game Features: Stunning Graphics : Step into a vividly detailed prison world that feels incredibly lifelike, bringing every corner of the facility to life. Expanded Gameplay : Engage in strategic planning and intense action as you navigate through the prison, interact with other players, and complete missions. Multiplayer : Join forces with friends or compete against others in real-time multiplayer modes. Form alliances, trade resources, and battle for supremacy. Customizable Characters : Create and customize your inmate with a wide range of options, from appearance to skills and abilities. Rich Storyline : Follow a gripping narrative that evolves with your decisions. Every choice you make will impact the outcome of your journey. New Features : Discover new items, challenges, and secrets as you explore the depths of The Prison. Are you ready to escape or will you rule from the inside? The choice is yours in The Prison.

rows.name: Citywars Tower Defense
rows.short_description: Citywars TD is a cute multiplayer third person Survival Tower Defense. Build towers, gather resources, craft tools, upgrade weapons, level up buildings, expand your city with your friends and work under pressure before the next incoming wave of monsters.
rows.description_html: More than 30 unique towers to build and counting! Discover their special abilities and upgrade them for maximum damage! Each merchant will be happy to show you their special inventory of new and exciting towers. Or take a chance with the mystery chess and get a random tower for less. Try out the: 🟠 Thunder Tower (electrifie multiple enemy at a time) 🔵 Healing tower (Heal you and you friends while you fight) 🟠 Guardian Tower (spawn an allie that will patrol) 🔵 Slam Tower (attack with a powerful wave but short range) And more! Start gathering resources quickly before the enemies attack! Starting with no tools and no resources will be hard but craft the right tools and you will discover a whole new set of resources to cut, mine and gather. Craft the missing resources to upgrade your towers and beat the incoming monsters from reaching your life crystal. Use the crafting table to help you quickly progress. Some handy tools: 🟠 Stone Axe (chopping up trees, chop ,chop) 🔵 Wooden club (got to defend that crystal) 🟠 Iron Shovel (diggity coal and clay) 🔵 Stone Pickaxe (Iron hear I come) And more! Each tool and each weapon in the game has a special skill tree to help you defend your crystal with greater ease. Choose between more than a dozen weapons and armors with unique features. Claim skill points by defeating waves and collecting the experience points from monsters. Choose from: 🟠 Scavenger (Give 20% of getting 2 extra item when gathering) 🔵 Spin Attack (Push back enemies near you) 🟠 Large Quiver (Shoot more arrow on a target) 🔵 Keen Eye 2 (60% Chance to find extra item) And more!

rows.name: The End of it All
rows.short_description: The End of it All is an isometric adventure game where players must control a large cast of characters and exploit personal relationships to take over a small town one person at a time. This is a Student Project.
rows.description_html: The End of it All is a comedic puzzle/adventure game in which you get to convert a small town to your cult. Players start as The Summoner, a cultist in training. Step one: get to know the townsfolk! Learn their names, relationship dynamics, and interests… and then exploit them for your personal gain. Step two: Use the information you have gathered to efficiently convert new members. Be warned, civilians may go insane, so it’s best to be strategic in your advances. Once a new member is recruited, they become a controllable character. This allows for several unique interactions and paths to victory(hint: some paths are better than others). Have fun, but remember: Teieghged is always watching. Key Features -Interactive puzzles -Unique dialogue options for every character -Ability to control any character -Lovecraftian elements

rows.name: Meat Madness
rows.short_description: A short, 3D narrative-driven horror platformer. Journey deep into the meat tunnel and talk with survivors to uncover the grim truth.
rows.description_html: The year is 2104. Humanity is starving. When the surface of the dwarf planet Ceres breaks apart revealing a planet-sized organism underneath, Earth began to feast upon its flesh. The DSV-Provender, an IngestiCorp mining ship, has disappeared on a mission to Ceres. Play as Recovery Specialist John Stuart as you solve the mystery of the disaster that took place aboard the DSV-Provender by delving deep into the meat planet’s surface and discovering its dark secrets. Gameplay combines precision platforming, exploration, and interactive dialog in a gritty PS1 style horror atmosphere. Cover art by Theresa Baxter
