rows.name: Sel Quinta - The Six City Quest
rows.short_description: A single player RPG about directing a six man party in their travels across a fantasy island in their efforts to save the world from an impending invasion!
rows.description_html: On the world of Barran Kollil, a world of magic, monsters and fantasy, trouble is brewing. The planet's most mysterious nation, the isolationist Sel Tor is building a grand navy, with the seeming purpose of launching an invasion of the entire world! However, the king of the nation of Sel-Quinta has sent his herald to rally support to defeat the invasion before it starts! This is where you come in! Taking command of a freshly formed group of six adventurers, it's up to you to travel across Sel-Quinta to rally the support of it's six major cities and halt the invasion! But Sel-Quinta's king is not the only one getting involved in this quest, and there's more going on than any of them realise... COMBAT: The foe isn't going down without a fight! Experience tough turn based combat featuring a large six member party and a variety of foes, from the familiar to the less familiar! There's also a range of tough optional bosses - Ever fought a cursed excavator before? How about a pair of high speed mushrooms? STORY: Experience the story of the game's six party members-the out of luck All Rounder Samson, the soft hearted Thief Katalyn, the strong but silent Lysandroth, the powerful if ill tempered caster Vegal, the demonic healer Reilia and the stoic leader Hetty. And of course, the many unusual friends and foes they meet on their journey! And the choices you make along the way will change things too-perhaps one party member will teach another some of their own moves, or maybe you'll find some new items because of it! ADVENTURE: Journey across the multi biome island of Sel-Quinta, traveling the reaches from it's burning deserts, to it's flooded deltas and the frozen north! And perhaps, somewhere not even in the party's dimension itself! BUILDS: There's a lot of foes out there, but you've got the ability to respond with a variety of character setups! With over 180 skills, 150 weapons and almost 200 pieces of armour/equipment, there's a huge range of possibility! Those mushrooms out in the delta got you down with status effects? Equip familiars to protect you! Got a foe that just won't die? Equip broaches that change the elements of your attacks or powerful elemental weapons! And for your own damage-well, how about an axe that petrifies the foe on the first swing, then smashes them for three times the damage on the second? A Scythe that outright kills non boss foes 50% of the time? How about a set of claws that strike eight times and always land a critical hit? They're all in there and more! CONVENIENCE: We all know RPG's sometimes have some awkward features. Having to backtrack all the way across the world to reach a certain town, or to go shopping. Not here! Once you've been somewhere, you'll unlock the ability to remotely order in items from previously visited shops, or to travel back to places you've been before through the simple use of an item!

rows.name: Tap Ninja - Idle game
rows.short_description: Defeat enemies, earn gold, upgrade your village, become a Ninja Master!
rows.description_html: Roadmap About the Game Become a Ninja Master Start your adventure as a Ninja in this incremental game, defeat incoming enemies with a well-timed Katana Slash, research new technologies and build up your own village. Recruit and Conquer Embark on an enemy controlled island to establish your very own settlement. Recruit legendary heroes and send them out on missions to conquer enemy provinces to unite the land. Collect a zoo Collect and befriend various pets that will help you out on your adventures. Have your friend by your side to raise your mutual bond through your journeys and make your friends even more powerful. Key Features Defeat incoming enemies, collect coins, earn gold Build up your village to earn even more gold even while you are offline! Buy Research Upgrades to increase your power Ascend and learn epic and permanent Skill Upgrades Collect pets and award them with treats Recruit heroes and unite the land Perfect various Challenge levels Complete Quests for rewards Solve weekly riddles Unlock hundreds of Achievements Unlock characters and customize them with dyes Crossplatform cloud saving - take your game on the go! Roadmap for future: More Upgrades and Ascension Skills More Achievements Forgeable Artifacts Your very own dojo to customize and to display your achievements Your idea? Share it on the Discord

rows.name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log3
rows.short_description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure
rows.description_html: 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log3' (Play time : 30 minutes) This is a continuation of 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log2'. Start with Log1. Deployment of Log3: 'A rumbles truth!' They finally escaped from the collapsing scaffolding ... The mystery of the vague world (structure) begins to be solved, and the astonishing facts are told! And new characters begin to upset their future gears ...! Two silent wanderers 6 full chapters A game of exploration and adventure A lost child, drifting in an odd husk, lands at a mysterious structure. Clione, a manufactured doll you encounter. You are Clione. Your purpose? Protect this lost child. What awaits you at the top of the slowly sinking structure? What is a 'Sinking Structure'? What is the true identity of 'Clione'? Where did the 'Lost Child' come from? Major features You can play with the keyboard or controller. Actions include 'running', 'walking', 'jumping', 'climbing', etc., and you only have to press a button depending on the situation. When walking with the controller, tilt the stick a little. Operate some machine, investigate, and get information from the people you meet. Lost child are at risk during their actions. At this time, if you want to move the lost child, you can approach the lost child and 'hold hands', and you can move together. When a lost child comes into contact with water, a mysterious creature called ankh may appear and be attacked. Clione's weapon is Taser only. You will be able to fire after charging. Aim with the Shift key or the left trigger. Fire with the Space key or the A button. When locked on, the aim will turn red and the taser bullet will be able to track. In Log3, the story expands greatly. Encounter new characters. And some of the mysteries so far will be unraveled. However, yet another mystery becomes clear and the confusion deepens. Public schedule Log1 / Released / no charge Log2 / Released / no charge Log3 / Released / no charge Log4 / Released / no charge Log5 / Released / no charge Log6 / Released / no charge ------------------------------- Start with Log1. It continues from Log1 to Log6. ------------------------------- When you operate the terminal, the route map is displayed ... However…. Let's listen to the story of the electrician. You may be able to read the mystery of Log1 and Log2. The delusion signal is output to only one hand.

rows.name: Riding to Bounce City
rows.short_description: Censored version FREE! Game inspired by old-school racing games, with explicit sexual content in the third person. A mysterious call makes these girls go on a pleasure trip, riding their faithful 'friend' between their legs.
rows.description_html: Censored Version – Free to Play! Jump into the free version with pixelated censorship on the spicier camera angles (the ones with the dildos). Start with cameras 1 and 2 (no censorship needed), and unlock more as you play. Craving every detail? Grab the uncensored DLC to remove the pixelated censorship! Your girls are drawn to the mysterious Bounce City , guided by their trusty dildo. The more pleasure they feel, the closer they seem to get to the city… but it’s an endless ride. Will they make it? ¯\ ( ͡◡͜ʖ ͡◡) /¯ Dive into this cheeky, adults-only adventure packed with vibrant stages and thrilling challenges. Meet Your Characters Pick your favorite from a diverse lineup of girls. Customize their outfits, accessories, and even their dildo color to make the journey uniquely yours. As you play, you’ll gradually unlock new Camera angles to view the action from different perspectives (by collecting special 'Cameras'). Collect special Clothes items to make your characters’ outfits progressively more revealing, layer by layer. Once fully unlocked, you can go straight to your favorite look every time! Hand-drawn animations bring every bounce and jiggle to life. Unlock 'Cameras' and 'Clothes' either by collecting them in Arcade Mode or choosing special routes in Adventure Mode . Arcade Mode – Classic Challenge Dodge obstacles and feel the rush in Arcade Mode! Guide your character across five lanes to dodge obstacles, collect items, and chase the highest score. Every stage brings unique obstacles, epic boss battles, and dynamic music , keeping each run exciting and unpredictable. Adventure Mode – Randomized Exploration Adventure Mode offers strategic variety and endless replayability ! Each run begins with a random character, stage, outfit, and hat (if unlocked). From there, navigate a branching map to choose your next unlockable. Arena Mode – Relax and Bounce Take a break in the Arena for a laid-back vibe. Unlike Arcade’s five-lane setup, here you can move freely across the screen while the character auto-shoots in a mini-boss battle . Police Chase Mode – High-Speed Action Play as Cosette , the fearless policewoman, in a high-speed motorcycle chase! Catch your target before they escape to Bounce City in this action-packed side mode . Build your multiplier with last-second dodges: x2 → x3 → x4. At x4 , smash through glowing obstacles for massive points! Earn Gold to unlock exclusive gallery scenes . With new stages planned for future updates, the chase never stops!

rows.name: Augma II - Arc I
rows.short_description: The prelude to exquisite chaos. A sci-fi, psychological horror, and action VN that sets the stage for a grand opera.
rows.description_html: SYNOPSIS: There was once a world devoid of any color, drowned out by the sound of howling winds and the sight of an ashen metropolis, now rotting within a God's terrible dream. While attempting to speak to a figure bathed in the color Gold, a colorless figure ultimately lost their head in such a futile attempt. As the relentless passage of time sways the voices of the distant past, Shira Yamano finds himself in that ashen metropolis. Kirron, an endless valley of skyscrapers that pierce the sky, is home to where that once colorless figure would encounter various people that would bring the color back to his vision, and help him overcome his dangerous apathetic feelings. However in the process of doing so, he accidentally involves himself within a string of events that raises more questions than answers. This is the first installment of the Augma series, where white shall be tarnished before all to see. FEATURES: Augma II Arc I is a sci-fi thriller visual novel, imbued with heavy action and psychological elements, with a cast of unforgettable characters and gripping story. 110k words. Varied and well-composed soundtrack, all the way from metal to the sound of pianos drowning in the deep blue ocean. Over 70 unique CGs, and over 200 total. Filtered photographs for BGs to invoke a dreamlike feel as opposed to drawn BGs. A linear storyline for those who want to sit back to.

rows.name: Ghost Castle
rows.short_description: Defeat the ghosts who live in the castle! Make full use of the ninja weapons and skills to aim for the top floor where the ghost boss Yamatanoorochi is! Weapons such as shurikens, bombs and swords, and skills such as fire and freeze will surely help. Keep the peace of the village!
rows.description_html: Defeat the ghosts who live in the castle! Make full use of the ninja weapons and skills to aim for the top floor where the ghost boss Yamatanoorochi is! Along the way, various ghosts such as kappa, toads, and umbrellas will attack you. Weapons such as shurikens, bombs and swords, and skills such as fire and freeze will surely help. Keep the peace of the village! Genre First-person shooter. Control Move with the WASD key, attack with the mouse click, and heal with the H key. Pause with the ESC key. You can check other controls on the control page of the pause screen. Stage This is an automatically generated dungeon. The higher you go, the stronger the ghosts. Shop There is another ninja in the dungeon. She sells weapons and scrolls, so if you see her, talk to her. Upgrade You can get points by defeating ghosts. You can pick up points with the E key. Collect points to acquire abilities on the upgrade page of the pause screen. Equip with a mask, you can control which of strength, technique, and mentality points you focus on. Difficulty You can choose from 5 levels. You can change it even in the middle of the game. Save It automatically saves when you open the door. You can also turn off auto-save in the settings screen. You can save at any time from the pause screen. (Other than boss battle) Localization Not fully localized. The subtitles that appear when you hover over the menu have been translated.

rows.name: A Wholesome Game About Farming
rows.short_description: This game is about farming! Just good ol' planting crops in the daytime, and harvesting them in the daytime with no sinister nighttime gameplay or anything nefarious like that at all.
rows.description_html: It's finally here, an honest to goodness game about farming! What will we think of next? Nothing but you and the calming iterations of putting seeds into the ground and taking them back out after they've gotten larger and more vegetable-y. Maybe you'll even discover some new recipes to put them in! No need worrying about how your actions affect anything happening at night, because probably everyone is asleep and everything is fine. No reason anything that happens at night could affect anything happening on your farm because, as I believe I've said, everyone is sleeping at night. A Wholesome Game About Farming takes roughly 2 hours to complete, and features classic farming mechanics like: Purchasing and planting seeds Harvesting and selling crops A simple crafting system where you can discover new recipes Spying on people Sneaking up on your victims Placing obstacles for your victims Hiding the evidence You'll play as a struggling yet resilient and kind-hearted old farmer named Jep, and if there's any such thing as a 'vampire' named 'Raluca' who you 'play as' at 'night' I've certainly never heard of her and have no idea what you're talking about. Happy Farming!

rows.name: Auto Kingdom Crunch
rows.short_description: Pick the best team, level up your units and battle other players in this relaxed auto-battler. Can you get 10 wins?
rows.description_html: NEW SERVER ONLINE! The new and upgraded server is now online and good to go! About the Game Try to defeat other players with a squad full of peasants and a king, or a team of jesters and paladins in this asymmetric multiplayer auto battler. In Auto Kingdom Crunch, you are tasked with building a team from ever increasing levels of nobility as you progress closer to the sought after 10 wins. Each unit has a special ability, which upgrades with the unit. However, be careful. If you lose all your lives you must start rebuilding your team from the very beginning! Isn't that nice... Currently there is only 1 game mode to play, however I would love to add more gamemodes, units and unlockables in the future! Please note: If you find any balance issues and want to help them be fixed, send a message in my discord or twitter. Thanks.

rows.name: DOOM TOMB
rows.short_description: Cut to the chase with DOOM TOMB! A chase-based PvP game. Catch, evade and outplay your opponents in this 3D arena filled with obstacles! Chose from a selection of abilities and items that will suit your playstyle.
rows.description_html: Rival explorers have unleashed The Curse while looting a sacred tomb! The Curse latches on to one of them, mutating them into a demon, and draining them of life! The only chance of survival for the inflicted is to catch another explorer and cast The Curse onto them before time runs out! The explorers' only hope is to evade the Demon while repairing their elevator to escape. Explorers can learn and master unique magic abilities: In game map editor to build custom maps! Currently, DOOM TOMB is online multiplayer only. Join the community discord server to learn what's next, join play sessions, and submit feedback!

The explorers' only hope is to evade the Demon while repairing their elevator to escape. Explorers can learn and master unique magic abilities: In game map editor to build custom maps! Currently, DOOM TOMB is online multiplayer only. Join the community discord server to learn what's next, join play sessions, and submit feedback!

rows.name: COG Back To The 80s
rows.short_description: Welcome to the year 1980 where everything almost went to hell, why? Let's just say that sometimes you have to be a fucking psychopath if you want change to happen, but every change has consequences. Welcome to COG a horror shooter.
rows.description_html: STORYLINE In this story you will meet the MET team, which will be looking for one of the most wanted terrorists in the world, during the time of the cold war, you will be able to experience how LOST But hey!, Does everything have its side? happy isn't it? Enjoy and live what little is left of you, explore, tear apart, cruelly kill your enemies, isn't it that they have a past behind? Meet, collect and feel part of the M.E.T, and you will not be alone, since the *Deleted* will be there to make your experience as pleasant as possible. And make everyone scream your name in agony that you can come out, but everything has a price, the highest? rows.name: ULTRARUSH
rows.short_description: ULTRARUSH is a free-to-play, fast-paced arena shooter where you fight for tokens in the middle of arena. It highly relies on movement, reflexes and gamesense.
rows.description_html: ULTRARUSH is a fast-paced arena shooter where you fight for tokens in the middle of arena. It highly relies on movement, reflexes and gamesense. ULTRARUSH takes advantage and completely reworks a control point based games. In the middle of an arena is a token spawner which is necessary for winning the game. After collecting certain amount of tokens and returning safely to the base, the team is victorious. GAMEPLAY The arena contains two kinds of spawners. One for tokens and other for scrap . Scrap can be used to buy certain items or upgrades that will help secure a victory. CONTENT 1v1 or 2v2 Server list Funny emotes Cosmetics Leaderboard

rows.short_description: Aleon is a young girl who is looking for a job. One day she found a job but things didn’t go well as she wishes. You have to find out the odd things happening in the mysterious house and You need to survive in the middle of psychopath puppets. And remember... You are in the middle of nightmare.
rows.description_html: UPCOMING GAME About the Game Aleon is a young girl who is looking for a job. One day she found a job but things didn’t go well as she wishes. You have to find out the odd things happening in the mysterious house and You need to survive in the middle of psychopath puppets. Use the tools you find around. And remember… You are in the middle of nightmare. You are at the end of nowhere where fear reigns. No One knows what is happening there. You have no choice for a new job. The old man needs help. Be nice to him. But you should be careful. Some Things happen there that the old man can’t figure out. It is quite unpredictable what will happen when. Do you brave enough to survive? Features: Game: A walking simulation where you solve puzzles by interacting with surrounding objects. Immersive look: Soft lights of sections, dark corners, and colorful images are waiting for you. Stealth: Get over the creatures by hiding from them. Psychological Horror: The unexpectable creature will horrify you. Unchasable enemies: It's hard to predict when enemies will do what. AutoSave: The game has autosave.

rows.name: The Creature Zone VR
rows.short_description: welcome to the experiment, The Creature Zone VR is thrilling, scary, and fun. get ready for spooky time. they are all spooky games.
rows.description_html: A 3-Part horror game about an experiment going on. you can play the three games in the story mode, vent run, terry's pizzeria, and missing friend. the game has features that include: physical hands, and much more! here are the synopsizes for each game: vent run is a game mode where you have to escape the vents of Terry's Pizzeria. Terry's Pizzeria is a game mode where you are positioned as the security guard of Terry's Pizzeria, but you slowly realize that the animatronics are actually the reason of the shutdown of Terry's Pizzeria. missing friend is a game mode of which you are in the also abandoned camp clearwater, you are surrounded by three extraterrestrial creatures, missing friend, party man, and salvage. You will have to play chronological order for the games. the physical hands mean that your VR hands are physics-based.

rows.name: SynthWaves
rows.short_description: A retrowave tower defense game where the player must manage their arsenal of sentries to fight off waves of synths, stop their invasion, and take the fight to their home.
rows.description_html: Thrust into the middle of a war spanning multiple worlds, you have been selected. Take control of a battlefield in a retrowave world, using an arsenal of sentries and the guidance of a mysterious company to fight off waves of invading synths who aim to conquer everything. Push Through the Synth Invasion Fight your way through 4 different locations and a simulation to put a stop to the Synth's reign of terror, and perhaps evaluate the motives of your secretive allies. Manage the Battlefield Utilize an arsenal of 20 sentries to plan your defense and ensure the annihilation of the Synth's forces Take in the Sights From massive, floating pyramids to tropical forests and massive industrial cities, take in the sights inspired by art of the 80's and visions of the future to the beat of thumping synthwave tracks. Save the Worlds Push the heart of the Synth's homeland and discover how they fuel their armies and put a stop to it.

rows.name: New Century Galaxy Legend
rows.short_description: New century Galaxy legend is a free to play barrage game where you avoid barrages from all directions and survive as long as possible. Players who have survived for a long time can gain higher ranking, so try your best to overcome this challenge and keep breaking records!
rows.description_html: New century Galaxy legend is currently a barrage game. Players strive for the maximum number of seconds to survive by avoiding barrages. The type of barrage will be switched every other period of time. At the same time, with the increase of survival time, the generated barrage speed will be faster and faster. After players are hit by a barrage, their survival time will be ranked with the player records around the world, so let's keep creating and refreshing survival records! If you are a hardcore game enthusiast, strong reaction ability is an important skill. New century Galaxy legend may help you improve this ability. The operation method of the game is very simple. Players only need to operate the aircraft to avoid the barrage. For new players, maybe 10 seconds is a milepost. Through continuous practice, players' flight time will be improved. tons of barrages are coming, can you hold on for 30 seconds? Let's start the challenge NOW! Game control Move: '←', '→', '↑', '↓' Confirm: 'space' Return: 'ESC'

rows.name: Parasight: Chlorophyll worms
rows.short_description: Parasight is a 2D Action-RPG game with souls-like mechanisms. In this game, you will play as a little girl who wants to save herself from a dangerous biological virus, but she faces various difficulties and hardships in her journey.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of Parasight: Chlorophyll worms! Parasight is a 2D Action-RPG game with souls-like mechanisms. In this game, you will play as a little girl who wants to save herself from a dangerous biological virus, but she faces various difficulties and hardships in her journey. *-- Summary --* Far away in the galaxy, there was an Earth-like planet called Velasterham. The story begins in a quiet-peaceful country named Bonrham that was created by united 40 cities. everyone's Life was simple and sweet. In a large old house, a girl and her family lived. On a normal sunny day, she goes out of the city to see her friend and play with him. After a lovely day, when they wanted to back home, suddenly they saw a strange plant! After that, The life of the girl turns upside down. Seems like a virus spreading in Bonrham, we call it... *-- Gameplay --* - Classes - The style used in the game is souls-like. there are 6 unique classes that each one has special powers. *Knight: Tough strong fighter with shiny armors and powerful damage, master of great weapons. *Mage: The magic brawler, Casting mighty magic and frozen spells from far away to deal with enemies, but is frail in close combats. *Priestess: The holy warrior, With the high amount of Hp, can cast holy spells to heal self or cast lightning spells to deal bone-breaker damages. *Witch: Warrior of darkens, master in casting dark magic that ignores armors, or flame spells that can burn the soul of the enemies, but Dark and the flame spell has consequences, like draining Health! *Thief: Blinding speed fighter, light, quick and fast, use both hands in fighting and can deal a lot of damage in just a second. *Ranger: Ranged fighting fighter, Slash the skins of enemies with whips, masters in using any ranged weapons, also has a special unique bow that works without physical ammunition. - Features - -Unique art and soundtrack. -More than 250 battle items! Includes swords, axes, staves, bows, shields and etc. * There are two types of currency * 1-Energy extract: Only can be obtained by Killing enemies, or by injection with energy syringes. 2-Clay coin: Can be obtained by doing tasks, or looting. -Vanquish enemies, gain ENERGY EXTRACTS, and Level up to become stronger in dealing with your enemies. -Spend Clay coin, buy new items like weapons, armors, rings consumables, and many more to help you and make your fights easier. * Play with your satisfying techniques! * -Wear heavy armor and use weighty weapons and crush your enemies, while you don't feel any pain upon taking damage, -or wear light armors, use a quick weapon like daggers and dance your blades in the face of your enemies, -or use ranged weapons to suffer your enemies without any danger, or fight with the magic spells will you breaking their scale and armors! -Also there are flavor items that can help you in battle, like consumables and rings that increase your ability in various things. -Explore the vast Bonrham cities, talk to people and listen to their stories, discover cool secrets and items... or you can just ignore them, killing everyone and finding your way out... -And finally, test your IQ and try to solve the tasks of Tefras and guide your way to your unpredictable fate!

rows.name: The Long Road North
rows.short_description: A music video game for the song Cold Burn from Cult Of Luna
rows.description_html: This is the interactive music video of the song Cold Burn by the band Cult of Luna . Help the lost light escape those dark tornados and guide it through the mysterious landscapes, all the way to the Mother Light at the core of the maze. Explore this surreal world, fight the tornados or see how many more lost lights you can find and bring with you home to the end of the maze. Enough lights collected in each part of the maze will unlock artworks at the end of the experience. How many lights can you find? The music is adaptive to navigating the game, so every experience will render a unique version of the song.

rows.name: Darza's Dominion
rows.short_description: The Dominion takes no prisoners! Fight for your survival in the unforgiving terrains that surround you, strengthen your hero through slaying dangerous creatures, gather a group of allies and bring the battle to Darza in this fast-paced roguelike cooperative bullet-hell MMO!
rows.description_html: UPDATE PACKAGES Celebrate the largest update in Darza's Dominion history with these limited-time themed packages! These packages are available for purchase in-game by talking to Pablo in the Tavern or by clicking the packages button. The Rampant Supporter package is themed after the new Rampant Citadel dungeon and includes 8000 gold, 32 Darza Crates, the Rampant Robed Wizard skin for Mage, the Rampant Executioner skin for Paladin, the Rampant Archer skin for Archer, the Rampant Killer skin for Assassin, and a Flying Book pet. It costs 80 platinum . The Ancient Supporter package is themed after the new Ancient Ruins dungeon and includes 4000 gold, 16 Darza Crates, Dominus, the Wizard skin for Mage, the Dominus skin for Paladin, and the Lil Green Cici and Lil Blue Cici pets. It costs 40 platinum . The Infested Supporter package is themed after the new Infested Cellar dungeon, and includes 2000 gold, 8 Darza Crates, and the Angry Cobweb pet. It costs 20 platinum . About the Game The Dominion takes no prisoners! Fight for your survival in the unforgiving terrains that surround you, strengthen your hero through slaying the dangerous creatures, gather a group of allies to multiply your strength, and bring the battle to Darza! As a cooperative bullet-hell MMORPG, Darza’s Dominion is a fast-paced game centered around being ready to dodge as many projectiles that can fit on the screen at once; the harder the difficulty, the more insane everything gets. You’re going to have to hope your reaction time is up to the test! Taking back the Dominion is all about teamwork. Thankfully for you, all of your closest (and farthest!) friends can help you out! Group up in the Tavern, form a Guild, or just find them in the Dominion and take on the toughest challenges the game has to offer. FAST-PACED GAMEPLAY Face off against foes in a 2D orthographic roguelike featuring permadeath mechanics in a speedy bullet hell environment. UNIQUE CHARACTER CLASSES Discover the full power of seven class abilities by looting special gear capable of leveling the playing field. RANDOMLY GENERATED UNIQUE DUNGEONS Challenge the dungeon bosses of the Dominion in their own individually created stages and make it out alive. INTENSE BOSS FIGHTS Engage in battles against an expanding roster of bosses boasting different phases and collect loot along the way to upgrade your characters. MULTIPLAYER ONLINE BULLET-HELL Utilize your character classes and work together against Darza and his minions by fighting alongside dozens of players at any time against the perils that await you in the Dominion. VIBRANT PLAYER-BASED ECONOMY Sell and buy your way up to the top by bartering with other players in an economic environment controlled by players just like you.

rows.description_html: Shinobi Warfare is a 2d RPG Turn Based game which lets you create and customize up to six different shinobis, strengthen them with different set of skills, weapons and more accessories to level up and compete with other players. The game offers different multiplier game modes which allows you to team up and play or compete with others, such as Clan Wars, Offline Arena, Live PVP and more. You can play trough various events and missions to level up and unlock new items, and if you ever feel lonely, you could always recruit friends to the battles!

rows.name: Koncolos: Prologue
rows.short_description: In a small pub with regulars, a woman makes a scene every night. Explore the compelling and mysterious story behind her bizarre behavior in the first chapter of this visual novel.
rows.description_html: Shift of Aras, who works as a bartender in a small pub where everyone knows each other, ends at 20:00. But for the last couple of days, the whole place turns upside down right after that time. In regards to the things told, it is not a simple drunken brawl. Because the woman who starts the fight every night asks a question before all the quarrel: 'Do you know a monster that dwells around here?' Getting curious on this question, Aras tries to find ways to learn more about this woman. Text-based story rich gaming experience Interaction with hand drawn comic book assets Anime style characters Original ambient soundtrack In the first episode of this Visual Novel, explore the hidden aspects of a living left ages behind, where ordinary folk, mages and monsters live together. Aras held most characteristic of the capital in which he lived with 5 millions other inhabitants in the center of Anatolia. Neither of them had any particular features one could think of right away. Everyone knew their names but nobody really cared about them. They both had a vision of sorts at one time, but they seemed to abandon it. Even the unfavorable aspects of cities, and of humans, can express a great deal, however this was not one of those cases. rows.name: Sexy Space Airlines
rows.short_description: Sexy Space Airlines is a sci-fi adult idle/clicker game centered around managing a spaceship enterprise. As CEO, your main mission is to discover more routes to expand your business. Encounter our cast of multi-species females and get to know them better to help you manage these routes.
rows.description_html: Cryogenically preserved and thrust 100 years into the future, you are awakened by two futuristic bombshells in an era where humans and aliens co-exist. You now embark on an expedition to expand your space transport enterprise with the help of the most attractive females you can find to manage your fleets. The success of this venture hinges on your ability to satisfy the demands of your attendants, one way or another. Sexy Space Airlines allows you to explore the lives of these multi-faceted characters via a messenger system that can be used to interact and provide gifts to them. Flood them with enough gifts to get romantic with them and uncover a few solar-heated adult scenes in the process. Traveling in space is no piece of cake with turbulence and a barrage of asteroids to maneuver, but successfully clearing these obstacles will allow you to get hold of a few goodies during your trips. Collect cards for your characters during your adventures throughout this solar system and beyond, to upgrade the skill levels of your attendants and help you progress through the game easier. The rest is for you to discover. At Sexy Space Airlines, every day is a spacial one.

rows.name: Running in the Y2K
rows.short_description: Run, Jump and Hunt through procedurally generated levels to feed your family in the post-apocalyptic world of the year 2000 after the Y2K bug occurred. Compete against everyone in the leaderboards to show who is the best hunter in the new world.
rows.description_html: Join the community! About the Game This game is an endless runner where every run is played in a procedural level. You will jump and shoot spears to hunt mutated animals. These animals will drop food that, apart from giving you some extra points, will allow you to upgrade different aspects of your character making each run important. The farther you go, the faster you will go making the run an ever rising challenge. Your goal is to go as far as you can. After the Y2K bug occurred (computers crashed due to not having into account the change of the millennium), catastrophe unleashed causing nuclear reactors to get unstable and inevitably cause mutations all over the world. Humanity went back to a nearly prehistoric way of living, technology was suddenly unusable the only use we can give to it is to throw it at animals or noise neighbours. After some testing the most efficient piece of technology to throw is the newly released Mokia 3210. What didn't change was the need for humans to eat. In a world where almost every living creature mutated food became the new currency. You are now in charge of hunting and providing for your family don't worry Turtlbbit is tastier than it sounds. After the nuclear catastrophe animals look.. well.. a bit different. Anyway, your job is to hunt them and get as much food as you can for your family. Food can be used to upgrade your 38m2 two floors primitive cave. These upgrades will give you an advantage when running. Ohh, and don't forget that you will be competing against other survivors through Steam leaderboards to see who is the best neo-post-apocalyptic-runner.

rows.name: Prince of Suburbia - Part 1
rows.short_description: Prince of Suburbia is a kinetic (linear) adult visual novel with only one thing on its mind. This simple sandbox game is packed with lewd scenes and sprinkled with a fun story that aims to never leave you wanting more. Play Part 1 for FREE!
rows.description_html: If you encounter any problems or errors, please post in the Discussions forum here on Steam or email our support email vimstudios.vns@gmail.com so we can help you. If you report a problem or error in the Reviews, we will not see it immediately. Thank you! Prince of Suburbia is a kinetic (linear) adult visual novel that will never leave you with blue balls. Simple sandbox navigation leads through a silly story full of hot women just waiting to seduce you, and be seduced by you. *Characters marked with an asterisk have relationships that are fully customizable. Medical research gone awry *Catherine is a medical researcher who is drowning in bills. She needs to prove her new fertility medication is safe for human consumption, and fast. How will the side effects of this experimental drug affect her, and those around her? Naughty neighbors Your neighbor, Naomi, and her daughter, Heather, have devious plans for you and the women you live with. Will you fall victim to their seductions, or turn the tables on them? Warm an icy path *Sarah is struggling with her own issues and seems to push away everyone who cares about her. Will she ever open up to you and accept your… help? A crowded home *Sonia and *Fiona also need a place to stay. Will they be polite houseguests welcomed with open arms, or will they make themselves a little too comfortable?

rows.name: The RPS Game Show
rows.short_description: Tired of losing at 'luck based' games? Yeah? Time to redeem yourself with 'The RPS Game Show'. If you win, you can still lose. If you lose, you can still win. Challenge your friends to a totally normal game of Rock Paper Scissors.
rows.description_html: A totally normal game about 'Rock Paper Scissors' This game plays like a very normal Rock Paper Scissors game. Pick your choice There is nothing else to say here. Just pick between Rock Paper and Scissors aha. But FIRST, Spam some Gesture with your friend Hey, it seems that you're winning! You picked Rock, and your friend picked Scissors, that's great! But wait... you didn't win yet... So it's now time, to smash your friend Win the quick time event to confirm the victory. Remember that you have ALSO to be faster than your friend. And if you win... You can finally smash your friend! Yeah, that's the general idea ahah.

rows.name: Dank Subs
rows.short_description: The combat is kind of like a Souls game and there is a multiplayer mode like Fall Guys.You must find the level end first and avoid getting stun-locked and damaged by enemies! Gaming is back in a big way!
rows.description_html: Hi Chat! This game is still in progress! I'll keep building on it! GAME MODES: Single Player This game mode is a 'Souls-Like' adventure! Hack, slash, and dodge your way through enemies while collecting Subs! Multiplayer Find the Bernie: This is a multiplayer game where you race on foot against others to reach the level end ! The level end is marked by a floating orb with a Bernie Sanders cardboard cut-out. More Multiplayer Game Modes Coming Soon! GAMEPLAY FEATURES: SPRINTING AND ROLLING You can Jump over objects and on platforms. Sprint and Roll/Air Dash to beat your competition and avoid AI Enemies! COMBAT While other PvP players can do a small amount of damage to you, most combat will be from enemy AI. The enemies can STUN-LOCK you and deal serious damage. Players can pick up Swords and Shields . Players can Quick Attack with left mouse/R1 and Heavy Attack with right mouse/R2 Block with 'V'/'L1' Target nearest enemy with 'TAB'/'R3' Rolling when you have enemy Targeted will dodge the enemy in the direction you are moving. STAMINA: Sprinting , Rolling , Blocking , and Attacking drain your Stamina Bar If stamina is drained, player cannot perform actions listed. CHICKEN TENDIES: Press Interact at chicken tenders or chicken wraps to Restore Health Restoring Health will also RESET ENEMIES that died. So be strategic and other players will have to deal with enemies you Revived! COLLECT SUBS: Defeated enemies will give the player 'subs' in a sub counter in bottom right corner. Subs will unlock more special abilities (coming soon) This is a community game for fans of HasanAbi twitch streamer. I welcome ideas in growing this game! *this is a fan made game for the twitch streamer HasanAbi. Game will remain free forever . All content is stream safe and music is made by me and other Hasan fans

rows.name: Soul In the Chamber
rows.short_description: Bound to the soul of an assassinated emperor and equipped with only one bullet, traverse and fight through the stylized world of Soul in the Chamber as you try to uncover the mysteries of a fallen empire and survive the collision of two dying worlds.
rows.description_html: You play as an archeologist exploring through the ruins of the long fallen Khal Empire when you recover a mysterious ancient gun. When picking up the gun, the soul of an assassinated emperor is dragged out of the spirit world and becomes entrapped into the body of the gun. Due to your actions, a cataclysmic collision of worlds has begun that only you can stop by returning the emperor to his final resting place in the spirit world. With the emperor at your side, you must traverse the chaos of the oncoming apocalypse as you fight through the vengeful and mad spirits of the fallen empire’s bloody past. Save the fates of both colliding worlds as you uncover the mystery of the emperor’s assassination and the story of the empire’s fall. Heart-Pumping Fast-Paced Traversal Slide, wall-run, and dash your way through a world designed for agility and flowing movement. Build up your momentum as you dodge opponents, traps, and traverse environments crafted to challenge your ability. Precise and Creative Combat With only one shot to take down enemies, use bullet-time and precision to take down your opponents and use their souls to recover your bullet and chain together kills as you move through combat. Gather and use unique modifiers for your shots to creatively take down enemies and use your environment against those who stand in your way. A Vibrant Stylized World Traverse through the beautiful ruins of an empire that fell from a tyrannical imperial dynasty and a bloody civil war. Explore the vibrance of a dying spirit world as well as the chaos of two worlds’ colliding. Endure the onslaught of stylized and unique opponents as well as a treacherous environment as you try to reach your goal. Competitive Speedrunning and Community-based Level Editing Race through levels to get the fastest times with in-game timers and optional objectives to constantly challenge yourself. Create your own levels with an in-game level editor that allows you to experiment with unique level combinations to create challenging and creative experiences. Want to help Playtest? Come join our playtesting Discord server:

rows.name: Project Xenoflora
rows.short_description: Someone thought it was a good idea to create the world's first sentient plant. It wasn't. Now there's a mildly dangerous and very angry plant making a mad dash for the exit, the only thing that stands in its way is the near-infinite number of mass-produced robot sentries programmed to destroy it.
rows.description_html: 100% of the plant life on earth was non-sentient, maybe scientists and giant corporations should learn to not mess with the laws of nature. In Project Xenoflora, you play the world's first biologically created sentient plant. Plants are cool, being able to think it cool, why not just combine those two things? Someone thought it was a good idea, it wasn't. Now there's a mildly dangerous and very angry plant making a mad dash for the exit, the only thing that stands in its way is the near-infinite number of mass-produced robot sentries programmed to destroy it. Burrow, shoot, and... tree?... your way through bullet-hell action in this short roguelike experience. Make use of randomized abilities and combine them to suit your playstyle. Most importantly, the enemies are all robots, the dog is a robot dog, specifically a chlorophyll-thirsty robot dog trying to tear you to shreds. Do not feel bad for the robot dog, it has red eyes its obviously evil. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Cursed
rows.short_description: A horrific retro point and click adventure with combat
rows.description_html: In a small unnamed rural town, a girl has been missing for over 24 hours. She foolishlly ventured down a forbidden stairwell feared by every citizen. Now you have been called to find her and solve the mysteries of the abandoned mines. Is she even still alive at this point? Only one way to find out. -Venture underground in retro point-and-click style -Do battle with unholy creatures in real time combat -Solve puzzles and use inventory to progress into the labyrinth -Chilling atmosphere and classic pc-indie-game vibes -Unique blend of action and puzzle solving This was the first game I made in one week during 2009. Inspired by old horror games such as Last Half of Darkness and Uninvited. Created as a small passion project. Cursed 2 was finished in 2019, and now Cursed 3 is being developed in 2022.

rows.name: Note Brawl
rows.short_description: Go head-to-head in a game like soccer, but filled with colorful monsters! Note Brawl is a free-to-play fighting soccer game where you play with a diverse roster Every map and character is completely unique so there will always be something new to find out.
rows.description_html: Go head-to-head in a game like soccer, but filled with colorful monsters! Note Brawl is a free-to-play fighting soccer game where you play with a diverse roster! Every map and character is completely unique so there will always be a new interaction for you to find out. Stay on the lookout for new characters and maps that will shake up how you play the game! - Local Multiplayer Play against any friend with the brawlers that you've unlocked. - Arcade Challenge the arcade so that you can flex your highest score or unlock new brawlers - Customization Show off your style with different balls and player skins that can be unlocked through gameplay! - Online Multiplayer Take your skills online with friends or random matches! - Controller Recommended To easily have fun with the brawlers with a familiar arcadey control scheme, playing with a controller is highly recommended, but not required.

rows.name: Rail Route: The Story of Jozic
rows.short_description: In “The Story of Jozic” a free stand alone expansion from the developers behind Rail Route you will take on the role of an apprentice train dispatcher in the bustling city of Prague - design, construct and automate your own railway network in real time!
rows.description_html: Want more? Get the full experience! About the Game Every train needs a dispatcher—and, there’s one dispatcher in particular that needs your help. In Rail Route: The Story of Jozic, you take on the role of an apprentice train dispatcher, loosely guided through the construction of your first, major rail network by a warm, albeit mysterious, mentor… Jozic. Step into the shoes of a real-life train dispatcher, and take on the day-to-day challenges of the role. From ensuring that your trains arrive on time, to planning the most efficient routes possible, you’ll be making sure the people of Prague get to their destinations on time on your journey to become a master train dispatcher! As you begin to unravel the narrative of Jozic, you’ll start to unlock some new upgrades for your network. From faster tracks to full automation of your network, you’ll be hitting eureka moments almost as much as Jozic! Rail Route: The Story of Jozic takes place in an accurate rail-map of The City of Prague! Complete with real-life station and place names (as well as Jozic’s favourite recollections of them…), you’ll get the chance to make your own mark on the city!

rows.name: Nightfall
rows.short_description: Nightfall is a top down sci-fi game with turn based combat. After waking up on a strange world without any recollection of your past, you must explore, fight, and survive in order to rediscover your memories and find out why, and by whom they were taken away.
rows.description_html: Nightfall is a top down sci-fi game with turn based combat, the game has a retro art style and is more of a casual game. After waking up on a strange world without any recollection of your past, you must explore, fight, and survive in order to rediscover your memories and find out why, and by whom they were taken away. You will progress through the game with a companion and acquire stronger items, weapons, and armor, these will boost different stats to allow you to combat enemies easier and faster. You will rediscover the characters lost memories by eliminating key enemies or bosses. This is the roadmap for the game showing the goals for the major updates I have planned. This roadmap may change over the development process.

rows.short_description: Amy Chambers, a young woman on her way to the Black Ridge Mountains to meet with her friends for a weekend of camping will soon find that the forest holds more than just a good time for her and her friends. The saw beckons and it must feed.
rows.description_html: THE SAW IS THE LAW. Meat Saw is a 30-40 minute horror experience inspired by the 80's slasher movie genre. You play as Amy Chambers, a young woman on her way to the Black Ridge Mountains to meet with her friends for a weekend of camping. The forest holds more than just a good time for her and her friends. Try and escape while a maniac with a chainsaw forged with the flesh of its victims descends upon them. The saw beckons and it must feed. Will she survive the night? Only time will tell. Solve puzzles and riddles with clues and tools which allows for engaging and fun game mechanics. Survive the horrors that await you in Meat Saw, while being stalked by a relentless AI hellbent on trying to end your life in a gruesome manner.

rows.name: Scavenger's Deep
rows.short_description: Scavenger's Deep is an underwater 3rd person action roguelike game, with an emphasis on player movement for traversing the game world and encounters.
rows.description_html: Scavengers deep is an underwater 3rd person action roguelike game, with an emphasis on player movement for traversing the game world and encounters. The player character is among the poorer inhabitants of a flooded future earth and is looking to join the upper class. On one fateful day, Damien heard a rumour about a legendary treasure with untold riches however, a monster lies in the depths. Damien equips his high-power diving suit along with his water booster and dives into the depths to begin his journey. The high-power diving suit allows Damien Jones to descend to the deepest parts of the ocean. The suit is equipped with aqua jets which allows for better mobility underwater to assist against unwanted predators. Damien also carries his knife and harpoon gun to aid against hostile marine life. Scavenger’s Deep is an action game with a system of permanent death and a loss of items, making the player start the game again with nothing. Belonging to the beat-em’ up or brawler subgenre, the game uses hordes of enemies to give the player multiple targets resulting in an intense, almost overwhelming combat experience. The roguelike elements exist in the form of a “permanent” death system. This means that in each playthrough or “run” of the game, if the player is defeated (health reaches zero), they will have to begin again from the first level. Upon dying, the player also loses all items and increases to stats they had obtained over the course of that run.

rows.name: Buried
rows.short_description: Get out of an underground research facility, but beware, don't get killed by the mysterious creatures. They hear you move. When they are close, hide and try not to breath. Avoid detection to get out of the facility.
rows.description_html: Wanna try something different from this: About the Game You are stuck in an underground facility after an earthquake. No help available, you need to get out on your own. Only problem is, you are not alone. There are some unknown creatures in the facility too. Run, Walk or Crouch to get away from the creatures, but beware, they can hear every noise you make. The faster you try to get away, the easier it is for them to find you. Hide, Hold your breath to avoid detection when they are near. In this small horror adventure there are no saves. So when you die, you start again.

rows.short_description: Shadow Era is the full scale, cross-platform collectible trading card game that you've been looking for, with the most generous free to play system out there! Enjoy the amazing dark fantasy artwork in a card game where strategy is most important.
rows.description_html: v4.90 Is Now Live! The Scaleforge have returned to help Humanity fight the Sandwing scourge! Meanwhile, darkness emerges from the heart of Kyber. A 26 card update including 2 New Heroes! A Shadow Priest, and a Human Wulven hero! OVERVIEW - 2 new heroes: She-Lah (Human Wulven) and Markus (Shadow Priest). - 8 new Human allies from the Scaleforge alignment. - 10 new Shadow allies from the Kyberian alignment. - 6 other new cards - 25 buffs across all sets - 4 card rejigs - Various bug fixes v4.80 Has Arrived! OVERVIEW - 14 new class cards added to the Rekindled Rebirth set. - 8 changes to Rekindled Rebirth cards, including 3 that are now unbanned. - 9 buffs to Call of the Crystals class cards. - 20 buffs to Dark Prophecies class cards. - 3 Campaign card balance changes. - 4 allies gained an alignment to boost Homunculus, Templar and Undead. - Various bug fixes NEW CARDS - 2 Warrior cards (rr064-rr065) - 2 Mage cards (rr074-rr075) - 2 Hunter cards (rr084-rr085) - 2 Priest cards (rr094-rr095) - 2 Rogue cards (rr104-rr105) - 2 Wulven cards (rr114-r115) - 2 Elemental cards (rr124-rr125) BUG FIXES Fixed a bug where Dragon's Tooth (ex146) becoming an ally with no abilities couldn't have its attack increased. Fixed a bug where Nanaya (ll060) doesn't buff allies created by Rise of the Banners (rr062). Fixed a bug where Felinian Dissenter (rr051) wasn't reducing weapon bow damage to it. Fixed a bug where Gyre and Gimble (rr102) gives card draw when a weapon enters play without being summoned. Fixed a bug where Tranceposer (rr121) can steal an opposing unique ally when you already control that ally. Fixed a bug where Nine Lives (rr131) can be activated with a full hand. Version 4.7 of Shadow Era is here! Shadow Era is the full scale, cross-platform collectible trading card game that you've been looking for, with the most generous free to play system out there! Start your campaign by choosing your Human Hero, and get a free starter deck. Battle with AI opponents or other players in realtime pvp to earn more cards. Your progress and cards will be saved on the server and can be accessed from any device! You must decide which strategy to use as you build your deck, in one of the most balanced card games out there! What's New in 4.7? A new saga begins in the world of Balor! With the forces of the wild becoming more increasingly dominated by the Shadow aligned Wulven faction, a desperate attempt is made to tilt the scales of nature back in favor of humanity. Mystics from Templar and Twilight persuasions collaborate on an intense ritual to infuse the souls of departed humans into the ferocious bodies of Balor's many jungle cats. Warnings from the Keeper of the Mystic Flames ignored, the ritual is successful - creating the first Feline Humanoid champions of Humanity on Balor! However, the energy releases cracked open the ancient egg-caverns of the Sandwings - a terrible tribe of dragons thought to be long-extinct. Will you defend humanity against its many foes, and fend off this scaly menace? Or will you take flight with the Sandwing Broodmother and punish Humanity for dabbling with powers they have no right to command? 'A fantastic representation of what freemium games should be.' - Touch Arcade 'Shadow Era is a must-download for fans of CCGs.' - TUAW 'Shadow Era is a deep CCG that's easy to pick up, but nearly impossible to put down.' - Slide To Play (4/4) 'Shadow Era proves that digital TCG's can be just as fun as their real world counterparts.' - Gamezebo FEATURES - Many new cards in the Lost Lands expansion, bringing the total to more than 800 cards - Amazing dark fantasy card art that is sure to wow you, even rivals the top trading card games! - View games in progress or replays to learn new strategies - Free to play Meltdown game mode with great weekly prizes - Cross-platform multiplayer pvp battles - Fantastic 3d graphics and special effects - Amazing custom soundtrack - Completely free to play! No 'pay to win' here! NEW CARDS - 7 Dual Class Allies - 6 Neutral Outlaw Allies - 1 Neutral Attachment for Outlaw - 1 Neutral Artifact for Outlaw - 3 Neutral Wild Allies - 1 Neutral Support Ability for Wild - 4 Neutral Items/Abilities - 1 Neutral Armor - 1 Neutral Weapon - 1 Neutral Location CARD BUG FIXES - Nishaven was damaging friendly allies with his ability. - Treetop Spider was being exhausted when it attacked with its ability. - Shard of Power allies were dying due to health reduction effects. - Agent Rex was treating a stolen item like it was destroyed. - Scrap Cannoneer could activate without an item to exile. BALANCE CHANGES Nishaven From: 5SE: All opposing allies take 2 electrical damage and if an ally was killed this way, repeat this effect up to once per turn. When Treetop Spider is summoned while any opposing player has resources equal or greater than yours, it attacks target opposing ally. To: Ambush. When Treetop Spider is summoned, it attacks target opposing ally if able.

rows.name: ITRP _ Volatile Vertex
rows.short_description: If you see a ledge, it means that it is needed for something. A three-dimensional puzzle platformer about the change of gravity in three axes. Walk on the walls and hang from the ceiling. Do whatever you want. The main thing is to get out of here.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the test complex, fitted with a state-of-the-art system of redistribution of active forces. Your participation in this test is crucial. Use your brain and be ready to blow your mind! ITRP _ Volatile Vertex is a small free spatial puzzle platformer about changing gravity. You are inside a huge cubic room filled with different buildings. On one side of it you see a large gate leading to freedom. You need to find a way to get to them, open them and get out through them. In some places there are devices in the form of small black and blue cubes that allow you to change gravity in a certain direction and move through buildings at a different angle. Thanks to them, you can get to the most inaccessible places of the entire location. Features: A large, hand-crafted location, where you will have to look at the same buildings from different angles to understand how they can be used. Puzzle through careful study of space. The game is not meant to test your dexterity. It is designed to test your attentiveness and spatial thinking. Fall from any height. You will remain safe and unharmed. Easy route planning, because all the contents of the location are almost always in sight. And you can study the walls and ceiling until they become your floor. Move different platforms from one place to another to secure access to new places. Find and collect keys that will help you expand your abilities. Each side of a huge cubic room is individual. Ranging from appearance and soundtrack to content.

rows.name: Maneater and the Golden Teacher
rows.short_description: Maneater and the Golden Teacher is a dark and emotional 2D point and click visual novel set in the aftermath of nuclear Armageddon. A post-apocalyptic recon unit recruit makes his first voyage to the surface world and questions the reality of his lifestyle and the underground society he grew up in.
rows.description_html: Arcadia is the last known bastion of society after a nuclear fallout 100 years ago. Following a rebellion some decades past, all vault inhabitants are required to consume a reality altering psychedelic found on the surface world called Golden Teachers or face “retirement.” Play as Marshal, a recruit in the Foragers, an elite reconnaissance unit whose primary purpose is the search and retrieval of GT. As you journey above for the first time, Marshal increasingly begins to question what is so bad about the real state of existence that he cannot be allowed to see it sober. Will your journey for the truth be your undoing? Features: Walk through the riveting story to see life after nuclear fallout as it really is Interact with a few objects throughout the game

rows.name: White Mirror
rows.short_description: A hardcore platformer, intended for speedrunners to try to beat as fast as possible !
rows.description_html: White Mirror is a hardcore 2D platformer with a twist, intended for speedrunners. In this double-sided platformer, run, jump and bounce on walls in order to avoid traps and make your way to the end of the level. Players will be able to see an environment and its reflection, which is a perfect inversion of the other one. Platforms, traps and enemies in white only appear on the black background and the other way around, black ones only appear on the white background. However, they exist in both sides. Players must combine both information to see the world how it really is.

rows.name: La Villa de la Muerte
rows.short_description: La Villa de la Muerte is a looping psychological horror game where players will progress through an ever-changing environment in pursuit of the truth behind a family disappearance.
rows.description_html: One villa. One family. One truth. La Villa de la Muerte is a looping psychological horror game inspired by the chilling tale of La Llorona. Explore an elegant villa filled with fragments from a family who mysteriously vanished. Explore the villa and solve puzzles to slowly reveal the truth behind what happened to the family, where they went, and who they became. Looping Environment Explore the villa as it changes alongside your knowledge of what truly transpired here. Puzzles Tour the environment to solve a puzzle in each loop to progress further toward the truth. AI/Stealth We lovingly call her Ghost Lady, she's pretty spooky. Hide in wardrobes, sneak under tables, or just run for it to avoid her. She will do whatever it takes to make sure you don't discover what happened. About Ottercide Studio Ottercide Studio is comprised of graduate game dev students at the University of Utah . Our game, La Villa de la Muerte , is the product of two semesters of hard work resulting in a 20-30 minute experience. Additionally, we owe a huge thank you to Berklee College of Music for contributing their time and talent to our game. FAQ Why Ottercide? Our team grew particularly attached to an adorable live otter stream that kept us peaceful while developing this horror game. Thus, we ended up with the play on words, Ottercide Studio as our development team name. Is this game a retelling of La Llorona? While the team pulled inspiration from the tale, this game is not a retelling of La Llorona. Instead, we drew from the lore to have something to ground us while also prioritizing remaining respectful to the story's origins. Folktales are a great way to keep culture and story alive while paving the way for new tales. We hope you enjoy our game as much as we loved developing it. Will the game be playable in Spanish? We had hoped to fit in localization during development, but it, unfortunately, did not end up falling within our final scope.

rows.name: Calrivar Cluster
rows.short_description: An Accessibility First Real Time Strategy Game, built from the ground up to work with only one hand and limited sight. Entirely single player all movement and control is preformed via keyboard, the camera system was designed around the physical layout of the number pad on keyboards.
rows.description_html: An Accessibility First Real Time Strategy Game Built from the ground up to work with only one hand and limited sight. Entirely single player all movement and control is preformed via keyboard, the camera system was designed around the physical layout of the number pad on keyboards. Options customisation Fully rebindable keys and the ability to create fully personalised colour profiles for all text that is saved across play sessions. Unique Control Scheme You have 9 primary cameras each linked to a number key from here you can see a large part of the map and build units, then for refined control selecting, moving and setting waypoints. Press a modifier key default Ctrl or Number pad Insert then another number key to access the specific are of the map, for example by pressing 9 then Modifier key 9 you are in the top right of the map pressing 1 modifier 1 takes you to the bottom left. A full tutorial is available. Current and future content The game features three factions but only one currently playable one within the campaign focusing on the Anubi, campaign missions do feature styled maps the bare screen shots are to help envision how the camera quadrants work and used in the tutorial.

rows.name: A Night With Gigsjaw VR
rows.short_description: A VR Survival Horror game set in a decrepit out of commission restaurant. Survey the cameras and your surroundings, conserve and recharge your power, and whatever you do... Do NOT let them in your room.
rows.description_html: A Night With Gigsjaw is a VR survival horror game, where you must survey your surroundings and survive. Evil robots will try to get to your room from 2 side doors and a vent above you. Check the cameras to keep track of them, listen out for movement in the vents, keep an eye on your power, and turn off the generator to charge it up if need be. But be careful, you won't have access to any lights or doors. Use your flashlight to peer into the darkness around you. Although you may not like what you see. Game contains Flashing lights, and loud jumpscares. If either of these things can effect you, please take caution when playing.

rows.name: New Roots
rows.short_description: In this story-driven pixel game set in a post-global warming world, a young capybara seeks to regrow the extinct native plants of their home with the help of their solarpunk community.
rows.description_html: Piertje is a solarpunk seaside community located on the New-Dutch coastline . Despite so much being lost to the unpredictable tides and weather, the people that live there are driven to take care of themselves, each other, and the world around them. It is also home to Stick, a teenage capybara wild about all things plant , who decides that they are done mourning the loss of local plant life and decides to give the beaten-down native plant life a chance to thrive again. So begins the wholesome adventure to restore their past in order to create a better future! Play as Stick as you search for the lost plants and help the community so that they both can thrive. 🌱✨ NOTE: New Roots is a short game. Estimated 1 hour completion time. 🌷 A beautiful futuristic solarpunk setting full of unique pixel art and animation 🌼 An optimistic outlook on global warming and focus on how we can still make positive change 🌹 Restore real-life plants that are being threatened by global warming and its consequences 🌻 A broad scope of charming queer, neurodivergent and disabled representation

rows.name: Green Wounds
rows.short_description: Craft, manage resources, fight enemies, and explore the unknown in this medieval RPG.
rows.description_html: Your wounds are fresh and it's time you got revenge... Green wounds is a RPG where you play as an exiled thief seeking revenge from a merciless king. Collect resources, fight enemies, craft new weapons and tools, explore the unknown, and uncover hidden truths about the world you are living in. Gather resources from collecting them around the world, mining them out of ores and trees, or having your villagers find them for you automatically. Use resources to craft new tools, weapons, consumables and other items that you will find useful throughout your journey. Talk to NPC's to learn more about the world and gain new and unique items and abilities. Fight beasts and monsters hiding out in the woods or even knights and kings. Uncover religions and cults in order to piece together the history of the land and maybe even take it over for yourself... features *Collect Resources from chopping trees, mining rocks, etc... *Craft new tools, weapons, and items *Manage resources generated by a team of villagers at your disposal *Explore a vast map that takes you to various locations *Interact with and talk to NPC's *Fight enemies by clicking on equipped weapons and items

rows.short_description: A Simple, Fun, Multiplayer FPS game, strictly built and packaged for development testing and networking development.
rows.description_html: FPS Game: Dev Test, is a First person shooter that is strictly built of a development asset, its intended purpose is to test and showcase networking features and other advanced Steam systems. It will continue to adapt and have new mechanics and testable features as time goes on. It is functioning and can be played by anyone. It is intended for multiplayer PVP combat and sessions, but creates online sessions using listen server at the moment. This is good if you want to just play with your friends only in a small private game. It currently uses a basic sort of class system that gives you a skill based on what class is selected e.g. Ammo box, health box, explosives box. On the loadout screen the player will get to pick what Class, Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Perk and Grenade type. You can play single player against bots, or multiplayer (can include bots as well). It uses a server browser, so look for a game and join random people. or create a game for you and your friends for the private experience if you'd prefer. Development The Game is built for development purposes and will change on a fairly regular basis, adding more content each time. This will mean more gamemodes and different weapon systems will be added along the way. Gamemodes: There is many game modes to play, and more to be added with time, ranging from: Capture the Flag, Team Death Match, Free For All, Confirmed Kill, Conquest/Domination. Weapons/Loadouts: There is a variety of weapon types you can choose from when playing: Assault Rifle, Shotgun, Machine Gun, Sniper, SMG, Pistols.

rows.name: 東方眠世界 ~ Wonderful Waking World
rows.short_description: A simplistic, dynamic Touhou fangame bullet hell shmup with a pixel art esthetic. Shoot down your enemies and dodge your way through an incessant barrage of projectiles!
rows.description_html: Gensokyo. A land of fantasy and phantasm. It was a normal day. And a normal day for Gensokyo meant it was an incident day. The sky. It was shattered into pieces A gaping hole, as if the sky was nothing more than a glass dome. Three of the land's residents decided to take action. Join Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame and Sanae Kochiya in their way to find the one who broke Gensokyo's sky! If you're a fan of the Touhou Project series, you'll feel right at home here! Shoot down your enemies, dodge the mess happening on screen and use your bombs to destroy everything in your way through a six-stage main game and an extra unlockable stage! With a range of four difficulty levels to choose from, both veterans and newcomers to the genre should be able to enjoy the game! Meet a cast of original characters, coupled with a few familiar faces as well as some special cameos! Are you tired of looong Touhou games with convoluted mechanics and systems? Well, you're in luck! The patterns here are straight to the point, allowing for a dynamic overall experience, with a system brought back to its bare minimum letting you focus fully on your dodging!
